  if(!backdrop&&item.backdrop_path) backdrop=IMG+(tvPerformanceEnabled()?"w780":"w1280")+item.backdrop_path;
  if(poster&&excluded.has(poster)) poster="";
  if(backdrop&&excluded.has(backdrop)) backdrop="";
  if(logo&&excluded.has(logo)) logo="";
  return sanitizeArtworkResult({poster,backdrop,logo,provider:item.artwork_provider||"catalogue",imdb:item.imdb_id||item.imdb||""});
}
function artworkIdentity(item){
  return buildTitleIdentity({type:typeOf(item),id:item&&item.id,title:titleOf(item),year:item&&(item.year||yearOf(item)),imdb_id:item&&(item.imdb_id||item.imdb||"")});
}
function artworkCandidateMatches(names,years,item){
  const identity=artworkIdentity(item);
  if(!identity.title||/^title$/i.test(identity.title)) return false;
  let best=0;
  for(const name of Array.isArray(names)?names:[names]){
    if(!name) continue;
    best=Math.max(best,identityTitleScore(String(name),identity).score);
  }
  if(best<86) return false;
  const wanted=Number(identity.year)||0;
  const found=(Array.isArray(years)?years:[years]).map(v=>Number(String(v||"").slice(0,4))).filter(v=>v>=1900&&v<=2100);
  if(wanted&&found.length) return found.some(y=>Math.abs(y-wanted)<=1);
  return best>=92;
}
function artworkProbeImage(url){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    if(!url||typeof Image!=="function"){ resolve(false); return; }
    const img=new Image();
    let done=false;
    const finish=ok=>{ if(done) return; done=true; clearTimeout(timer); img.onload=null; img.onerror=null; resolve(!!ok); };
    const timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(false),5500);
    img.onload=()=>finish((img.naturalWidth||0)>=32&&(img.naturalHeight||0)>=32);
    img.onerror=()=>finish(false);
    try{ img.decoding="async"; }catch{}
    img.src=url;
  });
}
async function probeArtworkCandidate(candidate,needs,excludeUrls){
  const clean=sanitizeArtworkResult(candidate);
  if(!clean) return null;
  const excluded=excludeUrls instanceof Set?excludeUrls:new Set();
  if(clean.poster&&excluded.has(clean.poster)) clean.poster="";
  if(clean.backdrop&&excluded.has(clean.backdrop)) clean.backdrop="";
  if(clean.logo&&excluded.has(clean.logo)) clean.logo="";
  if(needs.poster&&clean.poster&&!(await artworkProbeImage(clean.poster))) clean.poster="";
  if(needs.backdrop&&clean.backdrop&&!(await artworkProbeImage(clean.backdrop))) clean.backdrop="";
  if(clean.logo&&!(await artworkProbeImage(clean.logo))) clean.logo="";
  return sanitizeArtworkResult(clean);
}
async function artworkFetchJson(url,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  const timeoutMs=Math.max(2500,Math.min(15000,Number(opts.timeoutMs)||9000));
  const request=async target=>{
    const ctl=typeof AbortController==="function"?new AbortController():null;
    const timer=ctl?setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),timeoutMs):null;
    try{
      const init={signal:ctl?ctl.signal:undefined,credentials:"omit",cache:"force-cache",headers:Object.assign({Accept:"application/json"},opts.headers||{})};
      if(opts.method) init.method=opts.method;
      if(opts.body!=null) init.body=opts.body;
      const response=await fetch(target,init);
      if(!response.ok){ const err=new Error("HTTP "+response.status); err.status=response.status; throw err; }
      return await response.json();
    }finally{ if(timer) clearTimeout(timer); }
  };
  try{ return await request(url); }
  catch(err){
    if((!opts.method||opts.method==="GET")&&typeof location!=="undefined"&&/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)&&!/^\/api\//.test(url)){
      return await request("/api/extract?mode=json&url="+encodeURIComponent(url));
    }
    throw err;
  }
}
async function artworkFromCinemeta(item){
  if(!artworkSetting("cinemeta")||typeof cinemetaFetch!=="function"||typeof CINEMETA==="undefined") return undefined;
  const type=typeOf(item);
  const imdb=String(item.imdb_id||item.imdb||(typeof lookupImdbByTmdb==="function"?lookupImdbByTmdb(Number(item.id)):"")||"").toLowerCase();
  if(!/^tt\d+$/i.test(imdb)) return null;
  try{
    const data=await cinemetaFetch(CINEMETA+"/meta/"+(typeof cmType==="function"?cmType(type):(type==="tv"?"series":"movie"))+"/"+encodeURIComponent(imdb)+".json");
    const meta=data&&data.meta;
    if(!meta) return null;
    const candidate=sanitizeArtworkResult({
      poster:meta.poster?String(meta.poster).replace("/poster/small/","/poster/medium/"):"",
      backdrop:meta.background||"",
      logo:meta.logo||"",
      provider:"Cinemeta / MetaHub",
      imdb:meta.imdb_id||meta.id||imdb
    });
    return candidate||null;
  }catch{ return undefined; }
}
function tvmazeArtworkCandidate(show,needs){
  if(!show) return null;
  const image=show.image||{};
  return sanitizeArtworkResult({
    poster:tvPerformanceEnabled()?(image.medium||image.original||""):(image.original||image.medium||""),
    backdrop:"",
    provider:"TVmaze",
    imdb:show.externals&&show.externals.imdb||""
  });
}
async function tvmazeShowForItem(item){
  const imdb=String(item.imdb_id||item.imdb||(typeof lookupImdbByTmdb==="function"?lookupImdbByTmdb(Number(item.id)):"")||"").toLowerCase();
  if(/^tt\d+$/i.test(imdb)){
    try{
      const show=await artworkFetchJson("https://api.tvmaze.com/lookup/shows?imdb="+encodeURIComponent(imdb),{timeoutMs:8000});
      if(show&&show.id) return {show,trusted:true,definitive:true};
    }catch(err){ if(!(err&&err.status===404)) return {show:null,trusted:false,definitive:false}; }
  }
  const title=titleOf(item);
  if(!title||/^title$/i.test(title)) return {show:null,trusted:false,definitive:true};
  try{
    const rows=await artworkFetchJson("https://api.tvmaze.com/search/shows?q="+encodeURIComponent(title),{timeoutMs:9000});
    const list=(Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[]).map(row=>row&&row.show).filter(Boolean);
    const show=list.find(candidate=>artworkCandidateMatches([candidate.name],[candidate.premiered],item))||null;
    return {show,trusted:false,definitive:true};
  }catch(err){ return {show:null,trusted:false,definitive:!!(err&&err.status===404)}; }
}
async function artworkFromTvmaze(item,needs){
  if(!artworkSetting("tvmaze")||typeOf(item)!=="tv") return undefined;
  const found=await tvmazeShowForItem(item);
  if(!found.show) return found.definitive?null:undefined;
  const candidate=tvmazeArtworkCandidate(found.show,needs)||{poster:"",backdrop:"",logo:"",provider:"TVmaze",providers:["TVmaze"],imdb:found.show.externals&&found.show.externals.imdb||""};
  if(needs.backdrop&&found.show.id){
    try{
      const images=await artworkFetchJson("https://api.tvmaze.com/shows/"+encodeURIComponent(found.show.id)+"/images",{timeoutMs:9000});
      const backgrounds=(Array.isArray(images)?images:[]).filter(image=>image&&image.type==="background");
      backgrounds.sort((a,b)=>(b.main===true)-(a.main===true));
      const chosen=backgrounds[0];
      const resolutions=chosen&&chosen.resolutions||{};
      candidate.backdrop=(resolutions.original&&resolutions.original.url)||(resolutions.medium&&resolutions.medium.url)||"";
    }catch{}
  }
  const clean=sanitizeArtworkResult(candidate);
  return clean||null;
}
function artworkLooksAnime(item){
  if(!item||typeOf(item)!=="tv") return false;
  const ids=Array.isArray(item.genre_ids)?item.genre_ids.map(Number):[];
  const genreNames=[...(Array.isArray(item.genres)?item.genres.map(g=>typeof g==="string"?g:(g&&g.name||"")):[]),...(Array.isArray(item.genre)?item.genre:[])].join(" ").toLowerCase();
  const countries=[...(Array.isArray(item.origin_country)?item.origin_country:[]),item.country||""].join(" ").toUpperCase();
  const language=String(item.original_language||item.language||"").toLowerCase();
  if(ids.includes(16)&&(language==="ja"||countries.includes("JP"))) return true;
  if(/\banime\b/.test(genreNames)) return true;
  return ids.includes(16)&&!language&&!countries;
}
async function artworkFromAnilist(item){
  if(!artworkSetting("anilist")||!artworkLooksAnime(item)) return undefined;
  const title=titleOf(item);
  if(!title||/^title$/i.test(title)) return null;
  const year=Number(yearOf(item)||item.year)||null;
  const query="query ($search:String,$year:Int){Page(page:1,perPage:6){media(search:$search,seasonYear:$year,type:ANIME,sort:SEARCH_MATCH){id format seasonYear startDate{year} title{romaji english native} synonyms coverImage{extraLarge large medium} bannerImage}}}";
  const run=async variables=>{
    const data=await artworkFetchJson("https://graphql.anilist.co",{method:"POST",timeoutMs:10000,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({query,variables})});
    if(data&&Array.isArray(data.errors)&&data.errors.length) throw new Error(data.errors[0].message||"AniList error");
    return data&&data.data&&data.data.Page&&Array.isArray(data.data.Page.media)?data.data.Page.media:[];
  };
  try{
    let rows=await run({search:title,year});
    if(!rows.length&&year) rows=await run({search:title,year:null});
    const media=rows.find(candidate=>{
      const names=[candidate.title&&candidate.title.english,candidate.title&&candidate.title.romaji,candidate.title&&candidate.title.native,...(Array.isArray(candidate.synonyms)?candidate.synonyms:[])];
      const years=[candidate.seasonYear,candidate.startDate&&candidate.startDate.year];
      return artworkCandidateMatches(names,years,item);
    });
    if(!media) return null;
    const cover=media.coverImage||{};
    return sanitizeArtworkResult({
      poster:tvPerformanceEnabled()?(cover.large||cover.medium||cover.extraLarge||""):(cover.extraLarge||cover.large||cover.medium||""),
      backdrop:media.bannerImage||"",
      provider:"AniList"
    })||null;
  }catch{ return undefined; }
}
async function artworkFromItunes(item){
  if(!artworkSetting("itunes")) return undefined;
  const title=titleOf(item);
  if(!title||/^title$/i.test(title)) return null;
  const type=typeOf(item);
  const params=new URLSearchParams({term:title,media:type==="movie"?"movie":"tvShow",entity:type==="movie"?"movie":"tvSeason",limit:"10",country:"US"});
  try{
    const data=await artworkFetchJson("https://itunes.apple.com/search?"+params.toString(),{timeoutMs:9000});
    const rows=data&&Array.isArray(data.results)?data.results:[];
    const hit=rows.find(candidate=>{
      const names=[candidate.trackName,candidate.collectionName,candidate.artistName&&candidate.collectionName?candidate.collectionName:""];
      return artworkCandidateMatches(names,[candidate.releaseDate],item);
    });
    if(!hit) return null;
    return sanitizeArtworkResult({poster:hit.artworkUrl100||hit.artworkUrl60||"",provider:"Apple iTunes"})||null;
  }catch(err){ return err&&err.status===404?null:undefined; }
}
function mergeArtworkResults(base,candidate){
  const cleanBase=sanitizeArtworkResult(base)||{poster:"",backdrop:"",logo:"",provider:"",providers:[],imdb:""};
  const cleanCandidate=sanitizeArtworkResult(candidate);
  if(!cleanCandidate) return sanitizeArtworkResult(cleanBase);
  if(!cleanBase.poster&&cleanCandidate.poster) cleanBase.poster=cleanCandidate.poster;
  if(!cleanBase.backdrop&&cleanCandidate.backdrop) cleanBase.backdrop=cleanCandidate.backdrop;
  if(!cleanBase.logo&&cleanCandidate.logo) cleanBase.logo=cleanCandidate.logo;
  if(!cleanBase.imdb&&cleanCandidate.imdb) cleanBase.imdb=cleanCandidate.imdb;
  const providers=[];
  [...(cleanBase.providers||[]),...(cleanCandidate.providers||[])].forEach(name=>{ if(name&&!providers.includes(name)) providers.push(name); });
  cleanBase.providers=providers;
  cleanBase.provider=providers[0]||cleanCandidate.provider||"catalogue";
  cleanBase.updatedAt=Date.now();
  return sanitizeArtworkResult(cleanBase);
}
function applyArtworkToItem(item,art){
  if(!item||!art) return item;
  if(art.poster) item.poster_url=art.poster;
  if(art.backdrop) item.backdrop_url=art.backdrop;
  if(art.logo) item.logo_url=art.logo;
  if(art.provider) item.artwork_provider=art.providers&&art.providers.length?art.providers.join(" + "):art.provider;
  if(art.imdb&&!item.imdb_id) item.imdb_id=art.imdb;
  if(art.imdb&&typeof cinemetaByTmdb!=="undefined"&&item.id) cinemetaByTmdb.set(Number(item.id),art.imdb);
  return item;
}
function persistArtworkSnapshot(item,art){
  if(!item||!art) return;
  const type=typeOf(item), id=Number(item.id), key=keyOf(type,id);
  const update=snapshot=>{
    if(!snapshot||Number(snapshot.id)!==id||(snapshot.type||snapshot.media_type)!==type) return false;
    let changed=false;
    if(art.poster&&snapshot.poster_url!==art.poster){ snapshot.poster_url=art.poster; changed=true; }
    if(art.backdrop&&snapshot.backdrop_url!==art.backdrop){ snapshot.backdrop_url=art.backdrop; changed=true; }
    if(art.logo&&snapshot.logo_url!==art.logo){ snapshot.logo_url=art.logo; changed=true; }
    if(art.imdb&&!snapshot.imdb_id){ snapshot.imdb_id=art.imdb; changed=true; }
    if(art.provider) snapshot.artwork_provider=art.providers&&art.providers.length?art.providers.join(" + "):art.provider;
    return changed;
  };
  if(progress&&progress[key]&&update(progress[key])) saveProgress();
  let watchChanged=false;
  if(Array.isArray(watchlist)) watchlist.forEach(snapshot=>{ if(update(snapshot)) watchChanged=true; });
  if(watchChanged) saveWatchlist();
}
function applyArtworkToDom(item,art){
  if(!item||!art||typeof document==="undefined") return;
  const type=typeOf(item), id=String(Number(item.id)||item.id||"");
  $$("img[data-artwork-item]",document).forEach(img=>{
    if(img.dataset.type!==type||img.dataset.id!==id) return;
    const kind=img.dataset.artworkKind||"poster";
    const url=kind==="backdrop"?(art.backdrop||art.poster):(art.poster||art.backdrop);
    if(!url) return;
    img.dataset.artworkResolved="1";
    img.dataset.artworkMissing="";
    delete img.dataset.artworkFailedUrl;
    if(img.getAttribute("src")!==url){ delete img.dataset.fb; img.src=url; }
  });
}
async function resolveArtwork(item,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!item||!artworkFallbackEnabled()) return null;
  const key=artworkCacheKey(item);
  if(!key) return null;
  const excludeUrls=new Set([...(opts.excludeUrls||[]),...(opts.failedUrl?[opts.failedUrl]:[])].filter(Boolean).map(url=>cleanArtworkUrl(url,"poster")||String(url)));
  const cached=opts.force?null:cachedArtwork(item,{excludeUrls});
  const direct=artworkFromItem(item,excludeUrls);
  let result=mergeArtworkResults(cached,direct);
  const wantsPoster=opts.poster!==false;
  const wantsBackdrop=opts.backdrop===true||opts.kind==="backdrop";
  if(result&&(!wantsPoster||result.poster)&&(!wantsBackdrop||result.backdrop)){
    applyArtworkToItem(item,result);
    return result;
  }
  if(!opts.force){
    const missing=cachedArtwork(item,{includeMissing:true});
    if(missing&&missing.notFound&&!result) return null;
  }
  const flightKey=key+"|"+(wantsBackdrop?"backdrop":"poster")+"|"+[...excludeUrls].join("|");
  if(artworkInFlight.has(flightKey)) return artworkInFlight.get(flightKey);
  const promise=(async()=>{
    let definitiveMisses=0, providerAttempts=0;
    const providers=[
      ["cinemeta",()=>artworkFromCinemeta(item)],
      ["tvmaze",()=>artworkFromTvmaze(item,{poster:!result||!result.poster,backdrop:wantsBackdrop&&(!result||!result.backdrop)})],
      ["anilist",()=>artworkFromAnilist(item)],
      ["itunes",()=>artworkFromItunes(item)]
    ];
    for(const [name,load] of providers){
      if(!artworkSetting(name)) continue;
      if(result&&(!wantsPoster||result.poster)&&(!wantsBackdrop||result.backdrop)) break;
      providerAttempts++;
      let candidate;
      try{ candidate=await load(); }catch{ candidate=undefined; }
      if(candidate===null){ definitiveMisses++; continue; }
      if(!candidate) continue;
      const needs={poster:wantsPoster&&(!result||!result.poster),backdrop:wantsBackdrop&&(!result||!result.backdrop)};
      candidate=await probeArtworkCandidate(candidate,needs,excludeUrls);
      if(candidate) result=mergeArtworkResults(result,candidate);
      else definitiveMisses++;
    }
    if(result){
      artworkCache[key]=Object.assign({},result,{updatedAt:Date.now(),notFound:false});
      saveArtworkCacheSoon();
      applyArtworkToItem(item,result);
      try{ rememberCatalogItem(item); }catch{}
      persistArtworkSnapshot(item,result);
      applyArtworkToDom(item,result);
      return result;
    }
    if(providerAttempts&&definitiveMisses>=providerAttempts){
      artworkCache[key]={poster:"",backdrop:"",logo:"",provider:"",providers:[],imdb:"",updatedAt:Date.now(),notFound:true};
      saveArtworkCacheSoon();
    }
    return null;
  })();
  artworkInFlight.set(flightKey,promise);
  promise.finally(()=>{ if(artworkInFlight.get(flightKey)===promise) artworkInFlight.delete(flightKey); });
  return promise;
}
function artworkImgAttrs(item,kind,url){
  if(!item) return "";
  const missing=!url||/^data:image\/svg/i.test(String(url));
  return ' data-artwork-item="1" data-artwork-kind="'+esc(kind||"poster")+'" data-type="'+esc(typeOf(item))+'" data-id="'+esc(String(item.id||""))+'" data-seed="'+esc(String(item.id||9))+'"'+(missing?' data-artwork-missing="1"':"");
}
async function resolveArtworkForImage(img){
  if(!img||!img.isConnected) return;
  const type=img.dataset.type||"movie";
  const id=Number(img.dataset.id)||0;
  if(!id) return;
  const item=catalogItemFor(type,id);
  const art=await resolveArtwork(item,{kind:img.dataset.artworkKind||"poster",failedUrl:img.dataset.artworkFailedUrl||"",force:!!img.dataset.artworkFailedUrl});
  if(art) applyArtworkToDom(item,art);
}
function pumpArtworkDomQueue(){
  const limit=tvPerformanceEnabled()?1:2;
  while(artworkDomActive<limit&&artworkDomQueue.length){
    const img=artworkDomQueue.shift();
    if(!img||!img.isConnected||img.dataset.artworkResolved) continue;
    artworkDomActive++;
    resolveArtworkForImage(img).catch(()=>{}).finally(()=>{ artworkDomActive=Math.max(0,artworkDomActive-1); pumpArtworkDomQueue(); });
  }
}
function queueArtworkForImage(img,force){
  if(!img||!artworkFallbackEnabled()||img.dataset.artworkResolved) return;
  if(!force&&artworkDomQueued.has(img)) return;
  artworkDomQueued.add(img);
  if(!artworkDomQueue.includes(img)) artworkDomQueue.push(img);
  pumpArtworkDomQueue();
}
function bindArtworkFallbacks(root){
  if(!artworkFallbackEnabled()||typeof document==="undefined") return;
  const images=$$('img[data-artwork-item="1"][data-artwork-missing="1"]',root||document);
  if(!images.length) return;
  if(typeof IntersectionObserver!=="function"){ images.forEach(img=>queueArtworkForImage(img,false)); return; }
  if(!artworkDomObserver){
    artworkDomObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
      entries.forEach(entry=>{ if(entry.isIntersecting){ artworkDomObserver.unobserve(entry.target); queueArtworkForImage(entry.target,false); } });
    },{root:null,rootMargin:"320px",threshold:0.01});
  }
  images.forEach(img=>{ if(!artworkDomQueued.has(img)) artworkDomObserver.observe(img); });
}

function trailersAllowed(){
  if(!settings.stream||settings.stream.trailerPreviews===false) return false;
  if(playerState||document.hidden||effectiveSaver()) return false;
  try{ if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return false; }catch{}
  const conn=navigator.connection||{};
  if(conn.saveData||/(^|-)2g$/.test(String(conn.effectiveType||""))) return false;
  return true;
}
function youtubePreviewURL(key,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  const params=new URLSearchParams({autoplay:"1",mute:opts.sound?"0":"1",controls:"0",disablekb:"1",fs:"0",iv_load_policy:"3",loop:"1",playlist:key,modestbranding:"1",playsinline:"1",rel:"0"});
  return "https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/"+encodeURIComponent(key)+"?"+params.toString();
}
async function getTrailerKey(item,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!item||!item.id) return trailerKeyFromData(item);
  const type=typeOf(item), key=keyOf(type,Number(item.id));
  const immediate=trailerKeyFromData(item)||trailerKeyCache.get(key)||"";
  if(immediate){ trailerKeyCache.set(key,immediate); return immediate; }
  if(opts.fetchDetail===false) return "";
  if(trailerFetchCache.has(key)) return trailerFetchCache.get(key);
  const promise=(async()=>{
    try{
      const detail=await tmdb("/"+type+"/"+Number(item.id),{append_to_response:"videos,external_ids"});
      const found=trailerKeyFromData(detail);
      if(found){ trailerKeyCache.set(key,found); rememberCatalogItem(Object.assign({},item,{trailer_key:found})); }
      return found;
    }catch{ return ""; }
  })();
  trailerFetchCache.set(key,promise);
  promise.finally(()=>setTimeout(()=>trailerFetchCache.delete(key),30000));
  return promise;
}
function stopCardPreview(card){
  const target=card||activeCardPreview;
  if(cardPreviewTimer){ clearTimeout(cardPreviewTimer); cardPreviewTimer=null; }
  cardPreviewToken++;
  if(!target){ activeCardPreview=null; return; }
  target.classList.remove("is-previewing");
  const layer=target.querySelector(".trailer-layer");
  if(layer) layer.innerHTML="";
  if(activeCardPreview===target) activeCardPreview=null;
  if(cardPreviewObserver) cardPreviewObserver.disconnect();
}
async function startCardPreview(card,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!card||!card.isConnected||!trailersAllowed()) return;
  if(activeCardPreview&&activeCardPreview!==card) stopCardPreview(activeCardPreview);
  const token=++cardPreviewToken;
  const item=catalogItemFor(card.dataset.type,card.dataset.id);
  const key=await getTrailerKey(item,{fetchDetail:opts.fetchDetail!==false});
  if(!key||token!==cardPreviewToken||!card.isConnected||card.dataset.previewWanted!=="1"||!trailersAllowed()) return;
  const layer=card.querySelector(".trailer-layer");
  if(!layer) return;
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview);
  layer.innerHTML='<iframe title="Trailer preview for '+esc(titleOf(item))+'" src="'+esc(youtubePreviewURL(key))+'" loading="lazy" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe>';
  card.classList.add("is-previewing");
  activeCardPreview=card;
  if(cardPreviewObserver) cardPreviewObserver.disconnect();
  if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
    cardPreviewObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{ if(entries[0]&&entries[0].intersectionRatio<0.28) stopCardPreview(card); },{threshold:[0,.28,.6]});
    cardPreviewObserver.observe(card);
  }
}
function scheduleCardPreview(card,delay,opts){
  if(!card) return;
  card.dataset.previewWanted="1";
  if(activeCardPreview&&activeCardPreview!==card) stopCardPreview(activeCardPreview);
  if(cardPreviewTimer) clearTimeout(cardPreviewTimer);
  const effectiveDelay=tvPerformanceEnabled()?Math.max(1600,delay==null?620:Number(delay)||620):(delay==null?620:delay);
  cardPreviewTimer=setTimeout(()=>startCardPreview(card,opts||{}),effectiveDelay);
}
function clearCardPreviewIntent(card){
  if(!card) return;
  delete card.dataset.previewWanted;
  if(activeCardPreview===card||card.classList.contains("is-previewing")) stopCardPreview(card);
  else if(cardPreviewTimer){ clearTimeout(cardPreviewTimer); cardPreviewTimer=null; cardPreviewToken++; }
}
function updateRailProgress(track){
  const bar=track&&track.closest(".rail")?track.closest(".rail").querySelector(".rail-progress i"):null;
  if(!bar||!track) return;
  const max=Math.max(1,track.scrollWidth-track.clientWidth);
  const pct=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,track.scrollLeft/max));
  const width=Math.max(10,(track.clientWidth/Math.max(1,track.scrollWidth))*100);
  bar.style.width=width+"%";
  bar.style.transform="translateX("+(pct*(100-width)/Math.max(1,width)*100)+"%)";
}
function spotlightRailCard(track){
  if(!track||!trailersAllowed()) return;
  const rect=track.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(rect.bottom<70||rect.top>window.innerHeight-40) return;
  const center=rect.left+rect.width/2;
  let best=null,bestScore=Infinity;
  track.querySelectorAll(".poster-card").forEach(card=>{
    const r=card.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(r.right<rect.left||r.left>rect.right) return;
    const score=Math.abs((r.left+r.width/2)-center);
    if(score<bestScore){ bestScore=score; best=card; }
  });
  if(best&&best!==activeCardPreview) scheduleCardPreview(best,240,{fetchDetail:false});
}
function bindRailSpotlights(root){
  (root||document).querySelectorAll(".rail-track").forEach(track=>{
    updateRailProgress(track);
    if(track.dataset.spotlightBound) return;
    track.dataset.spotlightBound="1";
    let timer=null;
    track.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{
      updateRailProgress(track);
      if(activeCardPreview&&track.contains(activeCardPreview)) stopCardPreview(activeCardPreview);
      clearTimeout(timer); timer=setTimeout(()=>spotlightRailCard(track),260);
    },{passive:true});
  });
}
let pageSpotlightTimer=null;
window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{
  const topbar=document.getElementById("topbar"); if(topbar) topbar.classList.toggle("is-scrolled",window.scrollY>12);
  clearTimeout(pageSpotlightTimer);
  pageSpotlightTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!trailersAllowed()||document.querySelector(".poster-card:hover")||document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.classList&&document.activeElement.classList.contains("poster-card")) return;
    const tracks=[...document.querySelectorAll(".rail-track")].map(track=>({track,rect:track.getBoundingClientRect()})).filter(x=>x.rect.bottom>90&&x.rect.top<window.innerHeight-30);
    tracks.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs((a.rect.top+a.rect.bottom)/2-window.innerHeight/2)-Math.abs((b.rect.top+b.rect.bottom)/2-window.innerHeight/2));
    if(tracks[0]) spotlightRailCard(tracks[0].track);
  },520);
},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{ if(document.hidden){ stopCardPreview(); document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview); } });
function stopBackdropPreview(container){
  if(!container) return;
  if(container._previewTimer){ clearTimeout(container._previewTimer); container._previewTimer=null; }
  if(container._previewObserver){ container._previewObserver.disconnect(); container._previewObserver=null; }
  container.classList.remove("on"); container.innerHTML=""; container.dataset.playing="";
}
async function startBackdropPreview(container,item,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!container||!item||!trailersAllowed()) return;
  stopCardPreview();
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(other=>{ if(other!==container) stopBackdropPreview(other); });
  stopBackdropPreview(container);
  const key=await getTrailerKey(item,{fetchDetail:true});
  if(!key||!container.isConnected||!trailersAllowed()) return;
  container.dataset.key=key;
  container._previewTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!container.isConnected||!trailersAllowed()) return;
    container.innerHTML='<iframe title="Trailer preview for '+esc(titleOf(item))+'" src="'+esc(youtubePreviewURL(key,{sound:!!opts.sound}))+'" loading="lazy" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe>';
    container.classList.add("on"); container.dataset.playing="1"; container.dataset.sound=opts.sound?"1":"";
    if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
      container._previewObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{ if(entries[0]&&entries[0].intersectionRatio<0.22) stopBackdropPreview(container); },{threshold:[0,.22,.5]});
      container._previewObserver.observe(container);
    }
  },tvPerformanceEnabled()?Math.max(2000,Number(opts.delay)||900):(opts.delay==null?900:opts.delay));
}
function toggleBackdropPreviewSound(container,item){
  if(!container) return;
  stopCardPreview();
  const key=container.dataset.key||trailerKeyFromData(item);
  if(!key) return;
  const next=container.dataset.sound!=="1";
  stopBackdropPreview(container); container.dataset.key=key;
  /* Sound-on reload is a user gesture, so browsers can allow audible autoplay. */
  settings.stream.trailerPreviews=true;
  container.innerHTML='<iframe title="Trailer preview" src="'+esc(youtubePreviewURL(key,{sound:next}))+'" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe>';
  container.classList.add("on"); container.dataset.playing="1"; container.dataset.sound=next?"1":"";
}

/* ---------------- cards / rails ---------------- */
function cardHTML(it,opts={}){
  it=rememberCatalogItem(it);
  const type=typeOf(it), k=keyOf(type,it.id), pr=progress[k];
  const pct=pr&&pr.percent?Math.round(pr.percent):0;
  const listed=inWatchlist(type,it.id);
  const genres=(it.genre_ids||[]).map(id=>genreName(type,id)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).join(" · ");
  const index=Number.isFinite(Number(opts.index))?Math.max(0,Math.min(14,Number(opts.index))):0;
  return '<article class="poster-card" style="--i:'+index+'" data-type="'+type+'" data-id="'+it.id+'"'+(it.search_provider?' data-search-provider="'+esc(it.search_provider)+'"':'')+' tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="'+esc(titleOf(it))+(it.trailer_key?". Trailer preview available":"")+'">'
        +'<div class="poster-wrap"><img loading="lazy" src="'+esc(posterURL(it))+'" alt="'+esc(titleOf(it))+'"'+artworkImgAttrs(it,"poster",posterURL(it))+'>'
    +'<div class="trailer-layer" aria-hidden="true"></div><span class="preview-badge">Trailer</span>'
    +'<div class="poster-badges"><span class="chip violet">'+(type==="tv"?"Series":"Movie")+'</span></div>'
    +(it.vote_average?'<span class="poster-rate">★ '+Number(it.vote_average).toFixed(1)+"</span>":"")
    +(opts.remove?'<button class="icon-btn remove-x" data-remove="'+k+'" title="Remove" aria-label="Remove">×</button>':"")
    +'<div class="hover-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" data-play="'+k+'">▶ Watch</button>'
    +'<button class="btn btn-secondary" data-details="'+k+'">Details</button>'
    +'<button class="btn btn-outline" data-list="'+k+'">'+(listed?"✓ In Library":"+ Watchlist")+"</button>"
    +(it.overview?'<span class="card-overview">'+esc(String(it.overview).slice(0,150))+"</span>":"")
    +"</div>"
    +(pct>0&&pct<98?'<div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%"></div></div>':"")
    +'</div><div class="poster-meta"><div class="t">'+esc(titleOf(it))+'</div><div class="s">'+esc(yearOf(it)||"")+(genres?" · "+esc(genres):"")+(pr&&type==="tv"&&pr.season?" · S"+pr.season+" E"+(pr.episode||1):"")+(pct>0?" · "+pct+"% watched":"")+"</div></div></article>";
}
function railHTML(title,items,opts={}){
  if(!items||!items.length) return "";
  return '<section class="rail"><div class="rail-head"><h2>'+esc(title)+'</h2><div class="rail-arrows"><button class="icon-btn" data-scroll="-1" aria-label="Scroll left">‹</button><button class="icon-btn" data-scroll="1" aria-label="Scroll right">›</button></div></div><div class="rail-track">'+items.map((it,i)=>cardHTML(it,Object.assign({},opts,{index:i}))).join("")+'</div><div class="rail-progress" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div></section>';
}
function skeletonRail(title){ return '<section class="rail"><div class="rail-head"><h2>'+esc(title)+'</h2></div><div class="rail-track">'+'<div class="skel" style="flex:0 0 154px"><div class="ph"></div></div>'.repeat(7)+"</div></section>"; }
function bindCards(root){
  bindRailSpotlights(root);
  bindArtworkFallbacks(root);
  bindContinueWatching(root);
  if(root.dataset&&root.dataset.cardsBound) return;
  if(root.dataset) root.dataset.cardsBound="1";
  let intentTimer=null,intentKey="";
  const intent=(e,previewDelay)=>{ const card=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".poster-card"); if(!card||card.dataset.searchProvider) return; const key=card.dataset.type+":"+card.dataset.id; if(key!==intentKey){ intentKey=key; clearTimeout(intentTimer); intentTimer=setTimeout(()=>{ if(card.dataset.previewWanted!=="1") return; const pr=progress[key]||{}; faststreamPreload({type:card.dataset.type,id:Number(card.dataset.id),season:pr.season||1,episode:pr.episode||1},defaultSourceId()); },tvPerformanceEnabled()?2400:1350); } scheduleCardPreview(card,previewDelay,{fetchDetail:true}); };
  root.addEventListener("mouseover",e=>intent(e,tvPerformanceEnabled()?1500:680));
  root.addEventListener("focusin",e=>intent(e,tvPerformanceEnabled()?1700:520));
  root.addEventListener("mouseout",e=>{ const card=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".poster-card"); if(card&&!(e.relatedTarget&&card.contains(e.relatedTarget))){ intentKey=""; clearTimeout(intentTimer); clearCardPreviewIntent(card); } });
  root.addEventListener("focusout",e=>{ const card=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".poster-card"); if(card&&!(e.relatedTarget&&card.contains(e.relatedTarget))){ intentKey=""; clearTimeout(intentTimer); clearCardPreviewIntent(card); } });
  root.addEventListener("click",e=>{
    const sc=e.target.closest("[data-scroll]");
    if(sc){ const track=sc.closest(".rail").querySelector(".rail-track"); track.scrollBy({left:Number(sc.dataset.scroll)*track.clientWidth*0.8,behavior:"smooth"}); return; }
    const rm=e.target.closest("[data-remove]");
    if(rm){ e.stopPropagation(); const [t,id]=rm.dataset.remove.split(":"); delete progress[keyOf(t,Number(id))]; watchlist=watchlist.filter(w=>!(w.type===t&&w.id===Number(id))); saveProgress(); saveWatchlist(); toast("Removed"); render(); return; }
    const play=e.target.closest("[data-play]"), det=e.target.closest("[data-details]"), list=e.target.closest("[data-list]");
    const card=e.target.closest(".poster-card");
    if(list&&card){ e.stopPropagation(); toggleWatchlist(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id),card); return; }
    if(play&&card){ e.stopPropagation(); quickPlay(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id)); return; }
    if(card){ openDetail(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id)); return; }
    if(det){ const [t,id]=det.dataset.details.split(":"); openDetail(t,Number(id)); }
  });
  root.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ const card=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".poster-card"); if(!card) return; if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){ e.preventDefault(); openDetail(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id)); } else if(e.key.toLowerCase()==="p"||["MediaPlayPause","MediaPlay","MediaPause"].includes(e.key)){ e.preventDefault(); quickPlay(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id)); } });
}

function continueProgressLabel(record,type){
  if(!record) return type==="tv"?"Continue episode":"Continue watching";
  const ep=type==="tv"?("S"+(record.season||1)+" E"+(record.episode||1)):"";
  const pos=Number(record.timestamp||record.position)||0;
  const duration=Number(record.duration)||0;
  const pct=Number(record.percent)||(duration&&pos?Math.round(pos/duration*100):0);
  let left="";
  if(duration>pos&&pos>0) left=formatTime(duration-pos)+" left";
  else if(pct>0) left=Math.round(pct)+"% watched";
  return [ep,left].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")||"Resume";
}
function continueCardHTML(it){
  it=rememberCatalogItem(it);
  const type=typeOf(it), key=keyOf(type,it.id), record=progress[key]||{};
  const pct=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(Number(record.percent)||0)));
  const artUrl=backdropURL(it,"w780");
  const label=continueProgressLabel(record,type);
  return '<article class="continue-card" data-type="'+type+'" data-id="'+it.id+'" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Resume '+esc(titleOf(it))+". "+esc(label)+'">'
    +'<div class="continue-media"><img loading="lazy" src="'+esc(artUrl)+'" alt="'+esc(titleOf(it))+'"'+artworkImgAttrs(it,"backdrop",artUrl)+'>'
    +'<div class="continue-shade"></div><span class="continue-play" aria-hidden="true">▶</span>'
    +'<button class="icon-btn continue-remove" type="button" data-continue-remove="'+key+'" aria-label="Remove '+esc(titleOf(it))+' from Continue Watching" title="Remove from Continue Watching">×</button>'
    +'</div><div class="continue-meta"><div class="t">'+esc(titleOf(it))+'</div><div class="s">'+esc(label)+'</div>'
    +(pct>0?'<div class="progress-track continue-progress"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%"></div></div>':"")
    +'<div class="continue-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" data-continue-play="'+key+'">▶ Resume</button><button class="btn btn-secondary btn-xs" type="button" data-continue-details="'+key+'">Details</button></div>'
    +'</div></article>';
}
function continueRailHTML(items){
  if(!items||!items.length) return "";
  return '<section class="rail continue-rail"><div class="rail-head"><h2>Continue Watching</h2><div class="rail-arrows"><button class="icon-btn" data-scroll="-1" aria-label="Scroll Continue Watching left">‹</button><button class="icon-btn" data-scroll="1" aria-label="Scroll Continue Watching right">›</button></div></div><div class="rail-track continue-track">'+items.map(continueCardHTML).join("")+'</div><div class="rail-progress" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div></section>';
}
function bindContinueWatching(root){
  if(!root||!root.addEventListener||(root.dataset&&root.dataset.continueBound)) return;
  if(root.dataset) root.dataset.continueBound="1";
  root.addEventListener("click",e=>{
    const remove=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-continue-remove]");
    if(remove){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); const [type,id]=remove.dataset.continueRemove.split(":"); delete progress[keyOf(type,Number(id))]; saveProgress(); toast("Removed from Continue Watching"); render(); return; }
    const details=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-continue-details]");
    if(details){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); const [type,id]=details.dataset.continueDetails.split(":"); openDetail(type,Number(id)); return; }
    const play=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-continue-play]");
    const card=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".continue-card");
    if(card&&(play||!e.target.closest("button"))){ e.preventDefault(); quickPlay(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id)); }
  });
  root.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    const card=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".continue-card");
    if(!card||e.target.closest("button")) return;
    if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "||["MediaPlayPause","MediaPlay","MediaPause"].includes(e.key)||String(e.key).toLowerCase()==="p"){ e.preventDefault(); quickPlay(card.dataset.type,Number(card.dataset.id)); }
  });
}

function toggleWatchlist(type,id,cardEl,snapData){
  if(inWatchlist(type,id)){ watchlist=watchlist.filter(w=>!(w.type===type&&w.id===id)); toast("Removed from watchlist"); }
  else{
    let s=snapData;
    if(!s&&cardEl){ const cached=catalogItemFor(type,id); s=cached&&cached.id?snap(cached,type):null; if(!s||!s.title){ const t=cardEl.querySelector(".poster-meta .t"); s={id,type,title:t?t.textContent:"",poster_path:null,backdrop_path:null,year:"",rating:null}; const img=cardEl.querySelector("img"); if(img&&img.src.includes("image.tmdb.org")) s.poster_path=img.src.replace(IMG+"w342",""); } }
    if(s) watchlist.unshift(s);
    toast("Added to watchlist","success");
  }
  saveWatchlist(); refreshListButtons(type,id);
}
function refreshListButtons(type,id){
  $$('.poster-card[data-type="'+type+'"][data-id="'+id+'"] [data-list]').forEach(b=>b.textContent=inWatchlist(type,id)?"✓ In Library":"+ Watchlist");
  const db=$("#btnWatchlist"); if(db&&db.dataset.type===type&&Number(db.dataset.id)===id) db.textContent=inWatchlist(type,id)?"✓ In Library":"+ Watchlist";
}
async function quickPlay(type,id){
  let item={id,type,title:"",poster_path:null,backdrop_path:null};
  const k=keyOf(type,id);
  const cached=catalogItemFor(type,id); if(cached&&cached.id) item=Object.assign(item,snap(cached,type));
  if(progress[k]) item=Object.assign(item,progress[k]);
  const w=watchlist.find(x=>x.type===type&&x.id===id); if(w) item=Object.assign(item,w);
  if(!item.title){ try{ const d=await tmdb("/"+type+"/"+id); item=Object.assign(item,snap(d,type)); }catch{} }
  openPlayer(item,{});
}

/* ---------------- player (FastStream-enabled) ---------------- */
let playerState=null, playerTimers=[];
function clearPlayerTimers(){ playerTimers.forEach(t=>{ clearTimeout(t); clearInterval(t); }); playerTimers=[]; }
function withPlayerRuntime(st){
  const target=st&&typeof st==="object"?st:{};
  const defaults={
    engine:"", variants:[], activeVariant:null, directQueue:[], levels:[], currentLevelId:null,
    qualitySelection:(settings.stream&&settings.stream.quality)||"auto", availableServers:[], availabilityPromise:null,
    availabilityChecked:false, currentServerOptionId:"", triedUrls:new Set(), fsState:null,
    playback:{paused:true,buffering:true,currentTime:0,duration:0,buffered:0,volume:Number(settings.stream&&settings.stream.volume!=null?settings.stream.volume:.9),muted:!!(settings.stream&&settings.stream.muted),rate:Number(settings.stream&&settings.stream.rate||1)},
    lastProgressSave:0, chromeTimer:null, switching:false, healthRecorded:false, mountedAt:0, frameLoadedAt:0, playbackSignalAt:0, playbackConfirmed:false, embedNoticeShown:false, prime:null,
  };
  for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(defaults)) if(target[key]===undefined) target[key]=value;
  return target;
}
function formatTime(sec){
  sec=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(sec)||0));
  const h=Math.floor(sec/3600), m=Math.floor(sec%3600/60), s=sec%60;
  return h?h+":"+String(m).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(s).padStart(2,"0"):m+":"+String(s).padStart(2,"0");
}
function normalizeQualityLabel(q){
  const s=String(q||"").toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g,"");
  if(!s||s==="AUTO") return "auto";
  if(/2160|4K|UHD/.test(s)) return "2160p";
  if(/1440/.test(s)) return "1440p";
  if(/1080|FHD/.test(s)) return "1080p";
  if(/720|\bHD\b/.test(s)) return "720p";
  if(/480/.test(s)) return "480p";
  if(/360/.test(s)) return "360p";
  const m=s.match(/(\d{3,4})P?/); return m?m[1]+"p":"source";
}
function qualityHeight(q){ const n=parseInt(normalizeQualityLabel(q),10); return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0; }
function parseQualityFromText(text){
  const m=String(text||"").match(/(2160p|1440p|1080p|720p|480p|360p|4k|uhd|fhd|hd)/i);
  return m?normalizeQualityLabel(m[1]):"source";
}
function normalizeVariant(v,fallback){
  if(!v) return null;
  const url=typeof v==="string"?v:(v.url||v.playUrl||"");
  if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) return null;
  const base=typeof v==="object"?Object.assign({},v):{};
  base.url=url;
  base.quality=normalizeQualityLabel(base.quality||parseQualityFromText([base.label,base.name,base.sub,url].join(" ")));
  base.label=base.label||base.name||fallback||"Direct stream";
  base.addonName=base.addonName||base.serverName||fallback||"Direct server";
  return base;
}
function sortVariantsForQuality(variants,quality){
  const pref=normalizeQualityLabel(quality||settings.stream.quality||"auto");
  const prefH=pref==="auto"?2160:qualityHeight(pref);
  const unique=new Map();
  for(const raw of (variants||[])){ const v=normalizeVariant(raw); if(v&&!unique.has(v.url)) unique.set(v.url,v); }
  return [...unique.values()].sort((a,b)=>{
    const ah=qualityHeight(a.quality), bh=qualityHeight(b.quality);
    const aPenalty=ah>prefH?(ah-prefH)/100+20:(prefH-ah)/1000;
    const bPenalty=bh>prefH?(bh-prefH)/100+20:(prefH-bh)/1000;
    return aPenalty-bPenalty||(Number(b.seeders)||0)-(Number(a.seeders)||0)||(Number(a.bytes)||0)-(Number(b.bytes)||0);
  });
}
function chooseVariantForQuality(variants,quality,currentUrl){
  const list=sortVariantsForQuality(variants,quality);
  if(!list.length) return null;
  const pref=normalizeQualityLabel(quality||"auto");
  if(pref!=="auto"){
    const exact=list.find(v=>normalizeQualityLabel(v.quality)===pref);
    if(exact&&exact.url!==currentUrl) return exact;
  }
  return list.find(v=>v.url!==currentUrl)||list[0];
}
function variantQualityOptions(variants){
  const seen=new Map();
  (variants||[]).forEach(v=>{ const n=normalizeVariant(v); if(n){ const q=normalizeQualityLabel(n.quality); if(!seen.has(q)) seen.set(q,n); } });
  return [...seen.entries()].sort((a,b)=>qualityHeight(b[0])-qualityHeight(a[0])).map(([q,v])=>({value:q,label:q==="source"?"Source quality":q.replace("2160p","4K 2160p"),variant:v}));
}
function qualityOptionsHTML(st){
  st=st||playerState||{};
  const selected=String(st.qualitySelection||settings.stream.quality||"auto");
  if(st.engine==="faststream-api"&&Array.isArray(st.levels)&&st.levels.length){
    const levels=st.levels.slice().sort((a,b)=>(Number(b.height)||0)-(Number(a.height)||0)||(Number(b.bitrate)||0)-(Number(a.bitrate)||0));
    return '<option value="auto"'+(selected==="auto"?" selected":"")+'>Auto · FastStream</option>'+levels.map(l=>{
      const label=(l.height?l.height+"p":(l.label||"Level"))+(l.bitrate?" · "+Math.max(.1,Number(l.bitrate)/1000000).toFixed(1)+" Mb/s":"");
      const value="level:"+String(l.id);
      return '<option value="'+esc(value)+'"'+(selected===value?" selected":"")+">"+esc(label)+"</option>";
    }).join("");
  }
  const variants=variantQualityOptions(st.variants||[]);
  if(variants.length){
    return '<option value="auto"'+(selected==="auto"?" selected":"")+'>Auto · best server stream</option>'+variants.map(v=>'<option value="'+esc(v.value)+'"'+(selected===v.value?" selected":"")+">"+esc(v.label)+"</option>").join("");
  }
  if(st.engine==="embed"||st.engine==="faststream-legacy"){
    return [["auto","Quality · player decides"],["2160p","Prefer 4K"],["1080p","Prefer 1080p"],["720p","Prefer 720p"],["480p","Prefer 480p"]].map(([v,t])=>'<option value="'+v+'"'+(selected===v?" selected":"")+">"+t+"</option>").join("");
  }
  return '<option value="auto" selected>Auto quality</option>';
}
function playerLoading(on,text){
  const el=document.getElementById("playerLoading"); if(!el) return;
  if(text){ const t=el.querySelector("[data-loading-text]"); if(t) t.textContent=text; }
  el.classList.toggle("hide",!on);
}
function hidePlayerChrome(){
  const st=playerState, overlay=document.getElementById("playerOverlay"); if(!st||!overlay) return;
  st.chromeUserHidden=true; if(st.chromeTimer) clearTimeout(st.chromeTimer);
  overlay.classList.add("chrome-hidden"); overlay.classList.remove("player-tools-awake");
}
function showPlayerChrome(sticky,force){
  const st=playerState, overlay=document.getElementById("playerOverlay"); if(!st||!overlay||st.chromeUserHidden&&!force) return;
  st.chromeUserHidden=false; overlay.classList.remove("chrome-hidden");
  const paused=!!(st.playback&&st.playback.paused);
  overlay.classList.toggle("player-paused",paused);
  overlay.classList.add("player-tools-awake");
  if(st.chromeTimer) clearTimeout(st.chromeTimer);
  const playingNow=!!(st.playback&&!st.playback.paused&&!st.playback.buffering);
  // On TV the remote focus always sits on a chrome control, so a sticky
  // bar would cover the movie forever. While playing, always schedule
  // the hide; any key press wakes the bar again.
  if(sticky&&!(ANDROID_TV_APP&&playingNow)) return;
  st.chromeTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    if(playerState!==st) return;
    if(!(st.playback&&!st.playback.paused&&!st.playback.buffering)) return;
    const active=document.activeElement;
    if(active&&active.tagName==="SELECT"){ showPlayerChrome(true); return; }
    if(active&&active.closest&&active.closest(".player-bar,.player-controls")&&!st.embedFocused){
      // Park focus on the stage so focusin does not instantly re-show
      // the bar and the next key lands on the wake-up handler.
      const stage=document.getElementById("playerStage");
      if(stage){ stage.setAttribute("tabindex","-1"); stage.focus({preventScroll:true}); }
    }
    overlay.classList.add("chrome-hidden");
    overlay.classList.remove("player-tools-awake");
  },3000);
}
function setPlayerControlMode(mode){
  const st=playerState; if(st) st.engine=mode||st.engine;
  const controls=document.getElementById("playerControls"); if(controls) controls.dataset.mode=mode||"";
  const full=mode==="native"||mode==="faststream-api";
  const limited=mode==="embed"||mode==="faststream-legacy";
  ["btnPlayPause","btnBack10","btnForward10","btnMute","btnPiP"].forEach(id=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.disabled=!full; });
  ["seekRange","volumeRange","playerRate"].forEach(id=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.disabled=!full; });
  const seek=document.querySelector(".seek-row"); if(seek) seek.style.display=limited?"none":"flex";
  const focusBtn=document.getElementById("btnFocusEmbed"); if(focusBtn) focusBtn.style.display=limited?"inline-flex":"none";
  const centerPlay=document.getElementById("btnCenterPlay"); if(centerPlay){ centerPlay.hidden=limited; centerPlay.disabled=limited; }
  const engine=document.getElementById("playerEngine");
  if(engine) engine.textContent=mode==="faststream-api"?"FastStream integrated":mode==="faststream-legacy"?"FastStream player":mode==="native"?"ZeroPlay player":mode==="embed"?"Embedded player":"Connecting";
  refreshPlayerQualityOptions();
  if(limited){
    // Embedded players have their own controls. Keep ZeroPlay chrome out of
    // their way by default; the small edge restore button can bring it back.
    if(ANDROID_TV_APP) setTimeout(()=>{ if(playerState===st) st.chromeUserHidden=false; playerCommand("focusEmbed"); },40);
    hidePlayerChrome();
  }else{
    showPlayerChrome(true);
    if(full&&ANDROID_TV_APP){ const active=document.activeElement; if(!active||!active.closest||!active.closest("#playerRoot")){ const play=document.getElementById("btnPlayPause"); if(play) setTimeout(()=>play.focus({preventScroll:true}),30); } }
  }
}
function refreshPlayerQualityOptions(){
  const sel=document.getElementById("playerQuality"); if(!sel||!playerState) return;
  const was=document.activeElement===sel;
  sel.innerHTML=qualityOptionsHTML(playerState);
  const mode=playerState.engine;
  sel.disabled=(mode==="loading"||mode==="faststream-connecting"||!(mode==="faststream-api"||mode==="embed"||mode==="faststream-legacy"||(playerState.variants||[]).length>1));
  sel.title=mode==="faststream-api"?"FastStream quality level":(playerState.variants||[]).length?"Choose a real returned stream quality":"Quality preference. This player chooses the actual in-player quality.";
  if(was) sel.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function savePlaybackProgress(force){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer||st.noProgress||!st.item||!st.item.id) return;
  const now=Date.now(); if(!force&&now-(st.lastProgressSave||0)<5000) return;
  const pb=st.playback||{}; if(!(pb.duration>0)||!(pb.currentTime>5)) return;
  st.lastProgressSave=now;
  const k=keyOf(st.item.type,st.item.id), p=progress[k]||(progress[k]=Object.assign({},snap(st.item,st.item.type),{season:st.season,episode:st.episode}));
  p.position=Math.floor(pb.currentTime); p.timestamp=Math.floor(pb.currentTime); p.duration=Math.floor(pb.duration); p.percent=Math.min(100,Math.round(pb.currentTime/pb.duration*100)); p.updatedAt=now;
  saveProgress();
}
function updatePlaybackUI(state,eventName){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer||!state) return;
  const prev=st.playback||{};
  st.playback=Object.assign({},prev,state);
  if(Number(st.playback.currentTime)>0&&Number(st.playback.currentTime)>(Number(st.lastTs)||0)+.2){ st.lastTs=Number(st.playback.currentTime); st.lastAdvanceAt=Date.now(); st.playbackConfirmed=true; }
  const play=document.getElementById("btnPlayPause"); if(play) play.textContent=st.playback.paused?"▶":"❚❚";
  const center=document.getElementById("btnCenterPlay"); if(center){ const embedControls=st.engine==="embed"||st.engine==="faststream-legacy"; center.hidden=embedControls||!st.playback.paused||st.playback.buffering; center.disabled=embedControls; center.textContent="▶"; }
  const seek=document.getElementById("seekRange");
  if(seek&&document.activeElement!==seek&&st.playback.duration>0){ seek.max=String(Math.floor(st.playback.duration)); seek.value=String(Math.floor(st.playback.currentTime||0)); }
  const cur=document.getElementById("currentTime"); if(cur) cur.textContent=formatTime(st.playback.currentTime);
  const dur=document.getElementById("durationTime"); if(dur) dur.textContent=formatTime(st.playback.duration);
  const vol=document.getElementById("volumeRange"); if(vol&&document.activeElement!==vol) vol.value=String(Math.round((st.playback.volume==null?1:st.playback.volume)*100));
  const mute=document.getElementById("btnMute"); if(mute) mute.textContent=st.playback.muted||st.playback.volume===0?"🔇":"🔊";
  const rate=document.getElementById("playerRate"); if(rate&&st.playback.rate) rate.value=String(st.playback.rate);
  if(st.playback.buffering) playerLoading(true,"Buffering…");
  else if(eventName==="playing"||eventName==="canplay"||!st.playback.paused) playerLoading(false);
  savePlaybackProgress(false);
  const overlay=document.getElementById("playerOverlay");
  if(overlay){ overlay.classList.toggle("player-paused",!!st.playback.paused); if(st.playback.paused) overlay.classList.add("player-tools-awake"); else if(eventName==="playing") overlay.classList.remove("player-tools-awake"); }
  if(st.playback.paused) showPlayerChrome(true); else if(eventName==="playing") showPlayerChrome(false);
}
function currentPlaybackTime(){
  const st=playerState; if(!st) return 0;
  const v=document.getElementById("pv"); if(v&&Number.isFinite(v.currentTime)) return v.currentTime;
  return Number((st.playback||{}).currentTime)||0;
}
function handlePlaybackEnded(){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer) return;
  savePlaybackProgress(true); showPlayerChrome(true);
  if(st.item&&st.item.type==="tv"&&!st.noProgress&&!st.tempSource&&(!settings.ui||settings.ui.autoplayNext!==false)){
    toast("Episode finished — starting the next episode");
    playerTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{ if(playerState!==st) return; st.episode++; st.directUrl=""; st.variants=[]; st.activeVariant=null; st.tried=new Set(); st.triedUrls=new Set(); registerProgress(st.item,st.season,st.episode); drawPlayer({}); },1200));
  }
}
async function playerCommand(action,value){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer) return;
  showPlayerChrome(true);
  const v=document.getElementById("pv");
  try{
    if(action==="fullscreen"){ await togglePlayerFullscreen(); return; }
    if(st.engine==="native"&&v){
      if(action==="toggle") { if(v.paused) await v.play(); else v.pause(); }
      else if(action==="seek") v.currentTime=Math.max(0,Math.min(v.duration||Infinity,Number(value)||0));
      else if(action==="seekDelta") v.currentTime=Math.max(0,Math.min(v.duration||Infinity,v.currentTime+(Number(value)||0)));
      else if(action==="volume"){ v.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(value))); v.muted=v.volume===0; }
      else if(action==="mute") v.muted=!v.muted;
      else if(action==="rate") v.playbackRate=Number(value)||1;
      else if(action==="pip") { if(document.pictureInPictureElement) await document.exitPictureInPicture(); else await v.requestPictureInPicture(); }
      return;
    }
    if(st.engine==="faststream-api"){
      if(action==="toggle") await fsCommand("togglePlay");
      else if(action==="seek") await fsCommand("seek",{time:Number(value)||0});
      else if(action==="seekDelta") await fsCommand("seek",{delta:Number(value)||0});
      else if(action==="volume") await fsCommand("setVolume",{volume:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(value)))});
      else if(action==="mute") await fsCommand("setMuted",{muted:!(st.playback&&st.playback.muted)});
      else if(action==="rate") await fsCommand("setPlaybackRate",{rate:Number(value)||1});
      else if(action==="pip") await fsCommand("setPictureInPicture",{pictureInPicture:!(st.fsState&&st.fsState.pictureInPicture)});
      const fresh=await fsCommand("getState",{},5000).catch(()=>null); if(fresh) updatePlaybackUI(normalizeFastStreamState(fresh));
      return;
    }
    if(action==="focusEmbed"){ const f=document.getElementById("playerFrame")||document.getElementById("fsFrame"); if(f){ playerState.embedFocused=true; const ov=document.getElementById("playerOverlay"); if(ov) ov.classList.add("chrome-hidden"); f.focus(); toast("Video controls focused. Press Back once to return to the ZeroPlay bar."); } }
  }catch(err){ toast("Player control failed: "+(err&&err.message||err),"error"); }
}
async function togglePlayerFullscreen(){
  const overlay=document.getElementById("playerOverlay");
  if(document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen();
  else if(overlay&&overlay.requestFullscreen) await overlay.requestFullscreen();
}
async function setPlayerQuality(value){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer) return;
  st.qualitySelection=String(value||"auto");
  if(!String(value).startsWith("level:")){ settings.stream.quality=normalizeQualityLabel(value)==="source"?"auto":normalizeQualityLabel(value); applyQualityPreset(settings.stream.quality); saveSettings(); }
  if(st.engine==="faststream-api"){
    try{
      playerLoading(true,"Switching FastStream quality…");
      if(String(value).startsWith("level:")) await fsCommand("setVideoLevel",{id:String(value).slice(6)});
      else if(value==="auto"){
        const state=await fsCommand("getState",{},5000).catch(()=>st.fsState||{});
        await fsCommand("load",{url:st.url,autoPlay:true,time:Number(state.currentTime)||currentPlaybackTime()});
      }else await applyPreferredFastStreamLevel(value,true);
      playerLoading(false); toast("Quality set to "+(value==="auto"?"Auto":value.replace("level:","")),"success");
    }catch(e){ playerLoading(false); toast("FastStream could not switch quality: "+(e.message||e),"error"); }
    return;
  }
  if((st.variants||[]).length){
    const next=chooseVariantForQuality(st.variants,value,st.url);
    if(next&&next.url!==st.url){ await switchDirectVariant(next,{reason:"quality"}); return; }
  }
  if(st.engine==="embed"||st.engine==="faststream-legacy") toast("Saved as your quality preference. This embedded player controls its actual playback quality internally.");
  updatePlayerMeta();
}
async function switchDirectVariant(variant,opts){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||!variant) return;
  opts=opts||{};
  const next=normalizeVariant(variant); if(!next) return;
  const at=opts.keepTime===false?0:currentPlaybackTime();
  st.activeVariant=next; st.directUrl=next.url; st.url=next.url; st.fileBytes=next.bytes||st.fileBytes||null; st.healthRecorded=false;
  if(!st.variants||!st.variants.some(v=>v.url===next.url)) st.variants=[next].concat(st.variants||[]);
  const stage=document.getElementById("playerStage");
  const source=st.tempSource||getSource(st.source)||{id:"direct",name:next.addonName||"Direct server"};
  playerLoading(true,opts.reason==="quality"?"Switching quality…":"Trying another stream…");
  if(st.engine==="faststream-api"&&fsBridge.ready&&stage){
    try{
      await fsCommand("load",{url:next.url,autoPlay:true,time:at>5?at:0},12000);
      setTimeout(()=>refreshFastStreamLevels(true),300);
      updatePlayerMeta(source);
      return;
    }catch{}
  }
  if(st.engine==="native"&&stage&&nativeCanPlayDirect(next.url)){
    mountNativeVideo(stage,next.url,source,performance.now(),at);
    updatePlayerMeta(source);
    return;
  }
  if(st.engine==="faststream-legacy"&&stage){
    await mountFastStreamPlayer(stage,next.url,source,performance.now(),at,{allowApi:false});
    updatePlayerMeta(source);
    return;
  }
  await mountDirectVideo(stage,next.url,source,performance.now(),at);
  updatePlayerMeta(source);
}
async function tryNextDirectVariant(reason){
  const st=playerState; if(!st) return false;
  if(streamCfg().autoFailover===false) return false;
  st.triedUrls=st.triedUrls||new Set(); if(st.url) st.triedUrls.add(st.url);
  const next=(st.variants||[]).map(v=>normalizeVariant(v)).find(v=>v&&!st.triedUrls.has(v.url))||(st.directQueue||[]).map(v=>normalizeVariant(v)).find(v=>v&&!st.triedUrls.has(v.url));
  if(!next) return false;
  toast((reason||"Stream failed")+" — trying "+(next.quality||"another stream"),"error");
  await switchDirectVariant(next,{reason:"fallback"});
  return true;
}
const FASTSTREAM_ORIGIN="https://faststream.online";
let fastStreamApiStatus=(()=>{ try{ return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("zp_faststream_api_v1")||"null")||{state:"unknown",checkedAt:0}; }catch{ return {state:"unknown",checkedAt:0}; } })();
let fastStreamProbeStarted=false,fastStreamProbeCleanup=null;
function effectiveFastStreamApiStatus(){ return Date.now()-Number(fastStreamApiStatus.checkedAt||0)<6*60*60*1000?String(fastStreamApiStatus.state||"unknown"):"unknown"; }
function setFastStreamApiStatus(state){ fastStreamApiStatus={state,checkedAt:Date.now()}; try{ sessionStorage.setItem("zp_faststream_api_v1",JSON.stringify(fastStreamApiStatus)); }catch{} }
function probeFastStreamApiInBackground(){
  if(streamCfg().fastStreamApiProbe===false||fastStreamProbeStarted||effectiveFastStreamApiStatus()!=="unknown"||effectiveSaver()||document.hidden) return;
  fastStreamProbeStarted=true;
  const frame=document.createElement("iframe");
  frame.hidden=true; frame.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true"); frame.title="FastStream API capability check";
  const cleanup=()=>{ window.removeEventListener("message",onMessage); frame.remove(); if(fastStreamProbeCleanup===cancelProbe) fastStreamProbeCleanup=null; };
  const timer=setTimeout(()=>{ setFastStreamApiStatus("unavailable"); cleanup(); },6500);
  const cancelProbe=()=>{ clearTimeout(timer); cleanup(); fastStreamProbeStarted=false; };
  fastStreamProbeCleanup=cancelProbe;
  function onMessage(e){
    if(e.origin!==FASTSTREAM_ORIGIN||e.source!==frame.contentWindow) return;
    if(e.data&&e.data.type==="faststream:event"&&e.data.event==="ready"){ clearTimeout(timer); setFastStreamApiStatus("available"); cleanup(); }
  }
  window.addEventListener("message",onMessage);
  frame.src="https://faststream.online/player/";
  document.body.appendChild(frame);
}
let fsBridge={frame:null,ready:false,pending:new Map(),seq:0,waiters:[],lastState:null};
function resetFastStreamBridge(frame){
  for(const p of fsBridge.pending.values()){ clearTimeout(p.timer); p.reject(new Error("FastStream player changed")); }
  fsBridge={frame:frame||null,ready:false,pending:new Map(),seq:0,waiters:[],lastState:null};
}
function normalizeFastStreamState(state){
  state=state||{};
  let buffered=0;
  if(Array.isArray(state.buffered)){ for(const r of state.buffered){ if(r&&Number(r.start)<=Number(state.currentTime||0)&&Number(r.end)>=Number(state.currentTime||0)) buffered=Math.max(buffered,Number(r.end)-Number(state.currentTime||0)); } }
  return {paused:state.paused!==false,buffering:!!state.buffering,currentTime:Number(state.currentTime)||0,duration:Number(state.duration)||0,buffered,volume:Number(state.volume==null?1:state.volume),muted:!!state.muted,rate:Number(state.playbackRate||state.rate||1),videoWidth:Number(state.videoWidth)||0,videoHeight:Number(state.videoHeight)||0,currentVideoLevelID:state.videoLevel||state.currentVideoLevelID||null,currentAudioLevelID:state.audioLevel||state.currentAudioLevelID||null,fullscreen:!!state.fullscreen,pictureInPicture:!!state.pictureInPicture};
}
function fsCommand(command,args,timeoutMs){
  const frame=fsBridge.frame;
  if(!frame||!frame.contentWindow) return Promise.reject(new Error("FastStream is not loaded"));
  const id="zp-"+(++fsBridge.seq)+"-"+Date.now().toString(36);
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const timer=setTimeout(()=>{ fsBridge.pending.delete(id); reject(new Error("FastStream "+command+" timed out")); },timeoutMs||9000);
    fsBridge.pending.set(id,{resolve,reject,timer});
    frame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:"faststream:command",id,command,args:args||{}},FASTSTREAM_ORIGIN);
  });
}
function waitForFastStreamReady(timeoutMs){
  if(fsBridge.ready) return Promise.resolve(true);
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const waiter={resolve}; fsBridge.waiters.push(waiter);
    setTimeout(()=>{ const i=fsBridge.waiters.indexOf(waiter); if(i>=0) fsBridge.waiters.splice(i,1); resolve(false); },timeoutMs||4500);
  });
}
let fsLevelsTimer=null;
async function refreshFastStreamLevels(applyPref){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.engine!=="faststream-api") return;
  try{
    const levels=await fsCommand("getLevels",{},7000);
    const raw=levels&&(levels.video||levels.videoLevels||levels.levels)||[];
    st.levels=(Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[]).map(l=>({id:String(l.id||l.levelId||""),label:String(l.label||""),width:Number(l.width)||0,height:Number(l.height)||0,bitrate:Number(l.bitrate||l.bandwidth)||0})).filter(l=>l.id);
    st.currentLevelId=(levels&&(levels.currentVideo||levels.currentVideoLevelID))||st.currentLevelId||null;
    refreshPlayerQualityOptions();
    if(applyPref) await applyPreferredFastStreamLevel(settings.stream.quality,false);
  }catch{}
}
async function applyPreferredFastStreamLevel(quality,announce){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||!st.levels||!st.levels.length) return;
  const pref=normalizeQualityLabel(quality||"auto");
  const sorted=st.levels.slice().sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.height)||0)-(Number(b.height)||0)||(Number(a.bitrate)||0)-(Number(b.bitrate)||0));
  if(pref==="auto"){
    // Start high, then step down only if buffering proves the connection
    // cannot sustain it (handled in the faststream event listener).
    // FastStream's own auto starts low and can sit there indefinitely.
    const top=sorted[sorted.length-1]; if(!top) return;
    if(st.autoHighLevelId!==top.id){ await fsCommand("setVideoLevel",{id:top.id}); st.autoHighLevelId=top.id; st.autoHighBufferingSince=0; }
    return;
  }
  const prefH=qualityHeight(pref);
  const level=sorted.filter(l=>(Number(l.height)||0)<=prefH).pop()||sorted[0];
  if(level){ st.autoHighLevelId=""; await fsCommand("setVideoLevel",{id:level.id}); st.qualitySelection="level:"+level.id; refreshPlayerQualityOptions(); if(announce) toast("Quality set to "+(level.height?level.height+"p":pref)); }
}
window.addEventListener("message",e=>{
  if(e.origin!==FASTSTREAM_ORIGIN||!fsBridge.frame||e.source!==fsBridge.frame.contentWindow) return;
  const data=e.data||{};
  if(data.type==="faststream:response"&&data.id){
    const p=fsBridge.pending.get(data.id); if(!p) return;
    fsBridge.pending.delete(data.id); clearTimeout(p.timer);
    if(data.ok) p.resolve(data.result); else p.reject(new Error(data.error||"FastStream command failed"));
    return;
  }
  if(data.type!=="faststream:event") return;
  const state=normalizeFastStreamState(data.state||{});
  fsBridge.lastState=state;
  if(playerState) playerState.fsState=state;
  if(data.event==="ready"){
    fsBridge.ready=true;
    const waiters=fsBridge.waiters.splice(0); waiters.forEach(w=>w.resolve(true));
  }
  if(!playerState||playerState.trailer) return;
  if(playerState.engine==="faststream-api"||playerState.engine==="faststream-connecting"){
    updatePlaybackUI(state,data.event);
    if(playerState.autoHighLevelId&&(!playerState.qualitySelection||playerState.qualitySelection==="auto")){
      if(playerState.playback&&playerState.playback.buffering&&!playerState.playback.paused){ playerState.autoHighBufferingSince=playerState.autoHighBufferingSince||Date.now(); }
      else playerState.autoHighBufferingSince=0;
      if(playerState.autoHighBufferingSince&&Date.now()-playerState.autoHighBufferingSince>7000){
        playerState.autoHighBufferingSince=0;
        const sortedLevels=(playerState.levels||[]).slice().sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.height)||0)-(Number(b.height)||0)||(Number(a.bitrate)||0)-(Number(b.bitrate)||0));
        const lvlIdx=sortedLevels.findIndex(l=>String(l.id)===String(playerState.autoHighLevelId));
        if(lvlIdx>0){ const lower=sortedLevels[lvlIdx-1]; playerState.autoHighLevelId=lower.id; fsCommand("setVideoLevel",{id:lower.id}).catch(()=>{}); }
      }
    }
    if(data.event==="manifestparsed"||data.event==="sourcechange"||data.event==="loadedmetadata"){
      clearTimeout(fsLevelsTimer); fsLevelsTimer=setTimeout(()=>refreshFastStreamLevels(true),180);
    }
    if(data.event==="playing"&&!playerState.healthRecorded){ playerState.healthRecorded=true; const src=playerState.tempSource||getSource(playerState.source); if(src) recordHealth(src.id,true); updatePlayerMeta(); }
    if(data.event==="ended") handlePlaybackEnded();
    if(data.event==="error"){ playerLoading(true,"FastStream reported an error…"); tryNextDirectVariant("FastStream stream error").then(ok=>{ if(!ok) toast("FastStream could not play this stream","error"); }); }
  }
});
function registerProgress(item,season,episode){
  const k=keyOf(item.type,item.id), prev=progress[k]||{};
  progress[k]=Object.assign({},prev,snap(item,item.type),{season:season==null?prev.season:season,episode:episode==null?prev.episode:episode,updatedAt:Date.now()});
  saveProgress();
}
async function openPlayer(item,pos){

  stopCardPreview();

    source:pos.source||defaultSourceId(), tempSource:null, trailer:null, directUrl:"", directQueue:[],
    tried:new Set(), url:"", direct:false, fileBytes:null, lastTs:-1, lastAdvanceAt:0, stalls:0});
  registerProgress(item,playerState.season,playerState.episode);
  await drawPlayer(prev);
}

function openM3uExtractorForContext(ctx,url){

    const input=document.getElementById("m3uUrl"), title=document.getElementById("m3uTitle");
