function playerShell(msg){
  const st=withPlayerRuntime(playerState); playerState=st;
  const it=st.item, isTV=it.type==="tv";
  const rate=Number(st.playback&&st.playback.rate||1);
  return '<div class="player-overlay" id="playerOverlay">'
    +'<div class="player-stage" id="playerStage"><div class="player-loading" id="playerLoading"><div class="big-spinner"></div><strong data-loading-text>'+esc(msg||"Connecting…")+'</strong><span style="color:#cbd2d8;font-size:.88rem">ZeroPlay is preparing this exact title.</span></div></div>'
    +'<button class="player-chrome-restore" id="btnRestorePlayerChrome" type="button" aria-label="Show ZeroPlay controls" title="Show ZeroPlay controls">☰</button>'
    +'<div class="player-bar"><button class="icon-btn" id="btnBackPlayer" type="button" aria-label="Back">‹</button><span class="logo-badge"><span class="logo-mark">▶</span><span>ZeroPlay</span></span>'
    +'<span class="pt">'+esc(titleOf(it))+'<span class="player-title-sub" id="playerSourceLine">'+(isTV?"Season "+st.season+" · Episode "+st.episode:"Movie")+'</span></span><span id="fastBadge" class="chip violet"></span><span style="flex:1"></span>'
    +(isTV?'<button class="control-btn" id="btnPrevEp" type="button">‹ Ep</button><button class="control-btn" id="btnNextEp" type="button">Ep ›</button>':"")
    +'<button class="control-btn" id="btnPlayerServers" type="button">Servers</button>'+(downloadsEnabled()?'<button class="control-btn" id="btnPlayerDownload" type="button" aria-label="Download this title or episode">⬇</button>':"")+'<button class="control-btn" id="btnPlayerDetails" type="button">Details</button><button class="control-btn" id="btnPlayerFastStream" type="button">FastStream controls</button><button class="control-btn" id="btnPlayerM3u" type="button">M3U tools</button><button class="control-btn player-hide-btn" id="btnHidePlayerChrome" type="button" aria-label="Hide ZeroPlay controls" title="Hide ZeroPlay controls">Hide controls</button><button class="control-btn" id="btnClosePlayer" type="button" aria-label="Close player">×</button></div>'
    +'<button class="center-play" id="btnCenterPlay" type="button" aria-label="Play" hidden>▶</button>'
    +'<div class="player-controls" id="playerControls" data-mode="loading">'
    +'<div class="seek-row"><span id="currentTime">0:00</span><input id="seekRange" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" step="1" aria-label="Seek"><span id="durationTime">0:00</span></div>'
    +'<div class="control-row"><button class="control-btn primary" id="btnPlayPause" type="button" aria-label="Play or pause">▶</button>'
    +'<button class="control-btn" id="btnBack10" type="button" aria-label="Back 10 seconds">−10</button><button class="control-btn" id="btnForward10" type="button" aria-label="Forward 10 seconds">+10</button>'
    +'<span class="volume-wrap"><button class="control-btn" id="btnMute" type="button" aria-label="Mute or unmute">🔊</button><input id="volumeRange" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="'+Math.round((st.playback.volume==null?.9:st.playback.volume)*100)+'" aria-label="Volume"></span>'
    +'<span class="player-status" id="playerMeta">Connecting…</span><span style="flex:1"></span><span class="chip" id="playerEngine">Connecting</span>'
    +'<select class="control-select" id="playerQuality" aria-label="Playback quality">'+qualityOptionsHTML(st)+'</select>'
    +'<select class="control-select" id="playerRate" aria-label="Playback speed">'+[.5,.75,1,1.25,1.5,2].map(r=>'<option value="'+r+'"'+(rate===r?" selected":"")+">"+r+'×</option>').join("")+'</select>'
    +'<button class="control-btn" id="btnFocusEmbed" type="button" style="display:none">Video controls</button>'
    +'<button class="control-btn" id="btnPiP" type="button" aria-label="Picture in picture">PiP</button><button class="control-btn" id="btnFullscreen" type="button" aria-label="Fullscreen">⛶</button>'
    +'</div></div></div>';
}
function bindPlayerChrome(){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer) return;
  const on=(id,ev,fn)=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.addEventListener(ev,fn); };
  on("btnClosePlayer","click",closePlayer);
  on("btnBackPlayer","click",closePlayer);
  on("btnPlayerDetails","click",()=>{ const it2=st.item; closePlayer(); if(it2&&it2.id) openDetail(it2.type,it2.id); });
  on("btnPlayerServers","click",()=>{
    const identity=st.identity||buildTitleIdentity({item:st.item,type:st.item.type,id:st.item.id,title:titleOf(st.item),season:st.season,episode:st.episode});
    showStreamsModal({type:st.item.type,id:st.item.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:st.season,episode:st.episode,imdb:identity.imdbId,identity,item:snap(st.item,st.item.type),fromPlayer:true});
  });
  const downloadOpts=()=>({currentVariant:st.activeVariant||(st.directUrl?{url:st.directUrl,quality:(st.activeVariant||{}).quality}:null),currentUrl:st.directUrl||(st.direct?st.url:""),serverName:(getSource(st.source)||{}).name||"Current server"});
  const openDownload=()=>openDownloadForContext(playerContext(st),downloadOpts());
  on("btnPlayerDownload","click",openDownload);
  on("btnHidePlayerChrome","click",hidePlayerChrome);
  on("btnPlayerFastStream","click",()=>{ showPlayerChrome(true,true); if(st.engine==="faststream-api"||st.engine==="faststream-legacy"){ playerCommand("focusEmbed"); } else toast("ZeroPlay controls are active for this stream"); });
  on("btnPlayerM3u","click",()=>openM3uExtractorForContext(playerContext(st),st.directUrl||(st.direct?st.url:"")));
  on("btnRestorePlayerChrome","click",()=>showPlayerChrome(true,true));

  const changeEpisode=delta=>{
    if(delta<0&&st.episode<=1) return;
    savePlaybackProgress(true);
    st.episode+=delta; st.directUrl=""; st.variants=[]; st.activeVariant=null; st.levels=[]; st.tried=new Set(); st.triedUrls=new Set(); st.availableServers=[]; st.availabilityChecked=false;
    registerProgress(st.item,st.season,st.episode); drawPlayer({});
  };
  on("btnPrevEp","click",()=>changeEpisode(-1));
  on("btnNextEp","click",()=>changeEpisode(1));
  on("btnPlayPause","click",()=>playerCommand("toggle"));
  on("btnCenterPlay","click",()=>playerCommand("toggle"));
  on("btnBack10","click",()=>playerCommand("seekDelta",-10));
  on("btnForward10","click",()=>playerCommand("seekDelta",10));
  on("btnMute","click",()=>playerCommand("mute"));
  on("btnPiP","click",()=>playerCommand("pip"));
  on("btnFullscreen","click",()=>playerCommand("fullscreen"));
  on("btnFocusEmbed","click",()=>playerCommand("focusEmbed"));
  on("seekRange","input",e=>{ const cur=document.getElementById("currentTime"); if(cur) cur.textContent=formatTime(Number(e.target.value)); showPlayerChrome(true); });
  on("seekRange","change",e=>playerCommand("seek",Number(e.target.value)));
  on("volumeRange","input",e=>{ settings.stream.volume=Number(e.target.value)/100; saveSettings(); playerCommand("volume",settings.stream.volume); });
  on("playerRate","change",e=>{ settings.stream.rate=Number(e.target.value)||1; saveSettings(); playerCommand("rate",settings.stream.rate); });
  on("playerQuality","change",e=>setPlayerQuality(e.target.value));
  const overlay=document.getElementById("playerOverlay");
  if(overlay){
    // Pointer movement/taps are not an opt-in to restore ZeroPlay chrome.
    // The explicit restore button or keyboard wake command handles that.
    overlay.addEventListener("mousemove",()=>showPlayerChrome(false));
    overlay.addEventListener("touchstart",()=>showPlayerChrome(false),{passive:true});
    overlay.addEventListener("focusin",()=>showPlayerChrome(false));
    overlay.addEventListener("focusout",()=>showPlayerChrome(false));
  }
  setPlayerControlMode(st.engine||"loading");
  if(ANDROID_TV_APP||document.body.classList.contains("tv-mode")){ const first=document.getElementById("btnPlayerServers")||document.getElementById("btnClosePlayer"); if(first) setTimeout(()=>first.focus({preventScroll:true}),40); }
}
function playerContext(st){
  st=st||playerState;
  const it=st.item, identity=st.identity||buildTitleIdentity({item:it,type:it.type,id:it.id,title:titleOf(it),year:it.year||yearOf(it),season:st.season,episode:st.episode,imdb:it.imdb_id||""});
  return {type:it.type,id:it.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:st.season,episode:st.episode,imdb:identity.imdbId,identity,item:snap(it,it.type)};
}
function updatePlayerMeta(source){
  const m=$("#playerMeta"); if(!m||!playerState) return;
  const st=playerState, src=source||(st.tempSource||getSource(st.source));
  const parts=[];
  if(src) parts.push(esc(src.name));
  if(st.activeVariant&&st.activeVariant.quality) parts.push(esc(String(st.activeVariant.quality).replace("2160p","4K")));
  if(st.direct&&st.fileBytes) parts.push(fmtBytes(st.fileBytes));
  parts.push("Cap "+capGb()+" GB");
  if(st.engine==="embed") parts.push(st.playbackConfirmed?"Playback confirmed":st.frameLoadedAt?"Player page loaded":"Connecting");
  if(st.playback&&st.playback.buffered) parts.push("Buffer "+Math.round(st.playback.buffered)+"s");
  m.innerHTML=parts.join(" · ");
  const line=document.getElementById("playerSourceLine");
  if(line) line.textContent=(st.item&&st.item.type==="tv"?"Season "+st.season+" · Episode "+st.episode+" · ":"")+(src?src.name:"ZeroPlay player");
  const servers=document.getElementById("btnPlayerServers");
  if(servers) servers.textContent=st.availableServers&&st.availableServers.length?("Servers · "+st.availableServers.length):"Servers";
  updateFastBadge();
}
function playerErrorHTML(title,detail){
  return '<div class="player-message"><div><div class="status-box error"><strong>'+esc(title)+'</strong><br>'+esc(detail||"")+'</div><div style="display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1rem"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnPlayerFindServers" type="button">Find servers with this title</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnPlayerRetry" type="button">Retry</button><button class="btn btn-outline" id="btnPlayerDiscover" type="button">Open Sources</button></div></div></div>';
}
function bindPlayerErrorActions(){
  const st=playerState;
  const find=document.getElementById("btnPlayerFindServers"); if(find) find.onclick=()=>{ const ctx=playerContext(st); ctx.fromPlayer=true; showStreamsModal(ctx); };
  const retry=document.getElementById("btnPlayerRetry"); if(retry) retry.onclick=()=>drawPlayer(progress[keyOf(st.item.type,st.item.id)]||{});
  const disc=document.getElementById("btnPlayerDiscover"); if(disc) disc.onclick=()=>{ closePlayer(); location.hash="#/sources"; };
}
async function resolveSourcePlayback(source,ctx){
  ctx=ctx||{};
  const identity=(ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx);
  const richCtx=Object.assign({},ctx,{identity,imdb:identity.imdbId||ctx.imdb||"",altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year});
  if(source&&source.kind==="addon"){
    const res=await queryAddonStreams(source,richCtx);
    const variants=sortVariantsForQuality(res.direct||[],settings.stream.quality);
    if(!variants.length) throw new Error(source.name+" did not return this exact title");
    return {url:variants[0].url,kind:"direct",direct:true,variants,activeVariant:variants[0],identityScore:variants[0].identityScore,identityVerdict:variants[0].identityVerdict};
  }
  if(source&&source.kind==="site"){
    const found=await findOnWebsite(source,richCtx);
    if(!found) throw new Error(source.name+" did not return this exact title");
    const direct=sortVariantsForQuality((found.direct||[]).map(url=>({url,addonName:source.name,label:found.pageTitle||source.name})),settings.stream.quality);
    if(found.playUrl&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl)&&!direct.some(v=>v.url===found.playUrl)) direct.unshift(normalizeVariant({url:found.playUrl,addonName:source.name,label:found.pageTitle||source.name},source.name));
    if(direct.length&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl||direct[0].url)) return {url:found.playUrl&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl)?found.playUrl:direct[0].url,kind:"direct",direct:true,variants:direct,activeVariant:direct.find(v=>v.url===found.playUrl)||direct[0],found,identityScore:found.identityScore,identityVerdict:found.identityVerdict};
    return {url:found.playUrl||found.embed||found.watchUrl,kind:"embed",direct:false,variants:[],activeVariant:null,found,identityScore:found.identityScore,identityVerdict:found.identityVerdict};
  }
  const url=await resolveSourceURL(source,richCtx);
  const direct=!!(source&&source.direct)||isDirectMedia(url);
  const variant=direct?normalizeVariant({url,addonName:source?source.name:"Direct server",label:source?source.name:"Direct stream"},source?source.name:"Direct server"):null;
  return {url,kind:direct?"direct":"embed",direct,variants:variant?[variant]:[],activeVariant:variant};
}
async function drawPlayer(prevProgress){
  clearPlayerTimers(); resetFastStreamBridge(null);
  const st=withPlayerRuntime(playerState); playerState=st;
  const it=st.item, isTV=it.type==="tv";
  stopCardPreview();
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview);
  st.engine="loading"; st.healthRecorded=false; st.levels=[]; st.frameLoadedAt=0; st.playbackSignalAt=0; st.playbackConfirmed=false; st.embedNoticeShown=false; st.prime=null; st.playback=Object.assign({},st.playback,{paused:true,buffering:true,currentTime:0,duration:0,buffered:0});
  $("#playerRoot").innerHTML=playerShell("Finding this title on the selected server…");
  document.body.classList.add("locked");
  bindPlayerChrome();
  const source=st.tempSource||getSource(st.source)||allSources()[0];
  if(!source){ const stage=$("#playerStage"); if(stage) stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML("No playback server is enabled","Open Sources to add or turn on a source."); bindPlayerErrorActions(); playerLoading(false); return; }
  st.source=source.id; st.tried.add(source.id);
  const prev=prevProgress||progress[keyOf(it.type,it.id)]||{};
  const sameEpisode=prev.season===st.season&&prev.episode===st.episode;
  const resumeSeconds=(sameEpisode&&Number(prev.timestamp||prev.position)>30&&Number(prev.percent||0)<95)?Number(prev.timestamp||prev.position):0;
  let imdb=st.testImdb||it.imdb_id||"";
  if(!imdb&&detailState&&detailState.data&&detailState.data.id===it.id) imdb=detailState.data.imdb_id||((detailState.data.external_ids||{}).imdb_id)||"";
  const identity=(detailState&&detailState.data&&detailState.data.id===it.id)
    ? identityFromDetail(detailState.data,it.type,st.season,st.episode)
    : buildTitleIdentity({item:it,type:it.type,id:it.id,title:titleOf(it),year:it.year||yearOf(it),season:st.season,episode:st.episode,imdb});
  if(imdb&&!identity.imdbId) identity.imdbId=imdb;
  st.identity=identity;
  const ctx={type:it.type,id:it.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:st.season,episode:st.episode,timestamp:resumeSeconds,percent:prev.percent,imdb:identity.imdbId||imdb,identity};
  let playback=null;
  try{
    if(st.directUrl){
      const variants=sortVariantsForQuality([st.activeVariant||st.directUrl].concat(st.variants||[],st.directQueue||[]),settings.stream.quality);
      const active=variants.find(v=>v.url===st.directUrl)||variants[0];
      playback={url:st.directUrl,kind:"direct",direct:true,variants,activeVariant:active};
    }else playback=await resolveSourcePlayback(source,ctx);
  }catch(e){
    if(playerState!==st) return;
    if(!st.tempSource){ void failover(((source&&source.name)||"Source")+" did not provide this title"); return; }
    const stage=$("#playerStage"); if(stage) stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML("Could not resolve this server",e.message||"The server did not return a playable match for this exact title."); bindPlayerErrorActions(); playerLoading(false); return;
  }
  if(playerState!==st) return;
  st.url=playback.url; st.direct=!!playback.direct;
  st.variants=sortVariantsForQuality(playback.variants||[],settings.stream.quality);
  st.activeVariant=playback.activeVariant||st.variants.find(v=>v.url===st.url)||null;
  st.directQueue=st.variants.filter(v=>v.url!==st.url);
  if(st.activeVariant&&st.activeVariant.bytes) st.fileBytes=st.activeVariant.bytes;
  if(st.direct){
    if(!st.fileBytes&&!/^blob:/i.test(st.url)&&!/\.(m3u8|mpd)(\?|#|$)/i.test(st.url)) st.fileBytes=await probeFileSize(st.url);
    const verdict=decideSizeCap(st.fileBytes,capBytes());
    if(!verdict.allowed){ const stage=$("#playerStage"); if(stage) stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML("Blocked by the "+capGb()+" GB cap","This file is "+fmtBytes(st.fileBytes)+". Choose another server or a smaller quality."); bindPlayerErrorActions(); updatePlayerMeta(source); return; }
  }
  /* Re-render once variants are known so the quality menu contains real options. */
  $("#playerRoot").innerHTML=playerShell(st.direct?"Connecting to the direct stream…":"Loading the embedded player…");
  bindPlayerChrome();
  const stage=$("#playerStage");
  const loadT0=performance.now();
  if(st.direct) await mountDirectVideo(stage,st.url,source,loadT0,resumeSeconds);
  else mountEmbedPlayer(stage,st.url,source,loadT0,ctx);
  updatePlayerMeta(source);
  if(isTV&&settings.stream.preload!=="off"&&streamCfg().nextEpisodeWarm!==false&&!st.noProgress) playerTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{ if(playerState===st&&!document.hidden) faststreamPreload({type:it.type,id:it.id,title:titleOf(it),season:st.season,episode:st.episode+1},source.id); },9000));
}
function embedReferrerPolicyForUrl(url){
  try{ return new URL(String(url||"")).hostname.toLowerCase().endsWith("embedwave.cc")?"no-referrer":"strict-origin-when-cross-origin"; }catch{ return "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"; }
}
function mountEmbedPlayer(stage,url,source,loadT0,ctx){
  const st=playerState;
  if(!stage||!st) return;
  resetFastStreamBridge(null);
  st.mountedAt=Date.now(); st.frameLoadedAt=0; st.playbackSignalAt=0; st.playbackConfirmed=false; st.embedNoticeShown=false; st.lastTs=0; st.lastAdvanceAt=0;
  stage.innerHTML='<div class="media-shell"></div><div class="player-loading" id="playerLoading"><div class="big-spinner"></div><strong data-loading-text>Loading '+esc(source.name)+'…</strong><span style="color:#cbd2d8;font-size:.88rem">The player page is loading. ZeroPlay will not call this successful until playback actually progresses.</span></div>';
  const shell=stage.querySelector(".media-shell");
  const key=preloadKey({type:st.item.type,id:st.item.id,season:st.season,episode:st.episode},source.id);
  const pre=takePreloadedFrame(key,url);
  const markFrameLoaded=(preloaded)=>{
    if(playerState!==st||st.frameLoadedAt) return;
    st.frameLoadedAt=Date.now();
    playerLoading(false);
    showPlayerChrome(false);
    updatePlayerMeta(source);
    if(preloaded) toast("Preloaded "+source.name+" page attached — waiting for playback");
  };
  const armFrame=f=>{
    if(!f) return;
    f.id="playerFrame"; f.className="player-frame"; f.setAttribute("tabindex","-1"); f.setAttribute("title",source.name+" video player");
    try{ f.referrerPolicy=embedReferrerPolicyForUrl(url); }catch{}
    f.addEventListener("load",()=>markFrameLoaded(false),{once:true});
  };
  if(pre){ armFrame(pre); shell.appendChild(pre); markFrameLoaded(true); }
  else{
    const f=document.createElement("iframe");
    f.allow="autoplay; fullscreen; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"; f.allowFullscreen=true; f.referrerPolicy=embedReferrerPolicyForUrl(url);
    armFrame(f); shell.appendChild(f); f.src=url;
  }
  setPlayerControlMode("embed");
  updatePlayerMeta(source);
  const raceMs=embedLoadTimeoutMs();
  playerTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{
    if(playerState!==st||st.engine!=="embed"||st.frameLoadedAt) return;
    recordHealth(source.id,false,raceMs);
    void failover(source.name+" player page did not load within "+Math.round(raceMs/1000)+"s",{frameNeverLoaded:true});
  },raceMs));
  playerTimers.push(setTimeout(()=>{
    if(playerState!==st||st.engine!=="embed"||!st.frameLoadedAt||st.playbackConfirmed||st.embedNoticeShown) return;
    st.embedNoticeShown=true;
    updatePlayerMeta(source);
    toast(source.name+" loaded, but ZeroPlay has not received playback progress yet. Its own server list or Play button may still be working; ZeroPlay will stay here instead of jumping away.","error");
  },embedStallTimeoutMs()));
  playerTimers.push(setInterval(()=>{
    if(playerState!==st||st.engine!=="embed"||!st.playbackConfirmed||!(Number(st.lastTs)>0)||!st.lastAdvanceAt) return;
    if(document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.id==="playerFrame") return;
    if(Date.now()-st.lastAdvanceAt>embedStallTimeoutMs()){
      st.stalls++; st.lastAdvanceAt=Date.now();
      if(streamCfg().stallSwitch) void failover("Confirmed playback stalled on "+source.name,{confirmedStall:true});
      else toast("Playback progress has stalled on "+source.name+" — open Servers to switch","error");
    }
  },5000));
}
function directMediaKind(url){
  const path=String(url||"").split(/[?#]/)[0].toLowerCase();
  if(/\.m3u8$/.test(path)) return "hls";
  if(/\.mpd$/.test(path)) return "dash";
  if(/\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v)$/.test(path)) return "file";
  return "unknown";
}
function nativeCanPlayDirect(url){
  const kind=directMediaKind(url);
  if(kind==="dash") return false;
  if(kind==="hls"){
    const probe=document.createElement("video");
    return !!(probe.canPlayType&&probe.canPlayType("application/vnd.apple.mpegurl"));
  }
  return kind==="file"||kind==="unknown";
}
async function mountDirectVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resume){
  const st=playerState;
  if(!stage||!st) return;
  if(st.primeCtl) try{st.primeCtl.abort();}catch{}
  st.url=url; st.direct=true; st.triedUrls=st.triedUrls||new Set(); st.triedUrls.add(url);
  if(!st.activeVariant||st.activeVariant.url!==url) st.activeVariant=(st.variants||[]).find(v=>v.url===url)||normalizeVariant({url,addonName:source.name},source.name);
  const resumeAt=typeof resume==="number"?resume:Number(resume&&(resume.timestamp||resume.position))||0;
  const mode=String(settings.stream.player||"faststream-only");
  if(mode==="builtin"){
    if(nativeCanPlayDirect(url)) return mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt);
    stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML("FastStream is disabled","This stream format is not supported by the ZeroPlay player. Enable FastStream or choose a compatible direct stream.");
    bindPlayerErrorActions(); setPlayerControlMode("native");
    return;
  }
  if(mode==="faststream-only") return mountFastStreamPlayer(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{allowApi:true,legacyOnly:true});
  /* FastStream is the default direct-stream transport. It first attempts the
     EmbedAPI and then uses the hosted FastStream player; native playback is
     only selected when the user explicitly chooses ZeroPlay or as a guarded
     compatibility fallback after FastStream cannot load the stream. */
  return mountFastStreamPlayer(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{allowApi:true});
}
async function mountFastStreamPlayer(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,opts){
  const st=playerState; opts=opts||{};
  if(!stage||!st) return;
  const beginLegacy=()=>{
    if(playerState!==st) return;
    resetFastStreamBridge(null);
    stage.innerHTML='<div class="media-shell"><iframe class="player-frame" id="fsFrame" tabindex="-1" src="https://faststream.online/player/#'+encodeURI(url)+'" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen title="FastStream player"></iframe></div><div class="player-loading" id="playerLoading"><div class="big-spinner"></div><strong data-loading-text>Loading FastStream…</strong><span style="color:#cbd2d8;font-size:.88rem">FastStream is running inside ZeroPlay. Servers and quality remain in the ZeroPlay bar.</span></div>';
    const f=document.getElementById("fsFrame");
    if(f) f.addEventListener("load",()=>{ st.frameLoadedAt=Date.now(); playerLoading(false); showPlayerChrome(false); updatePlayerMeta(source); },{once:true});
    setPlayerControlMode("faststream-legacy");
    updatePlayerMeta(source);
  };
  if(opts.allowApi===false){ beginLegacy(); return; }
  if(streamCfg().fastStreamApiProbe===false){
    if(!opts.legacyOnly&&nativeCanPlayDirect(url)) return mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{fastStreamApiPending:true});
    beginLegacy(); return;
  }
  const apiStatus=effectiveFastStreamApiStatus();
  if(!opts.legacyOnly&&apiStatus==="unavailable"){
    if(nativeCanPlayDirect(url)) return mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{fastStreamApiPending:true});
    beginLegacy(); return;
  }
  if(!opts.legacyOnly&&apiStatus!=="available"&&nativeCanPlayDirect(url)){
    /* Do not make a playable file wait on a capability handshake. Start in
       the responsive ZeroPlay engine now and probe FastStream in the
       background; once the API is known available, later direct streams
       use it automatically. */
    probeFastStreamApiInBackground();
    return mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{fastStreamApiPending:true});
  }
  stage.innerHTML='<div class="media-shell"></div><div class="player-loading" id="playerLoading"><div class="big-spinner"></div><strong data-loading-text>Connecting FastStream inside ZeroPlay…</strong><span style="color:#cbd2d8;font-size:.88rem">Checking for the FastStream control API.</span></div>';
  const shell=stage.querySelector(".media-shell");
  const frame=document.createElement("iframe");
  frame.id="fsFrame"; frame.className="player-frame"; frame.title="FastStream player inside ZeroPlay";
  frame.allow="autoplay; fullscreen; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"; frame.allowFullscreen=true; frame.setAttribute("tabindex","-1");
  resetFastStreamBridge(frame);
  shell.appendChild(frame);
  st.engine="faststream-connecting";
  setPlayerControlMode("faststream-connecting");
  frame.src="https://faststream.online/player/";
  const ready=await waitForFastStreamReady(4500);
  if(playerState!==st) return;
  if(!ready){
    setFastStreamApiStatus("unavailable");
    if(opts.legacyOnly||!nativeCanPlayDirect(url)){ beginLegacy(); return; }
    /* Hosted FastStream currently lags the EmbedAPI release. A native file
       gets full ZeroPlay controls now, and automatically upgrades to the
       API engine as soon as faststream.online publishes it. */
    return mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{fastStreamApiPending:true});
  }
  try{
    await fsCommand("subscribe",{events:["canplay","durationchange","ended","error","loadedmetadata","manifestparsed","pause","play","playing","ratechange","seeked","seeking","timeupdate","waiting","sourcechange","volumechange"]},6000);
    setFastStreamApiStatus("available");
    st.engine="faststream-api";
    setPlayerControlMode("faststream-api");
    const click=document.createElement("button"); click.className="media-click"; click.type="button"; click.setAttribute("aria-label","Play or pause"); click.onclick=()=>playerCommand("toggle"); click.ondblclick=()=>playerCommand("fullscreen"); shell.appendChild(click);
    playerLoading(true,"FastStream connected — loading stream…");
    await fsCommand("load",{url,autoPlay:true,time:resumeAt>20?resumeAt:0},12000);
    await fsCommand("setVolume",{volume:Number(settings.stream.volume==null?.9:settings.stream.volume)},5000).catch(()=>{});
    await fsCommand("setPlaybackRate",{rate:Number(settings.stream.rate||1)},5000).catch(()=>{});
    const state=await fsCommand("getState",{},5000).catch(()=>null);
    if(state) updatePlaybackUI(normalizeFastStreamState(state),"playing");
    setTimeout(()=>refreshFastStreamLevels(true),350);
    updatePlayerMeta(source);
  }catch(e){
    if(playerState!==st) return;
    if(opts.legacyOnly||!nativeCanPlayDirect(url)) beginLegacy();
    else return mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,{fastStreamApiPending:true});
  }
}
function mountNativeVideo(stage,url,source,loadT0,resumeAt,opts){
  const st=playerState; opts=opts||{};
  if(!stage||!st) return;
  resetFastStreamBridge(null);
  stage.innerHTML='<div class="media-shell"><video class="player-frame" id="pv" playsinline preload="metadata"></video><button class="media-click" id="mediaClick" type="button" aria-label="Play or pause"></button></div><div class="player-loading" id="playerLoading"><div class="big-spinner"></div><strong data-loading-text>Connecting to the stream…</strong><span style="color:#cbd2d8;font-size:.88rem">'+(opts.fastStreamApiPending?"ZeroPlay controls are active while FastStream API support rolls out.":"ZeroPlay player")+'</span></div>';
  const v=document.getElementById("pv");
  const click=document.getElementById("mediaClick");
  if(click){ click.onclick=()=>playerCommand("toggle"); click.ondblclick=()=>playerCommand("fullscreen"); }
  const bufferedAhead=()=>{ try{ for(let i=0;i<v.buffered.length;i++){ if(v.buffered.start(i)<=v.currentTime&&v.currentTime<=v.buffered.end(i)) return Math.max(0,v.buffered.end(i)-v.currentTime); } }catch{} return 0; };
  let raf=0,lastUi=0;
  const sync=(eventName,force)=>{
    const now=performance.now();
    if(!force&&now-lastUi<180) return;
    lastUi=now;
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>updatePlaybackUI({paused:v.paused,buffering:v.readyState<3&&!v.paused,currentTime:v.currentTime||0,duration:Number.isFinite(v.duration)?v.duration:0,buffered:bufferedAhead(),volume:v.volume,muted:v.muted,rate:v.playbackRate},eventName));
  };
  v.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(settings.stream.volume==null?.9:settings.stream.volume)));
  v.muted=!!settings.stream.muted; v.playbackRate=Number(settings.stream.rate||1);
  v.preload=(settings.stream.preload==="off"||effectiveSaver())?"metadata":"auto";
  v.src=url;
  setPlayerControlMode("native");
  updatePlayerMeta(source);
  v.addEventListener("loadedmetadata",()=>{
    if(resumeAt>20&&v.duration&&resumeAt<v.duration-15){ try{v.currentTime=resumeAt;}catch{} }
    sync("loadedmetadata",true);
    const p=v.play(); if(p&&p.catch) p.catch(()=>{ playerLoading(false); updatePlaybackUI({paused:true,buffering:false,currentTime:v.currentTime,duration:v.duration||0},"pause"); toast("Press Play to start"); });
  });
  v.addEventListener("canplay",()=>{ playerLoading(false); sync("canplay",true); primeDirectSafely(url,v,bufferedAhead); });
  v.addEventListener("playing",()=>{ playerLoading(false); if(!st.healthRecorded){ st.healthRecorded=true; recordHealth(source.id,true,performance.now()-loadT0); } sync("playing",true); updatePlayerMeta(source); });
  v.addEventListener("pause",()=>{ sync("pause",true); savePlaybackProgress(true); });
  v.addEventListener("waiting",()=>{ st.stalls++; playerLoading(true,"Buffering…"); sync("waiting",true); });
  v.addEventListener("progress",()=>sync("progress"));
  v.addEventListener("timeupdate",()=>sync("timeupdate"));
  v.addEventListener("volumechange",()=>{ settings.stream.volume=v.volume; settings.stream.muted=v.muted; saveSettings(); sync("volumechange",true); });
  v.addEventListener("ratechange",()=>sync("ratechange",true));
  v.addEventListener("ended",()=>{ sync("ended",true); handlePlaybackEnded(); });
  let lastObservedTime=0,lastObservedAdvanceAt=0,hasAdvanced=false;
  const noteObservedTime=()=>{ lastObservedTime=Number(v.currentTime)||0; lastObservedAdvanceAt=Date.now(); };
  v.addEventListener("seeking",noteObservedTime);
  v.addEventListener("seeked",noteObservedTime);
  const stallTimer=setInterval(()=>{
    if(playerState!==st||!v.isConnected){ clearInterval(stallTimer); return; }
    if(v.paused||v.ended||document.hidden){ lastObservedAdvanceAt=Date.now(); return; }
    const t=Number(v.currentTime)||0;
    if(t>lastObservedTime+.2){ lastObservedTime=t; lastObservedAdvanceAt=Date.now(); if(t>.5) hasAdvanced=true; return; }
    if(t<lastObservedTime-.5){ noteObservedTime(); return; }
    if(hasAdvanced&&lastObservedAdvanceAt&&Date.now()-lastObservedAdvanceAt>embedStallTimeoutMs()){
      lastObservedAdvanceAt=Date.now(); st.stalls++;
      if(streamCfg().stallSwitch) void failover("Confirmed direct playback stalled on "+source.name,{confirmedStall:true});
      else toast("Direct playback has stalled on "+source.name+" — open Servers to switch","error");
    }
  },5000);
  playerTimers.push(stallTimer);
  v.addEventListener("error",async()=>{
    if(playerState!==st) return;
    recordHealth(source.id,false);
    if(await tryNextDirectVariant("This stream format failed")) return;
    if(settings.stream.player!=="builtin"&&st._nativeRetriedWithFastStream!==url){ st._nativeRetriedWithFastStream=url; toast("The browser could not play this file directly — retrying inside FastStream"); mountFastStreamPlayer(stage,url,source,performance.now(),currentPlaybackTime(),{allowApi:false}); return; }
    stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML("This stream could not be played","The browser reported a media/codec error. Try another quality or server with this exact title."); bindPlayerErrorActions(); setPlayerControlMode("native");
  },true);
  try{v.load();}catch{}
}
function primeDirectSafely(url,video,bufferedAhead){
  const st=playerState;
  if(!st||st._primeStartedFor===url||settings.stream.preload==="off"||effectiveSaver()||directMediaKind(url)!=="file") return;
  st._primeStartedFor=url;
  /* The primer accepts only real 206 range responses, uses the configured
     FastStream worker/chunk/budget limits, and cancels as soon as the player
     reaches the configured buffer target. */
  setTimeout(async()=>{
    const cfg=streamCfg(), bufferTarget=Number(cfg.bufferTargetSec)||16;
    if(playerState!==st||!video||video.paused||bufferedAhead()>bufferTarget) return;
    const conn=navigator.connection||{};
    const configuredBudget=Math.round(Number(cfg.primeBudgetMb||2)*1048576);
    const budget=conn.downlink&&conn.downlink<1.5?Math.min(configuredBudget,512*1024):configuredBudget;
    const chunk=Math.round(Number(cfg.primeChunkKb||256)*1024); let off=0,got=0; const t0=performance.now();
    st.primeCtl=new AbortController();
    const worker=async()=>{
      while(off<budget&&playerState===st&&!document.hidden){
        if(bufferedAhead()>bufferTarget) break;
        const start=off; off+=chunk;
        try{
          const r=await fetch(url,{headers:{Range:"bytes="+start+"-"+(start+chunk-1)},signal:st.primeCtl.signal,credentials:"omit"});
          if(r.status!==206){ try{await r.body.cancel();}catch{} break; }
          if(!r.body) break;
          const rd=r.body.getReader(); let local=0;
          for(;;){ const part=await rd.read(); if(part.done) break; local+=part.value.length; got+=part.value.length; if(local>=chunk||got>=budget){ try{await rd.cancel();}catch{} break; } }
          const sec=(performance.now()-t0)/1000; st.prime={mb:got/1048576,mbps:sec>0?(got/1048576)/sec:0}; updatePlayerMeta();
        }catch{ break; }
      }
    };
    await Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.max(1,Math.min(4,Number(cfg.primeThreads)||2))},()=>worker()));
  },1400);
}

function isEmbedwaveOption(option){
  if(!option) return false;
  const text=String([option.id||"",option.sourceId||"",option.name||"",option.url||""].join(" ")).toLowerCase();
  return text.includes("embedwave");
}
async function failover(reason,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer||st.switching) return false;
  if(!opts.manual&&streamCfg().autoFailover===false){
    toast((reason||"Playback problem")+" — automatic server switching is off. Open Servers to choose another server.","error");
    const stage=document.getElementById("playerStage");
    if(stage&&(opts.frameNeverLoaded||st.engine==="loading")){ stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML("This server did not start",(reason||"Playback problem")+" Automatic server switching is off in Settings, so ZeroPlay stayed on this server."); bindPlayerErrorActions(); playerLoading(false); }
    return false;
  }
  st.switching=true;
  try{
    if(st.currentServerOptionId) st.tried.add(st.currentServerOptionId);
    if(st.source) st.tried.add(st.source);
    if(st.url){ st.triedUrls=st.triedUrls||new Set(); st.triedUrls.add(st.url); }
    let options=Array.isArray(st.availableServers)?st.availableServers:[];
    if(!st.availabilityChecked||!options.length){
      toast((reason||"Playback problem")+" — searching only servers with this exact title");
      const ctx=playerContext(st);
      const result=await findTitleServers(ctx,{quick:true,quickTimeoutMs:10000,shouldContinue:()=>playerState===st&&!!st.switching,onUpdate:partial=>{ if(playerState===st){ st.availableServers=partial.options||[]; updatePlayerMeta(); } }});
      if(playerState!==st) return;
      options=result.options||[]; st.availableServers=options; st.availabilityChecked=true;
    }
    const untried=options.filter(o=>o&&!st.tried.has(o.id)&&!(o.sourceId&&st.tried.has(o.sourceId))&&(!(o.url&&st.triedUrls&&st.triedUrls.has(o.url))||(o.variants||[]).some(v=>!st.triedUrls.has(v.url))));
    const allowEmbedwave=!!(opts.allowEmbedwave||opts.manual||streamCfg().embedwaveFailover);
    const next=untried.find(o=>allowEmbedwave||!isEmbedwaveOption(o));
    if(!next){
      const onlyEmbedwave=untried.length&&untried.every(isEmbedwaveOption);
      const message=onlyEmbedwave?"Only Embedwave remains, and automatic Embedwave failover is off. Open Servers if you want to choose it manually.":"No other server returned this exact title.";
      toast((reason||"Playback problem")+" — "+message,"error");
      const stage=document.getElementById("playerStage");
      if(stage&&(opts.frameNeverLoaded||st.engine==="loading"||!st.healthRecorded)){ stage.innerHTML=playerErrorHTML(onlyEmbedwave?"ZeroPlay stopped before Embedwave":"No other server returned this exact title",(reason||"")+" "+message); bindPlayerErrorActions(); playerLoading(false); }
      return false;
    }
    toast((reason||"Switching server")+" — "+next.name+" has this title");
    await playTitleServerOption(next,playerContext(st),{fromPlayer:true,keepTime:true});
    return true;
  }finally{ if(playerState===st) st.switching=false; }
}
function closePlayer(){
  const st=playerState;
  if(st){
    savePlaybackProgress(true);
    if(st.primeCtl) try{st.primeCtl.abort();}catch{}
    if(st.chromeTimer) clearTimeout(st.chromeTimer);
    if(st.engine==="faststream-api") fsCommand("unsubscribe",{},1500).catch(()=>{});
  }
  if(document.pictureInPictureElement) document.exitPictureInPicture().catch(()=>{});
  if(document.fullscreenElement&&document.fullscreenElement.id==="playerOverlay") document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});
  clearPlayerTimers(); resetFastStreamBridge(null); clearPreload();
  if(typeof activeDownloadObjectUrl!=="undefined"&&activeDownloadObjectUrl&&st&&(st.url===activeDownloadObjectUrl||st.directUrl===activeDownloadObjectUrl)){ URL.revokeObjectURL(activeDownloadObjectUrl); activeDownloadObjectUrl=""; }
  $("#playerRoot").innerHTML=""; playerState=null;
  if(typeof discoveryRuntime!=="undefined"&&discoveryRuntime.running&&discoveryRuntime.deferredForPlayback){ discoveryRuntime.deferredForPlayback=false; setTimeout(()=>runDiscoveryCycle("after playback"),3000); }
  if(!detailState) document.body.classList.remove("locked");
  if(st&&st.item&&st.item.id&&(ANDROID_TV_APP||document.body.classList.contains("tv-mode"))){
    setTimeout(()=>{ const target=document.getElementById("btnPlay")||document.querySelector('.continue-card[data-type="'+st.item.type+'"][data-id="'+st.item.id+'"]')||document.querySelector('.poster-card[data-type="'+st.item.type+'"][data-id="'+st.item.id+'"]'); if(target) target.focus({preventScroll:true}); else if(typeof restoreTvFocus==="function") restoreTvFocus(); },30);
  }
}

/* ---------------- downloads + M3U extraction ----------------
   Downloads are deliberately honest about browser/network limits. A file can
   only be parallelised when CORS and HTTP Range are available; an HLS stream
   can be parallelised at segment level. Completed chunks/segments are kept in
   IndexedDB, so Pause and browser restarts resume from stored parts whenever
   the remote file/playlist is still the same. Cross-origin embed players are
   never downloadable from the parent page: ZeroPlay first searches for a
   verified direct file/HLS result for the exact title/episode. */
const DOWNLOAD_DB_NAME="zeroplay-downloads-v1";
let downloadDbPromise=null;
const downloadFallbackStores={jobs:new Map(),chunks:new Map(),files:new Map()};
let downloadJobs=new Map();
let downloadControllers=new Map();
let deletedDownloadIds=new Set();
let downloadPersistTimers=new Map();
let downloadsLoaded=false;
let downloadsLoadPromise=null;
let downloadUiTimer=0;
let downloadUiSignature="";
let downloadModalState=null;
let m3uResultsState=[];
let activeDownloadObjectUrl="";
const hlsKeyCache=new Map();
function makeDownloadId(){ try{ if(crypto&&crypto.randomUUID) return "dl-"+crypto.randomUUID(); }catch{} return "dl-"+Date.now().toString(36)+"-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10); }
function downloadStoreKey(store,value){ return store==="chunks"?value.key:value.id; }
function downloadRequestPromise(request){ return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ request.onsuccess=()=>resolve(request.result); request.onerror=()=>reject(request.error||new Error("IndexedDB request failed")); }); }
function downloadTxPromise(tx){ return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ tx.oncomplete=()=>resolve(true); tx.onerror=()=>reject(tx.error||new Error("IndexedDB transaction failed")); tx.onabort=()=>reject(tx.error||new Error("IndexedDB transaction aborted")); }); }
function openDownloadDb(){
  if(downloadDbPromise) return downloadDbPromise;
  downloadDbPromise=new Promise(resolve=>{
    try{
      if(typeof indexedDB==="undefined"){ resolve(null); return; }
      const req=indexedDB.open(DOWNLOAD_DB_NAME,1);
      req.onupgradeneeded=()=>{
        const db=req.result;
        if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains("jobs")) db.createObjectStore("jobs",{keyPath:"id"});
        if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains("files")) db.createObjectStore("files",{keyPath:"id"});
        if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains("chunks")){ const store=db.createObjectStore("chunks",{keyPath:"key"}); store.createIndex("jobId","jobId",{unique:false}); }
      };
      req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result);
      req.onerror=()=>resolve(null);
      req.onblocked=()=>resolve(null);
    }catch{ resolve(null); }
  });
  return downloadDbPromise;
}
async function downloadDb(){ try{ return await openDownloadDb(); }catch{ return null; } }
async function dlPut(store,value){
  const db=await downloadDb();
  if(db){ const tx=db.transaction(store,"readwrite"); const req=tx.objectStore(store).put(value); await Promise.all([downloadRequestPromise(req),downloadTxPromise(tx)]); return value; }
  downloadFallbackStores[store].set(downloadStoreKey(store,value),value); return value;
}
async function dlGet(store,key){
  const db=await downloadDb();
  if(db) return downloadRequestPromise(db.transaction(store,"readonly").objectStore(store).get(key));
  return downloadFallbackStores[store].get(key)||null;
}
async function dlGetAll(store){
  const db=await downloadDb();
  if(db) return downloadRequestPromise(db.transaction(store,"readonly").objectStore(store).getAll());
  return [...downloadFallbackStores[store].values()];
}
async function dlDelete(store,key){
  const db=await downloadDb();
  if(db){ const tx=db.transaction(store,"readwrite"); const req=tx.objectStore(store).delete(key); await Promise.all([downloadRequestPromise(req),downloadTxPromise(tx)]); return; }
  downloadFallbackStores[store].delete(key);
}
async function dlDeleteJobChunks(jobId){
  const db=await downloadDb();
  if(db){
    const keys=await downloadRequestPromise(db.transaction("chunks","readonly").objectStore("chunks").index("jobId").getAllKeys(IDBKeyRange.only(jobId)));
    if(keys.length){ const tx=db.transaction("chunks","readwrite"); const store=tx.objectStore("chunks"); keys.forEach(key=>store.delete(key)); await downloadTxPromise(tx); }
    return;
  }
  for(const [key,chunk] of [...downloadFallbackStores.chunks.entries()]) if(chunk.jobId===jobId) downloadFallbackStores.chunks.delete(key);

function completedDownloadSet(job){
  if(!(job._completedSet instanceof Set)) job._completedSet=new Set((job.completedChunks||[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isInteger));
  return job._completedSet;
}
function firstMissingDownloadIndex(job){
  const done=completedDownloadSet(job); let index=0;
  while(done.has(index)) index++;
  return index;
}
function downloadPartIndexes(job){
  if(job&&Number(job.chunksTotal)>0) return Array.from({length:Number(job.chunksTotal)},(_,i)=>i);
  return [...completedDownloadSet(job)].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}
function serializableDownloadJob(job){
  const out={};
  for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(job||{})){
    if(key.startsWith("_")||typeof value==="function") continue;
    out[key]=value;
  }
  out.completedChunks=[...completedDownloadSet(job)].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  return out;
}
function persistDownloadJob(job,force){
  if(!job||deletedDownloadIds.has(job.id)) return;
  job.updatedAt=Date.now();
  queueDownloadUiRefresh();
  const old=downloadPersistTimers.get(job.id);
  if(old&&!force) return;
  if(old) clearTimeout(old);
  const run=()=>{ downloadPersistTimers.delete(job.id); dlPut("jobs",serializableDownloadJob(job)).catch(()=>{}); };
  if(force) run(); else downloadPersistTimers.set(job.id,setTimeout(run,750));
}
function downloadChunkLength(job,index){
  if(job.kind!=="file"||!job.totalBytes) return Number(job.partSizes&&job.partSizes[index])||0;
  const start=index*job.chunkSize; return Math.max(0,Math.min(job.chunkSize,job.totalBytes-start));
}
function recalcDownloadBytes(job){
  const done=completedDownloadSet(job); let total=0;
  for(const index of done) total+=downloadChunkLength(job,index);
  if(total||job.kind==="file") job.downloadedBytes=total;
  return Number(job.downloadedBytes)||0;
}
function downloadProgress(job){
  if(job.totalBytes>0) return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(Number(job.downloadedBytes)||0)/job.totalBytes*100));
  if(job.chunksTotal>0) return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,completedDownloadSet(job).size/job.chunksTotal*100));
  return job.status==="complete"?100:0;
}
function formatDownloadEta(job){
  if(job.status==="complete") return "Complete";
  if(!(job.speedBps>0)) return job.status==="running"?"Calculating…":"—";
  const remaining=job.totalBytes>0?Math.max(0,job.totalBytes-(job.downloadedBytes||0)):null;
  if(remaining==null) return "—";
  const seconds=remaining/job.speedBps;
  if(seconds<60) return Math.ceil(seconds)+" sec left";
  if(seconds<3600) return Math.ceil(seconds/60)+" min left";
  return (seconds/3600).toFixed(1)+" hr left";
}
function noteDownloadBytes(job,bytes){
  const now=performance.now();
  if(!job._speedStartedAt){ job._speedStartedAt=now; job._speedBytes=0; }
  job._speedBytes=(job._speedBytes||0)+(Number(bytes)||0);
  const elapsed=(now-job._speedStartedAt)/1000;
  if(elapsed>.35) job.speedBps=job._speedBytes/elapsed;
  persistDownloadJob(job,false);
}
function downloadContextFrom(ctx){
  ctx=ctx||{};
  const identity=(ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx);
  return {type:identity.type,id:identity.tmdbId||ctx.id||0,title:identity.title||ctx.title||"Download",altTitles:identity.titles||[],year:identity.year||ctx.year||"",season:identity.season||ctx.season||1,episode:identity.episode||ctx.episode||1,imdb:identity.imdbId||ctx.imdb||"",identity,item:ctx.item||(identity.tmdbId?snap(catalogItemFor(identity.type,identity.tmdbId),identity.type):null)};
}
function sanitizeDownloadName(value){ return String(value||"ZeroPlay download").replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,150)||"ZeroPlay download"; }
function extensionForDownload(url,mime,kind){
  const path=String(url||"").split(/[?#]/)[0].toLowerCase();
  const ext=(path.match(/\.(mp4|m4v|webm|mov|mkv|ts|m2ts|aac|mp3)$/)||[])[1];
  if(ext) return ext;
  const m=String(mime||"").toLowerCase();
  if(m.includes("mp4")) return "mp4"; if(m.includes("webm")) return "webm"; if(m.includes("quicktime")) return "mov"; if(m.includes("matroska")) return "mkv"; if(m.includes("mp2t")) return "ts"; if(m.includes("aac")) return "aac"; if(m.includes("mpeg")&&m.includes("audio")) return "mp3";
  return kind==="hls"?"ts":"mp4";
}
function makeDownloadFilename(ctx,variant,kind,url,mime){
  const cleanCtx=downloadContextFrom(ctx||{});
  const ep=cleanCtx.type==="tv"?" S"+String(cleanCtx.season||1).padStart(2,"0")+"E"+String(cleanCtx.episode||1).padStart(2,"0"):"";
  const q=variant&&variant.quality&&variant.quality!=="source"?" "+variant.quality:"";
  return sanitizeDownloadName(cleanCtx.title+ep+q)+"."+extensionForDownload(url,mime,kind);
}
function parseM3uAttributes(text){
  const out={}; const re=/([A-Z0-9-]+)=("[^"]*"|[^,]*)/gi; let m;
  while((m=re.exec(String(text||"")))){ out[m[1].toUpperCase()]=String(m[2]||"").replace(/^"|"$/g,""); }

}
function resolvePlaylistUrl(raw,base){ try{ return new URL(String(raw||"").trim(),base).href; }catch{ return ""; } }
function parseByteRangeValue(value,previousEnd){
  const m=String(value||"").trim().match(/^(\d+)(?:@(\d+))?$/); if(!m) return null;

function parseM3uPlaylist(text,baseUrl){

  const rangeEnds=new Map();

        if(segmentBuffer.byteLength!==segment.byterange.length) throw new Error("An HLS byte-range segment had the wrong length; resume to retry it");
      }
      const plain=await decryptHlsSegment(job,segment,segmentBuffer,signal);
      await saveDownloadPart(job,index,plain);
    }
  };
  const threads=Math.max(1,Math.min(effectiveDownloadThreads(job),segments.length||1));
  const settled=await Promise.allSettled(Array.from({length:threads},()=>worker())); const failed=settled.find(r=>r.status==="rejected"); if(failed) throw failed.reason;
}
async function refreshDownloadUrl(job){
  if(!job||!job.ctx||downloadCfg().refreshExpired===false) return false;
  try{
    const result=await findTitleServers(job.ctx,{bypassCache:true,shouldContinue:()=>downloadJobs.get(job.id)===job});
    const candidates=[];
    for(const option of result.options||[]){
      if(option.kind!=="direct") continue;
      for(const variant of option.variants||[]) candidates.push({variant,option});
      if(option.url&&isDirectMedia(option.url)) candidates.push({variant:{url:option.url,quality:"source"},option});
    }
    const wantedKind=job.kind==="hls"?"hls":"file";
    candidates.sort((a,b)=>{
      const score=x=>((x.option.name===job.serverName)?30:0)+((normalizeQualityLabel(x.variant.quality)===normalizeQualityLabel(job.quality))?20:0)+((directMediaKind(x.variant.url)===wantedKind||wantedKind==="file"&&directMediaKind(x.variant.url)!=="hls")?15:0);
      return score(b)-score(a);
    });
    const chosen=candidates.find(x=>wantedKind==="hls"?directMediaKind(x.variant.url)==="hls":directMediaKind(x.variant.url)!=="hls"&&directMediaKind(x.variant.url)!=="dash");
    if(!chosen) return false;
    if(job.kind!=="hls"){
      const probe=await probeDownloadTarget(chosen.variant.url);
      if(job.totalBytes&&probe.totalBytes&&Number(probe.totalBytes)!==Number(job.totalBytes)) return false;
      job.url=chosen.variant.url; job.serverName=chosen.option.name||job.serverName; job.note="The old media link expired; ZeroPlay re-found the same title/episode and will continue from stored chunks."; persistDownloadJob(job,true); return true;
    }
    const plan=await resolveHlsPlan(chosen.variant.url,job.quality);
    const oldPaths=(job.segments||[]).map(s=>{ try{return new URL(s.url).pathname;}catch{return s.url;} });
    const newPaths=plan.parts.map(s=>{ try{return new URL(s.url).pathname;}catch{return s.url;} });
    if(oldPaths.length!==newPaths.length||oldPaths.some((value,i)=>value!==newPaths[i])) return false;
    job.url=chosen.variant.url; job.playlistUrl=plan.playlistUrl; job.segments=plan.parts; job.serverName=chosen.option.name||job.serverName; job.note="The old M3U link expired; the same segment sequence was re-found, so completed segments were kept."; persistDownloadJob(job,true); return true;
  }catch{ return false; }
}
async function finalizeDownload(job){
  recalcDownloadBytes(job);
  if(!completedDownloadSet(job).size||!(Number(job.downloadedBytes)>0)) throw new Error("The server returned an empty download");
  if(job.chunksTotal&&(completedDownloadSet(job).size<job.chunksTotal||firstMissingDownloadIndex(job)<job.chunksTotal)) return false;
  if(job.kind==="file"&&job.totalBytes&&Number(job.downloadedBytes)!==Number(job.totalBytes)) throw new Error("Downloaded bytes do not match the server file size; resume to repair the missing chunks");
  job.status="complete"; job.completedAt=Date.now(); job.speedBps=0; job.error=""; persistDownloadJob(job,true); updateDownloadMenuCount(); queueDownloadUiRefresh();
  toast("Download complete: "+job.filename,"success");
  if(downloadCfg().autoSave!==false){ try{ await saveDownloadedFile(job,{automatic:true}); }catch(e){ job.note="The file is complete in Downloads. Automatic saving was blocked: "+(e.message||e); persistDownloadJob(job,true); } }
  return true;
}
async function runDownloadJob(job){
  if(!job||downloadControllers.has(job.id)||job.status==="complete") return;
  if(!downloadsEnabled()){ job.status="paused"; persistDownloadJob(job,true); return; }
  const controller=new AbortController(); downloadControllers.set(job.id,controller);
  job.status="running"; job.error=""; job._speedStartedAt=performance.now(); job._speedBytes=0; persistDownloadJob(job,true); updateDownloadMenuCount();
  try{
    if(job.kind==="hls") await runHlsDownload(job,controller.signal);
    else if(job.kind==="file") await runRangeDownload(job,controller.signal);
    else await runStreamDownload(job,controller.signal);
    if(controller.signal.aborted){ if(job.status==="running") job.status="paused"; }
    else if(await finalizeDownload(job)===false){ job.status="paused"; job.error="Some stored parts are still missing; resume to continue without discarding completed parts."; }
  }catch(e){
    if(controller.signal.aborted||(e&&e.name==="AbortError")){ if(job.status==="running") job.status="paused"; }
    else if(e&&[401,403,404,410].includes(Number(e.status))&&!job._refreshedThisRun){
      job._refreshedThisRun=true;
      const refreshed=await refreshDownloadUrl(job);
      if(refreshed){ job.status="queued"; job.error=""; }
      else { job.status="error"; job.error=(e.message||String(e))+" ZeroPlay could not safely refresh the same file/playlist."; }
    }else{
      job.status="error"; job.error=e&&e.message||String(e); job.retries=(job.retries||0)+1;
      if(e&&e.code==="RANGE_UNSUPPORTED") job.note="Parallel resume is unavailable for this host. Resume will retry; if the host keeps rejecting ranges, use another server/quality.";
    }
  }finally{
    downloadControllers.delete(job.id); job.speedBps=0; recalcDownloadBytes(job); persistDownloadJob(job,true); updateDownloadMenuCount(); queueDownloadUiRefresh();
    setTimeout(scheduleDownloads,60);
  }
}
async function assembleDownloadBlob(job){
  const existing=await dlGet("files",job.id).catch(()=>null);
  if(existing&&existing.blob) return existing.blob;
  const indexes=downloadPartIndexes(job);
  if(!indexes.length) throw new Error("No stored download parts were found");
  const parts=[];
  for(const index of indexes){
    const chunk=await dlGet("chunks",job.id+":"+index);
    if(!chunk||!chunk.data) throw new Error("A stored download chunk is missing. Resume the download to repair it.");
    parts.push(chunk.data);
  }
  const blob=new Blob(parts,{type:job.mime||"application/octet-stream"});
  if(downloadCfg().keepCompleted!==false){
    try{
      await dlPut("files",{id:job.id,blob,filename:job.filename,mime:job.mime||blob.type,size:blob.size,createdAt:Date.now()});
      job.fileStored=true; await dlDeleteJobChunks(job.id); job.chunksStored=false; persistDownloadJob(job,true);
    }catch{ job.note="The assembled file could not also be stored as one browser file (storage may be full), so its chunks were kept."; persistDownloadJob(job,true); }
  }
  return blob;
}
async function cleanupSavedDownload(job){
  await dlDeleteJobChunks(job.id).catch(()=>{}); await dlDelete("files",job.id).catch(()=>{});
  job.fileStored=false; job.chunksStored=false; job.note="Saved to this device and removed from browser storage because “Keep completed files in browser” is off."; persistDownloadJob(job,true);
}
async function writeDownloadToFileHandle(job,handle){
  const writable=await handle.createWritable();
  try{
    const existing=await dlGet("files",job.id).catch(()=>null);
    if(existing&&existing.blob){ await writable.write(existing.blob); }
    else{
      for(const index of downloadPartIndexes(job)){
        const chunk=await dlGet("chunks",job.id+":"+index);
        if(!chunk||!chunk.data) throw new Error("A stored download chunk is missing. Resume the download to repair it.");
        await writable.write(chunk.data);
      }
    }
    await writable.close();
  }catch(e){ try{ await writable.abort(); }catch{} throw e; }
}
async function saveDownloadedFile(job,options){
  options=options||{};
  if(!job||job.status!=="complete") throw new Error("This download is not complete yet");
  if(!job.fileStored&&!job.chunksStored) throw new Error("This file was already saved and cleaned from browser storage");
  if(!options.automatic&&window.showSaveFilePicker){
    try{
      const ext="."+(job.filename.split(".").pop()||"mp4").toLowerCase();
      const handle=await window.showSaveFilePicker({suggestedName:job.filename,types:[{description:"ZeroPlay media",accept:{[job.mime||"application/octet-stream"]:[ext]}}]});
      await writeDownloadToFileHandle(job,handle);
      if(downloadCfg().keepCompleted===false) await cleanupSavedDownload(job);
      toast("Saved "+job.filename,"success"); return true;
    }catch(e){ if(e&&e.name==="AbortError") return false; }
  }
  const blob=await assembleDownloadBlob(job);
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=url; a.download=job.filename; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1500);
  if(downloadCfg().keepCompleted===false) setTimeout(()=>cleanupSavedDownload(job).catch(()=>{}),1800);
  if(!options.automatic) toast("Saved "+job.filename,"success");
  return true;
}
async function playDownloadedFile(job){
  if(!job||job.status!=="complete") return;
  const blob=await assembleDownloadBlob(job);
  const mime=String(blob.type||job.mime||"").toLowerCase();
  if(mime.includes("mp2t")){
    const probe=document.createElement("video");
    if(!(probe.canPlayType&&probe.canPlayType(mime))){ toast("This browser cannot play an assembled .ts file directly. Use Save file to play it in a media player.","error"); return; }
  }
  if(activeDownloadObjectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(activeDownloadObjectUrl);
  activeDownloadObjectUrl=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  closeDownloadModal();
  const ctx=job.ctx||{}, item=ctx.item?snapToItem(ctx.item):{id:0,type:"movie",title:job.title||job.filename};
  playResolvedURL(activeDownloadObjectUrl,item,"Downloaded file",[],{ctx,identity:ctx.identity||null,season:ctx.season||1,episode:ctx.episode||1,noProgress:!ctx.item,activeVariant:{url:activeDownloadObjectUrl,quality:job.quality,bytes:blob.size}});
}
function downloadStatusLabel(job){
  return {queued:"Queued",running:"Downloading",paused:"Paused",complete:"Complete",error:"Needs attention",cancelled:"Cancelled"}[job.status]||job.status||"Download";
}
function downloadStatsHTML(job){
  const progress=downloadProgress(job), done=completedDownloadSet(job).size;
  const mode=job.kind==="hls"?"M3U/HLS segments":job.kind==="file"?"Parallel byte ranges":"Sequential parts";
  const threadCount=effectiveDownloadThreads(job); const threadText=job.kind==="stream"?"1 stream":threadCount+" thread"+(threadCount>1?"s":"");
  return '<span>'+progress.toFixed(1)+'%</span><span>'+fmtBytes(job.downloadedBytes||0)+(job.totalBytes?' / '+fmtBytes(job.totalBytes):" downloaded")+'</span><span>'+done+(job.chunksTotal?' / '+job.chunksTotal:"")+' parts</span><span>'+esc(mode)+' · '+esc(threadText)+'</span>'+(job.status==="running"?'<span>'+fmtBytes(Math.round(job.speedBps||0))+'/s</span><span>'+esc(formatDownloadEta(job))+'</span>':"");
}
function downloadJobHTML(job){
  const progress=downloadProgress(job), done=completedDownloadSet(job).size;
  const isActive=job.status==="running"||job.status==="queued", canResume=["paused","error"].includes(job.status), canUse=job.status==="complete"&&(job.fileStored||job.chunksStored);
  return '<article class="download-job" data-download-job="'+esc(job.id)+'"><div class="download-job-head"><div><h3>'+esc(job.filename||job.title||"Download")+'</h3><div class="download-meta">'+esc(job.title||"")+(job.ctx&&job.ctx.type==="tv"?" · S"+(job.ctx.season||1)+" E"+(job.ctx.episode||1):"")+' · '+esc(job.serverName||"Direct server")+(job.quality?' · '+esc(job.quality):"")+'</div></div><span class="chip '+(job.status==="complete"?"rd":job.status==="error"?"":"violet")+'" data-download-status>'+esc(downloadStatusLabel(job))+'</span></div>'
    +'<div class="download-progress" aria-label="Download progress"><i style="width:'+progress.toFixed(1)+'%"></i></div>'
    +'<div class="download-stats" data-download-stats>'+downloadStatsHTML(job)+'</div>'
    +(job.note?'<p class="help-text">'+esc(job.note)+'</p>':"")+(job.error?'<div class="status-box error" style="margin-top:.6rem">'+esc(job.error)+'</div>':"")
    +'<div class="download-actions">'
    +(isActive?'<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" type="button" data-download-action="pause" data-download-id="'+esc(job.id)+'">Pause</button>':"")
    +(canResume?'<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button" data-download-action="resume" data-download-id="'+esc(job.id)+'">'+(job.status==="error"?"Retry / resume":"Resume")+'</button>':"")
    +(canUse?'<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button" data-download-action="save" data-download-id="'+esc(job.id)+'">Save file</button><button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" type="button" data-download-action="play" data-download-id="'+esc(job.id)+'">▶ Play downloaded</button>':"")
    +'<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" type="button" data-download-action="copy" data-download-id="'+esc(job.id)+'">Copy source link</button>'
    +'<button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" type="button" data-download-action="delete" data-download-id="'+esc(job.id)+'">Delete</button>'
    +'</div></article>';
}
function downloadJobsListHTML(){
  const jobs=sortedDownloadJobs();
  if(!jobs.length) return '<div class="download-empty"><h3>No downloads yet</h3><p>Use the Download button beside an episode, on a title page, or in the player. ZeroPlay will search for a verified direct file or M3U/HLS stream for that exact title first.</p></div>';
  return '<div class="download-list">'+jobs.map(downloadJobHTML).join("")+'</div>';
}
function renderDownloadJobLists(){
  const signature=sortedDownloadJobs().map(job=>[job.id,job.status,job.fileStored,job.chunksStored,job.filename,job.note||"",job.error||"",job.chunksTotal||0,job.totalBytes||0].join(":")).join("|");
  const containers=["downloadJobsList","downloadModalJobs"].map(id=>document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean);
  if(!containers.length){ downloadUiSignature=signature; updateDownloadMenuCount(); return; }
  if(signature!==downloadUiSignature){
    downloadUiSignature=signature;
    containers.forEach(el=>{ el.innerHTML=downloadJobsListHTML(); });
  }else{
    for(const job of sortedDownloadJobs()){
      containers.forEach(container=>{
        const row=container.querySelector('[data-download-job="'+String(job.id).replace(/["\\]/g,"\\$&")+'"]'); if(!row) return;
        const bar=row.querySelector(".download-progress i"); if(bar) bar.style.width=downloadProgress(job).toFixed(1)+"%";
        const stats=row.querySelector("[data-download-stats]");
        if(stats) stats.innerHTML=downloadStatsHTML(job);
      });
    }
  }
  const summary=document.getElementById("downloadSummary");
  if(summary){ const jobs=sortedDownloadJobs(); summary.textContent=jobs.filter(j=>j.status==="running").length+" downloading · "+jobs.filter(j=>j.status==="paused").length+" paused · "+jobs.filter(j=>j.status==="complete").length+" complete · "+fmtBytes(jobs.reduce((n,j)=>n+(Number(j.downloadedBytes)||0),0))+" stored/downloaded"; }
  updateDownloadMenuCount();
}
function queueDownloadUiRefresh(){
  if(downloadUiTimer) return;
  downloadUiTimer=setTimeout(()=>{ downloadUiTimer=0; renderDownloadJobLists(); },350);
}
async function copyTextToClipboard(text,label){
  try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast((label||"Link")+" copied","success"); return true; }catch{}
  const ta=document.createElement("textarea"); ta.value=text; ta.style.position="fixed"; ta.style.opacity="0"; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
  let ok=false; try{ ok=document.execCommand("copy"); }catch{}
  ta.remove(); toast(ok?(label||"Link")+" copied":"Copy failed — the browser blocked clipboard access",ok?"success":"error"); return ok;
}
async function handleDownloadAction(action,id,button){
  const job=downloadJobs.get(id); if(!job) return;
  try{
    if(button) button.disabled=true;
    if(action==="pause") pauseDownload(job);
    else if(action==="resume") resumeDownload(job);
    else if(action==="delete"){ if(window.confirm("Delete this download and its stored chunks?")) await deleteDownload(job); }
    else if(action==="save") await saveDownloadedFile(job);
    else if(action==="play") await playDownloadedFile(job);
    else if(action==="copy") await copyTextToClipboard(job.kind==="hls"?(job.playlistUrl||job.url):job.url,"Source link");
  }catch(e){ toast(e.message||String(e),"error"); }
  finally{ if(button&&button.isConnected) button.disabled=false; queueDownloadUiRefresh(); }
}
function directOptionsForDownload(options){
  const out=[];
  for(const option of options||[]){
    if(!option||option.kind!=="direct") continue;
    const variants=(option.variants&&option.variants.length?option.variants:(option.url?[{url:option.url,quality:"source"}]:[])).map(v=>normalizeVariant(v,option.name)).filter(v=>v&&isDirectMedia(v.url)&&directMediaKind(v.url)!=="dash");
    if(variants.length) out.push(Object.assign({},option,{variants}));
  }
  return out;
}
function downloadOptionsHTML(state){
  const options=directOptionsForDownload(state.options||[]);
  const seen=new Set(options.flatMap(o=>o.variants.map(v=>v.url)));
  const blocks=options.map((option,index)=>{
    const selectId="downloadVariant-"+index;
    return '<div class="src-row"><div class="grow"><span class="nm">'+esc(option.name||"Direct server")+'</span> <span class="chip rd">'+(option.verified?"Verified direct":"Exact-ID direct route")+'</span><div class="provider-meta">'+(option.verified?"Exact title match":"Direct route addressed by this title ID")+(option.identityScore?' · identity '+Math.round(option.identityScore)+"%":"")+' · '+(option.variants.some(v=>directMediaKind(v.url)==="hls")?"M3U/HLS available":"Direct media")+'</div></div><div class="src-actions"><label class="sr-only" for="'+selectId+'">Quality</label><select class="server-quality-select" id="'+selectId+'">'+option.variants.map((v,i)=>'<option value="'+i+'">'+esc(v.quality||"Source")+(v.bytes?' · '+fmtBytes(v.bytes):"")+(directMediaKind(v.url)==="hls"?' · M3U8':"")+'</option>').join("")+'</select><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button" data-download-option="'+index+'">⬇ Download</button></div></div>';
  });
  if(state.currentUrl&&/^https?:\/\//i.test(state.currentUrl)&&isDirectMedia(state.currentUrl)&&!seen.has(state.currentUrl)){
    blocks.unshift('<div class="src-row"><div class="grow"><span class="nm">'+esc(state.serverName||"Current stream")+'</span> <span class="chip violet">Now playing</span><div class="provider-meta">Download the direct stream already loaded in the player.</div></div><div class="src-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button" data-download-current="1">⬇ Download current stream</button></div></div>');
  }
  if(blocks.length) return blocks.join("");
  return state.done?'<div class="status-box error"><strong>No downloadable direct stream was returned for this exact title.</strong><br>Embedded players cannot be downloaded from the parent page. Try Sources → Find more, then try again.</div>':'<div class="server-skeleton"><span class="spinner"></span> Looking for a downloadable file…</div>';
}
function renderDownloadModalOptions(){
  const state=downloadModalState; if(!state) return;
  const box=document.getElementById("downloadOptions"); if(box) box.innerHTML=downloadOptionsHTML(state);
  const status=document.getElementById("downloadSearchStatus");

    const count=directOptionsForDownload(state.options||[]).reduce((n,o)=>n+o.variants.length,0);
    status.textContent=state.done?(count?count+" downloadable stream"+(count===1?"":"s")+" found for this exact title.":"Search complete."):"Searching only servers that can return this exact "+(state.ctx.type==="tv"?"episode":"movie")+"…";
  }
}
async function startDownloadFromModalOption(index){

  const select=document.getElementById("downloadVariant-"+index); const variant=option.variants[Number(select&&select.value)||0]||option.variants[0];

}
async function startDownloadCurrent(){
