function groupStreamsByServer(direct){
  const groups=new Map();
  for(const raw of (direct||[])){
    const variant=normalizeVariant(raw);
    if(!variant) continue;
    let key=variant.addonBase||variant.addonName||"direct";
    try{ if(!variant.addonBase) key=new URL(variant.url).hostname; }catch{}
    if(!groups.has(key)){
      const addon=enabledAddons().find(a=>a.base===variant.addonBase||a.name===variant.addonName)||null;
      groups.set(key,{
        id:"direct:"+encodeURIComponent(key),
        kind:"direct", status:"verified", verified:true,
        name:variant.addonName||(addon&&addon.name)||key,
        sourceId:addon?addon.id:"", source:addon||null,
        variants:[], identityScore:Number(variant.identityScore)||0, identityVerdict:variant.identityVerdict||"verified",
      });
    }
    const group=groups.get(key);
    if(!group.variants.some(v=>v.url===variant.url)) group.variants.push(variant);
    group.identityScore=Math.max(group.identityScore,Number(variant.identityScore)||0);
  }
  for(const group of groups.values()){
    group.variants=sortVariantsForQuality(group.variants,settings.stream.quality);
    group.url=group.variants[0]?group.variants[0].url:"";
    group.score=group.identityScore+Math.min(12,(group.variants[0]&&Number(group.variants[0].seeders))||0);
  }
  return [...groups.values()].sort((a,b)=>(b.score||0)-(a.score||0));
}
function sourceSupportsTitle(source,identity){
  if(!source||!identity) return {supported:false,reason:"missing source or title identity"};
  if(source.kind==="site") return {supported:true,needsLookup:true,reason:"website will be searched for the exact title"};
  if(source.kind==="addon"){
    const idn=source.identification||{};
    const supports=idn.supports||source.supports||{};
    if(identity.type==="movie"&&supports.movie===false) return {supported:false,reason:"provider does not identify as a movie server"};
    if(identity.type==="tv"&&(supports.series===false||supports.tv===false)) return {supported:false,reason:"provider does not identify as a series server"};
    return {supported:true,needsLookup:true,reason:"provider will be queried by catalogue identity"};
  }
  const tpl=identity.type==="tv"?(source.tvTpl||source.movieTpl||""):(source.movieTpl||"");
  if(["vidstuck","zxcstream","embedwave"].includes(source.id)) return {supported:!!identity.tmdbId,route:true,reason:"exact TMDB ID route"};
  if(!tpl&&source.kind==="custom") return {supported:false,reason:"no template for this media type"};
  if(/\{imdb\}/i.test(tpl)&&!identity.imdbId) return {supported:true,needsImdb:true,route:true,reason:"exact IMDb ID route after ID lookup"};
  if(/\{(tmdb|id)\}/i.test(tpl)&&!identity.tmdbId) return {supported:false,reason:"template needs a TMDB ID"};
  if(identity.type==="tv"&&tpl&&!/\{(season|episode|s|e)\}/i.test(tpl)&&!/(\/tv\/|\/series\/|season|episode)/i.test(tpl)) return {supported:false,reason:"template cannot address an episode"};
  return {supported:true,route:true,reason:"exact catalogue ID route"};
}
function sortTitleServerOptions(options){
  const rank=o=>o&&o.sourceId==="embedwave"?4:o&&o.kind==="direct"?0:o&&(o.kind==="site"||o.kind==="site-direct")?1:o&&o.status==="verified"?1:2;
  return (options||[]).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>rank(a)-rank(b)||((b.score||0)-(a.score||0))||healthScore(b.sourceId)-healthScore(a.sourceId)||String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));
}
async function runTitleChecks(items,limit,fn){
  const list=(items||[]).slice(); let i=0;
  const workers=Array.from({length:Math.max(1,Math.min(limit||3,list.length||1))},async()=>{
    while(i<list.length){ const item=list[i++]; try{ await fn(item); }catch{} }
  });
  await Promise.all(workers);
}
const titleServerCache=new Map();
function mergeServerFinderCandidates(records){
  const candidates=Array.isArray(records)?records:[],tombstones=settings.providerTombstones||{};
  let added=0,seen=0;
  const existingCandidates=(settings.providers||[]).filter(p=>p&&p.status==="candidate").length;
  const maxNew=Math.max(0,1000-existingCandidates);
  for(const record of candidates){
    if(seen>=maxNew) break;
    if(!record||record.status!=="candidate"||record.titleScopedDiscovery!==true||!record.base||!record.manifestUrl) continue;
    const base=String(record.base).replace(/\/$/,"");
    if(!isPublicHttpsProviderBase(base)||!isPublicHttpsProviderBase(record.manifestUrl)) continue;
    const supports=record.identification&&record.identification.supports||{};
    if(!supports.streams&&!((record.resources||[]).includes("stream"))) continue;
    const id=String(record.id||"");
    if(id&&tombstones[id]) continue;
    record.base=base; record.enabled=record.enabled!==false; record.status="candidate"; record.titleScopedDiscovery=true;
    const result=upsertProvider(record);
    if(result){ seen++; if(result.added) added++; }
  }
  if(seen) saveSettings();
  return {added,seen};
}
async function requestServerFinder(identity,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  const now=Date.now(),discovery=discoveryCfg();
  if(!opts.bypassCache&&Number(discovery.serverFinderLastAt||0)&&now-Number(discovery.serverFinderLastAt)<180000){
    return {cached:true,candidates:[],sources:[],candidateCount:0,mode:"browser-cache"};
  }
  const controller=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),18000);
  const abort=()=>controller.abort();
  if(opts.signal){ if(opts.signal.aborted) abort(); else opts.signal.addEventListener("abort",abort,{once:true}); }
  try{
    const response=await fetch("/api/find",{method:"POST",signal:controller.signal,headers:{Accept:"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"},cache:"no-store",credentials:"same-origin",body:JSON.stringify({identity:{title:identity.title,titles:identity.titles,type:identity.type,year:identity.year,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,imdbId:identity.imdbId,tmdbId:identity.tmdbId}})});
    if(!response.ok) throw new Error("finder unavailable");
    const data=await response.json();
    if(!data||!data.ok||!Array.isArray(data.candidates)) throw new Error("invalid finder response");
    const merged=mergeServerFinderCandidates(data.candidates);
    discovery.serverFinderLastAt=Date.now(); discovery.serverFinderCandidateCount=Number(data.candidateCount)||0; discovery.serverFinderMode=String(data.mode||"hosted");
    saveSettings();
    return Object.assign({},data,{added:merged.added,merged:merged.seen,cached:false});
  }catch(error){
    discovery.serverFinderLastAt=Date.now(); discovery.serverFinderCandidateCount=0; discovery.serverFinderMode="browser fallback";
    saveSettings();
    throw error;
  }finally{ clearTimeout(timer); if(opts.signal) opts.signal.removeEventListener("abort",abort); }
}
async function findTitleServers(ctx,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  ctx=Object.assign({},ctx||{});
  const identity=(ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx);
  const richCtx=Object.assign({},ctx,{identity,imdb:identity.imdbId||ctx.imdb||"",altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode});
  const providerInventory=enabledAddons().map(a=>String(a.id||"")+"@"+String(a.base||"")).sort().join("|");
  const candidateInventory=titleCandidateInventoryFingerprint();
  const cacheKey=identity.fingerprint+":"+identity.type+":"+identity.season+":"+identity.episode+":"+(settings.stream.quality||"auto")+":"+providerInventory+":"+candidateInventory;
  if(!opts.bypassCache){
    const cached=titleServerCache.get(cacheKey);
    if(cached&&Date.now()-cached.t<180000){ if(opts.onUpdate) opts.onUpdate(Object.assign({},cached.data,{complete:true,cached:true})); return cached.data; }
  }
  const byId=new Map();
  const stats={checkedRoutes:0,checkedWebsites:0,matchedWebsites:0,queriedProviders:0,totalProviders:enabledAddons().length,concurrency:Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Math.floor(Number(opts.concurrency)||100)||1,enabledAddons().length||1)),titleCandidatesQueried:0,titleCandidatesTotal:titleSearchCandidates(100).length,titleCandidatesAvailable:titleCandidatePool().length,titleCandidatesMatched:0,titleCandidateConcurrency:0,serverFinderStatus:"queued",serverFinderSourcesComplete:0,serverFinderSourcesTotal:3,serverFinderCandidates:0,serverFinderAdded:0,serverFinderMode:"",serverFinderError:"",serverFinderSourceStatus:[],identityVerified:0,identityRejected:0,torrents:0,oversize:0,external:0,catalogMatches:0,complete:false};
  let embedwaveOption=null;
  const snapshot=complete=>({options:sortTitleServerOptions([...byId.values()].concat(complete&&embedwaveOption?[embedwaveOption]:[])),stats:Object.assign({},stats,{complete:!!complete}),identity});
  const emit=()=>{ if(opts.onUpdate){ try{ opts.onUpdate(snapshot(false)); }catch{} } };
  const addOption=option=>{ if(!option) return; if(option.sourceId==="embedwave"){ embedwaveOption=option; return; } byId.set(option.id,option); emit(); };
  const runServerFinder=(async()=>{
    stats.serverFinderStatus="running"; stats.serverFinderError=""; emit();
    try{
      const found=await requestServerFinder(identity,{signal:opts.signal,bypassCache:!!opts.bypassCache});
      stats.serverFinderStatus=found.cached?"cached":"complete";
      stats.serverFinderSourcesComplete=Number(found.sourcesComplete)||0; stats.serverFinderSourcesTotal=Number(found.sourcesTotal)||3;
      stats.serverFinderCandidates=Number(found.candidateCount)||Number(discoveryCfg().serverFinderCandidateCount)||0;
      stats.serverFinderAdded=Number(found.added)||0; stats.serverFinderMode=String(found.mode||""); stats.serverFinderSourceStatus=Array.isArray(found.sources)?found.sources:[];
      if(found.sourcesFailed) stats.serverFinderError=found.sourcesFailed+" source"+(found.sourcesFailed===1?"":"s")+" unavailable";
    }catch(error){
      stats.serverFinderStatus=opts.signal&&opts.signal.aborted?"cancelled":"fallback";
      stats.serverFinderMode="browser fallback";
      stats.serverFinderError=opts.signal&&opts.signal.aborted?"Search cancelled":"Server Finder offline; browser discovery continues";
    }
    emit();
  })();
  /* 1) Built-in/custom exact-ID routes. These are not dumped blindly: a
        route appears only when it can address this TMDB/IMDb title (and
        episode). Cross-origin embeds cannot prove catalogue availability
        before loading, so the UI labels them honestly as exact-ID routes. */
  const routeSources=allSources().filter(s=>s.kind!=="addon"&&s.kind!=="site");
  const routeTask=(async()=>{
    await Promise.allSettled(routeSources.map(async source=>{
      if(opts.signal&&opts.signal.aborted) return;
      stats.checkedRoutes++;
      const support=sourceSupportsTitle(source,identity);
      if(!support.supported) return;
      const playback=await resolveSourcePlayback(source,richCtx);
      if(!playback||!playback.url) return;
      addOption({
        id:(playback.direct?"direct-route:":"route:")+source.id,
        kind:playback.direct?"direct":"route", status:playback.direct?"direct-route":"route", verified:false,
        name:source.name, sourceId:source.id, source, url:playback.url,
        variants:playback.variants||[], activeVariant:playback.activeVariant||null,
        score:45+Math.max(-20,Math.min(35,healthScore(source.id)/4)),
        evidence:support.reason,
      });
    }));
    emit();
  })();
  /* 2) Website checks and addon checks run together; return partial matches as
        each provider finishes instead of waiting for a whole category. */
  const sites=allSources().filter(s=>s.kind==="site");
  const websiteTask=(async()=>{
    await runTitleChecks(sites,Math.max(1,Math.min(12,Number(opts.websiteConcurrency)||6)),async source=>{
      if(opts.signal&&opts.signal.aborted) return;
      stats.checkedWebsites++;
      const found=await checkWebsiteAvailability(source,richCtx).catch(()=>null);
      if(!found||!found.matched){ emit(); return; }
      stats.matchedWebsites++;
      const direct=sortVariantsForQuality((found.direct||[]).map(url=>({url,addonName:source.name,label:found.pageTitle||found.watchTitle||source.name})),settings.stream.quality);
      if(found.playUrl&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl)&&!direct.some(v=>v.url===found.playUrl)) direct.unshift(normalizeVariant({url:found.playUrl,addonName:source.name,label:found.pageTitle||source.name},source.name));
      addOption({
        id:"site:"+source.id,
        kind:direct.length&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl||direct[0].url)?"direct":"site",
        status:"verified", verified:true,
        name:source.name, sourceId:source.id, source, url:found.playUrl||found.watchUrl||found.embed||"",
        variants:direct, activeVariant:direct.find(v=>v.url===found.playUrl)||direct[0]||null,
        identityScore:Number(found.identity&&found.identity.score)||0, identityVerdict:found.identity&&found.identity.verdict||"website identity verified",
        score:70+(Number(found.identity&&found.identity.score)||0)/4,
        evidence:"website returned and identity-verified this title",
      });
    });
    emit();
  })();
  /* 3) Identified addon/direct servers: only servers returning verified
        streams for this exact movie/episode become options, grouped by
        server with their real quality variants. */
  let addonSearchActive=true, quickSearchDetached=false;
  const runAddons=collectAllStreams(richCtx,{
    concurrency:opts.concurrency||100,
    signal:opts.signal,
    shouldContinue:()=>addonSearchActive&&(quickSearchDetached||!opts.shouldContinue||opts.shouldContinue()),
    onProgress:agg=>{
      stats.queriedProviders=agg.queried; stats.totalProviders=agg.totalAddons; stats.concurrency=agg.concurrency; stats.identityVerified=agg.identityVerified; stats.identityRejected=agg.identityRejected; stats.torrents=agg.torrents; stats.oversize=agg.oversize; stats.external=agg.external; stats.catalogMatches=agg.catalogMatches;
      for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(agg.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
      emit();
    }
  });
  /* Candidate search reads only the current registry snapshot. The separate
     continuous crawler discovers and identifies new servers on its own timer. */
  const runCandidates=runServerFinder.then(()=>collectTitleCandidateStreams(richCtx,{
    limit:100,concurrency:12,signal:opts.signal,
    shouldContinue:()=>addonSearchActive&&(quickSearchDetached||!opts.shouldContinue||opts.shouldContinue()),
    onProgress:found=>{
      stats.titleCandidatesQueried=found.queried; stats.titleCandidatesTotal=found.totalCandidates; stats.titleCandidatesAvailable=found.availableCandidates; stats.titleCandidatesMatched=found.matchedProviders; stats.titleCandidateConcurrency=found.concurrency;
      for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(found.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
      emit();
    }
  }));
  const runTitleCandidates=Promise.all([runAddons,runCandidates]).then(([providerAgg,candidateAgg])=>{
    providerAgg.titleCandidateAgg=candidateAgg;
    for(const stream of candidateAgg.direct||[]) if(stream&&stream.url&&!providerAgg.direct.some(existing=>existing.url===stream.url)) providerAgg.direct.push(stream);
    return providerAgg;
  });
  const runAllSearches=runTitleCandidates;
  let agg=null;
  if(opts.quick){
    /* Quick playback failover races only the direct-provider scan; slower web
       engines continue alongside it and update the open modal independently. */
    agg=await Promise.race([runTitleCandidates,new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(()=>resolve(null),Math.max(5000,Number(opts.quickTimeoutMs)||10000)))]);
    if(!agg){
      /* A quick caller can consume playable results while title-scoped
         provider checks continue and emit live updates. */
      quickSearchDetached=true;
      runAllSearches.then(async fullAgg=>{
        addonSearchActive=false;
        await Promise.allSettled([routeTask,websiteTask]);
        stats.queriedProviders=fullAgg.queried; stats.totalProviders=fullAgg.totalAddons; stats.concurrency=fullAgg.concurrency;
        stats.identityVerified=fullAgg.identityVerified; stats.identityRejected=fullAgg.identityRejected; stats.torrents=fullAgg.torrents; stats.oversize=fullAgg.oversize; stats.external=fullAgg.external; stats.catalogMatches=fullAgg.catalogMatches;
        const candidateStats=fullAgg.titleCandidateAgg||{};
        stats.titleCandidatesQueried=candidateStats.queried||0; stats.titleCandidatesTotal=candidateStats.totalCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesAvailable=candidateStats.availableCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesMatched=candidateStats.matchedProviders||0; stats.titleCandidateConcurrency=candidateStats.concurrency||0;
        for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(fullAgg.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
        const completed=snapshot(true); completed.agg=fullAgg;
        if(opts.onUpdate){ try{ opts.onUpdate(completed); }catch{} }
      }).catch(()=>{});
      const partial=snapshot(false); partial.agg=null;
      return partial;
    }
  }else agg=await runAllSearches;
  addonSearchActive=false;
  await Promise.allSettled([routeTask,websiteTask]);
  if(agg){
    stats.queriedProviders=agg.queried; stats.concurrency=agg.concurrency; stats.identityVerified=agg.identityVerified; stats.identityRejected=agg.identityRejected; stats.torrents=agg.torrents; stats.oversize=agg.oversize; stats.external=agg.external; stats.catalogMatches=agg.catalogMatches;
    const candidateStats=agg.titleCandidateAgg||{};
    stats.titleCandidatesQueried=candidateStats.queried||0; stats.titleCandidatesTotal=candidateStats.totalCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesAvailable=candidateStats.availableCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesMatched=candidateStats.matchedProviders||0; stats.titleCandidateConcurrency=candidateStats.concurrency||0;
    for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(agg.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
  }
  const result=snapshot(true);
  result.agg=agg;
  if(!opts.quick&&!(agg&&agg.aborted)){
    const latestInventory=enabledAddons().map(a=>String(a.id||"")+"@"+String(a.base||"")).sort().join("|");
    const checkedCandidateInventory=agg&&agg.titleCandidateAgg?agg.titleCandidateAgg.candidateInventory:titleCandidateInventoryFingerprint();
    const latestCacheKey=identity.fingerprint+":"+identity.type+":"+identity.season+":"+identity.episode+":"+(settings.stream.quality||"auto")+":"+latestInventory+":"+checkedCandidateInventory;
    titleServerCache.set(latestCacheKey,{t:Date.now(),data:result});
  }
  if(opts.onUpdate){ try{ opts.onUpdate(result); }catch{} }
  return result;
}
async function playTitleServerOption(option,ctx,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!option) return;
  ctx=Object.assign({},ctx||{});
  const identity=(ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx);
  ctx.identity=identity;
  const item=ctx.item||snap(catalogItemFor(ctx.type||identity.type,ctx.id||identity.tmdbId),identity.type);
  const variants=sortVariantsForQuality(option.variants||[],settings.stream.quality);
  const selected=opts.variant?normalizeVariant(opts.variant):(option.kind==="direct"?(chooseVariantForQuality(variants,settings.stream.quality,"")||variants[0]||(option.url?normalizeVariant({url:option.url,addonName:option.name},option.name):null)):null);
  if(playerState&&opts.fromPlayer){
    const st=playerState;
    st.currentServerOptionId=option.id; st.tried.add(option.id); if(option.sourceId) st.tried.add(option.sourceId);
    st.identity=identity;
    if(option.kind==="direct"&&selected){
      st.source=option.sourceId||st.source; st.tempSource=option.source&&option.source.kind?null:st.tempSource;
      st.variants=variants.length?variants:[selected]; st.activeVariant=selected; st.directUrl=selected.url; st.directQueue=st.variants.filter(v=>v.url!==selected.url);
      await switchDirectVariant(selected,{keepTime:opts.keepTime!==false,reason:"server"});
      return;
    }
    const at=currentPlaybackTime();
    const prev=Object.assign({},progress[keyOf(st.item.type,st.item.id)]||{},{season:st.season,episode:st.episode,timestamp:at>30?at:0,position:at>30?at:0,percent:st.playback&&st.playback.duration?Math.round(at/st.playback.duration*100):0});
    savePlaybackProgress(true);
    st.source=option.sourceId||st.source; st.tempSource=option.source&&!getSource(option.sourceId)?option.source:null;
    st.directUrl=""; st.variants=[]; st.activeVariant=null; st.levels=[];
    await drawPlayer(prev);
    return;
  }
  if(detailState) closeDetail();
  if(option.kind==="direct"&&selected){
    playResolvedURL(selected.url,item,option.name,variants,{ctx,identity,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,sourceId:option.sourceId||"",source:option.source&&!getSource(option.sourceId)?option.source:null,optionId:option.id,activeVariant:selected,variants});
    if(playerState) playerState.availableServers=opts.availableServers||playerState.availableServers||[];
    return;
  }
  await openPlayer(item,{season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,source:option.sourceId||defaultSourceId()});
  if(playerState){ playerState.currentServerOptionId=option.id; if(opts.availableServers) playerState.availableServers=opts.availableServers; }
}
async function resolveAddonURL(source, ctx){
  const addon = enabledAddons().find(a=>a.id===source.id) || source;
  const res = await queryAddonStreams(addon, ctx);
  if(!res.direct.length) throw new Error(addon.name+": no identity-verified direct streams ("+res.torrents+" torrent-only hidden"+(res.oversize?", "+res.oversize+" over "+capGb()+" GB cap":"")+(res.identityRejected?", "+res.identityRejected+" rejected by title identifier":"")+")");
  return res.direct[0].url;
}

/* ---- website lookup sources (paste a site; catalogue titles stay in ZeroPlay) ---- */
async function resolverCall(params){
  const qs=new URLSearchParams();
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(params||{})) if(v!==undefined&&v!==null&&v!=="") qs.set(k,String(v));
  const r=await fetch("/api/extract?"+qs.toString());
  let data=null; try{ data=await r.json(); }catch{}
  if(!r.ok||!data||data.ok===false) throw new Error((data&&data.error)||("Website lookup service unavailable (HTTP "+r.status+")"));
  return data;
}
async function registerWebsiteSource(rawUrl, manual, preferredName, opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  let u=null;
  try{ u=new URL(String(rawUrl||"").includes("://")?String(rawUrl):"https://"+String(rawUrl||"")); }catch{}
  if(!u||(u.protocol!=="https:"&&u.protocol!=="http:")) throw new Error("Paste a valid website link first");
  if(isDirectMedia(u.href)) throw new Error("That is a direct media file, not a website. Use “Play a link now” for one-off files.");
  if(/\{(tmdb|imdb|id|season|episode|type)\}/.test(u.href)) throw new Error("That is an explicit URL template — use “Add template source” instead.");
  const id="site:"+u.hostname.toLowerCase();
  const force=!!(manual||opts.force);
  if(!force&&settings.providerTombstones&&settings.providerTombstones[id]) throw new Error("This website was removed and will not be re-added by the crawler");
  const existingSite=(settings.sites||[]).find(site=>site.id===id);
  const existingProvider=getProvider(id);
  const profile=await resolverCall({mode:"profile",url:u.href});
  const name=String(preferredName||existingSite&&existingSite.name||prettyHostName(u.hostname)).trim().slice(0,40)||prettyHostName(u.hostname);
  settings.sites=(settings.sites||[]).filter(site=>site.id!==id);
  const enabled=force?true:(existingSite?existingSite.enabled!==false:(existingProvider?existingProvider.enabled!==false:true));
  const site={id,name,base:profile.origin||u.origin,home:profile.url||u.href,enabled,lookup:"dynamic",searchTemplate:profile.searchTemplate||"",addedAt:(existingSite&&existingSite.addedAt)||Date.now()};
  settings.sites.push(site);
  if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(settings,"siteCatalogues")) delete settings.siteCatalogues;
  upsertProvider(identifyWebsiteProvider(site,profile,manual?"manual website":"continuous crawler"),{force});
  saveSettings();
  dlog("Website server identified and added: "+name+" ("+u.hostname+") — lookup only, no titles or covers imported");
  if(manual) toast(name+" identified and added as a lookup server","success");
  return profile;
}
function canonicalCatalogueTitle(ctx){
  return String((ctx&&ctx.title)||"").replace(/\s*\(source test\)\s*$/i,"").trim();
}
const siteLookupCache=new Map();
async function findOnWebsite(source, ctx){
  const site=(settings.sites||[]).find(x=>x.id===source.id)||source;
  const identity=(ctx&&ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx||{});
  const title=identity.title||canonicalCatalogueTitle(ctx);
  if(!title) throw new Error((source.name||"Website")+" lookup needs the catalogue title");
  const key=[source.id,identity.fingerprint,identity.type,identity.season||1,identity.episode||1].join(":");
  const cached=siteLookupCache.get(key);
  if(cached&&Date.now()-cached.t<(cached.data.matched?900000:300000)) return cached.data;
  const data=await resolverCall({
    mode:"find",
    url:site.home||site.base||source.home||source.base,
    q:title,
    alt:(identity.titles||[]).slice(1).filter(Boolean).join("|"),
    type:identity.type||ctx.type||"movie",
    year:identity.year||ctx.year||"",
    season:identity.season||ctx.season||1,
    episode:identity.episode||ctx.episode||1,
    imdb:identity.imdbId||ctx.imdb||"",
    tmdb:identity.tmdbId||ctx.id||"",
    searchTemplate:site.searchTemplate||source.searchTemplate||""
  });
  const serverIdentity=data.identity||data.match||null;
  const localVerdict=identifyTitleCandidate({
    title:(data.match&&data.match.title)||data.watchTitle||data.title||"",
    url:data.playUrl||data.watchUrl||data.matchedUrl||"",
    imdbId:(serverIdentity&&serverIdentity.candidateIds&&serverIdentity.candidateIds.imdbId)||"",
    tmdbId:(serverIdentity&&serverIdentity.candidateIds&&serverIdentity.candidateIds.tmdbId)||null
  },identity,{threshold:80});
  const serverAccepted=!!(serverIdentity&&Number(serverIdentity.score)>=80&&serverIdentity.hardReject!==true);
  data.identity=Object.assign({},localVerdict,{
    accepted:!localVerdict.hardReject&&(serverAccepted||localVerdict.accepted),
    score:Math.max(Number(localVerdict.score)||0,serverAccepted?Number(serverIdentity.score)||0:0),
    server:serverIdentity
  });
  data.matched=!!(data.matched&&data.identity.accepted);
  if(data.matched){
    const provider=getProvider(source.id);
    if(provider){ provider.lastCheckedAt=Date.now(); provider.lastError=""; provider.lastIdentityMatch={fingerprint:identity.fingerprint,score:data.identity.score,at:Date.now()}; saveSettings(); }
  }
  siteLookupCache.set(key,{t:Date.now(),data});
  return data;
}
async function checkWebsiteAvailability(source, ctx){
  try{ return await findOnWebsite(source,ctx); }
  catch(e){ return {matched:false,error:e.message||String(e)}; }
}
async function resolveSiteURL(source, ctx){
  const found=await findOnWebsite(source,ctx);
  if(!found.matched||!found.playUrl) throw new Error("“"+canonicalCatalogueTitle(ctx)+"” was not identity-verified on "+source.name);
  return found.playUrl;
}
async function addWebsiteSourceFlow(){
  const raw=($("#pasteLink").value||"").trim();
  const note=(msg,type)=>{ const n=$("#detectNote"); if(n){ n.textContent=msg; n.className="status-box "+type; } };
  if(!raw){ note("Paste a website homepage or title-page link first.","error"); return; }
  const btn=$("#btnAddWebsite");
  if(btn){ btn.disabled=true; btn.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Checking website lookup…'; }
  note("Checking how this website searches — no covers or titles will be imported.","info");
  try{
    await registerWebsiteSource(raw,true,($("#srcName").value||"").trim());
    note("Website added as a lookup source. Pick any existing catalogue title and ZeroPlay will check this site at play time.","success");
    renderSources(true);
  }catch(e){
    note(""+(e.message||e),"error");
    if(btn){ btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent="Add website lookup"; }
  }
}

/* ---- Title-specific servers modal: only matched servers/routes are listed ---- */
let streamsCtx=null;
function closeStreams(){
  if(streamsCtx&&streamsCtx._searchAbort) streamsCtx._searchAbort.abort();
  $("#streamsRoot").innerHTML=""; streamsCtx=null;
  if(!playerState&&!detailState) document.body.classList.remove("locked");
  if(document.body.classList.contains("tv-mode")) setTimeout(()=>{ const target=document.getElementById("btnPlayerServers")||document.getElementById("btnStreams"); if(target) target.focus({preventScroll:true}); },30);
}
function serverOptionHTML(option){
  const variants=sortVariantsForQuality(option.variants||[],settings.stream.quality);
  const qualityChoices=variantQualityOptions(variants);
  const best=variants[0]||option.activeVariant||null;
  const verified=!!option.verified;
  const badge=verified?'<span class="chip rd">Has this title'+(option.identityScore?(" · "+Math.round(option.identityScore)+"%"):"")+'</span> ':(option.kind==="route"?'<span class="chip violet">Exact ID route</span> ':'<span class="chip">Direct route</span> ');
  const qualitySelect=variants.length?'<select class="server-quality-select" data-server-quality="'+esc(option.id)+'" aria-label="Quality for '+esc(option.name)+'"><option value="auto">Auto quality</option>'+qualityChoices.map(q=>'<option value="'+esc(q.value)+'"'+(settings.stream.quality===q.value?" selected":"")+">"+esc(q.label)+"</option>").join("")+"</select>":"";
  const variantMeta=variants.length?'<div class="variant-chips">'+qualityChoices.slice(0,5).map(q=>'<span>'+esc(q.label)+'</span>').join("")+(best&&best.bytes?'<span>'+fmtBytes(best.bytes)+'</span>':"")+(best&&best.seeders!=null?'<span>👤 '+best.seeders+'</span>':"")+(best&&best.notWebReady?'<span>may not play in browser</span>':"")+"</div>":"";
  return '<div class="src-row server-option"><div class="grow"><span class="nm">'+esc(option.name)+'</span> '+badge+(option.sourceId==="embedwave"?'<span class="chip">LAST RESORT</span> ':"")+(option.sourceId?healthBadge(option.sourceId):"")
    +'<code>'+esc(best?(best.label+(best.sub?(" — "+best.sub):"")):(option.evidence||""))+'</code>'+variantMeta
    +(option.evidence&&best?'<div class="help-text">'+esc(option.evidence)+'</div>':"")
    +'</div><div class="src-actions">'+qualitySelect+'<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" data-server-option="'+esc(option.id)+'">▶ Play</button>'+(downloadsEnabled()&&option.kind==="direct"&&variants.some(v=>directMediaKind(v.url)!=="dash")?'<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-xs" type="button" data-server-download="'+esc(option.id)+'">⬇ Download</button>':"")+'</div></div>';
}
function serverFinderProgressHTML(stats){
  stats=stats||{};
  const status=String(stats.serverFinderStatus||"queued"),total=Math.max(1,Number(stats.serverFinderSourcesTotal)||3);
  const complete=Math.min(total,Number(stats.serverFinderSourcesComplete)||0),count=Number(stats.serverFinderCandidates)||0;
  const active=status==="running";
  const headline=status==="running"?"Searching discovery sources":status==="complete"?"Server discovery complete":status==="cached"?"Using recent candidate cache":status==="fallback"?"Browser-only fallback active":status==="cancelled"?"Server discovery cancelled":"Server discovery queued";
  const detail=status==="running"?"Three bounded sources · worker pool · candidate registry capped at 1,000":status==="complete"?count+" stream-capable candidates found · title verification still required":status==="cached"?count+" saved candidates available · continuing exact-title scan":status==="fallback"?"Server API unavailable · existing browser crawlers continue independently":status==="cancelled"?"The title search was cancelled":"Local sidecar or hosted API will discover public server manifests";
  const progress=active?'<progress max="'+total+'" value="'+complete+'" aria-label="'+esc(complete+" of "+total+" crawler sources finished")+'"></progress>':"";
  const sourceNames={"stremio-addons":"Stremio Addons","catalog-graph":"Catalog graph",github:"GitHub"};
  const sources=(stats.serverFinderSourceStatus||[]).map(source=>'<span class="discovery-source-status '+esc(source.status||"queued")+'">'+esc(sourceNames[source.id]||source.id)+' · '+(source.status==="failed"?"unavailable":source.status==="partial"?"partial · "+Number(source.candidates||0)+" candidates":Number(source.candidates||0)+" candidates")+'</span>').join("");
  return '<div class="server-finder-progress" role="status" aria-live="polite"><div class="server-finder-progress-head"><strong>'+esc(headline)+'</strong><span>'+esc(active?complete+"/"+total+" sources":(stats.serverFinderMode||"server finder"))+'</span></div>'+progress+'<div class="help-text">'+esc(stats.serverFinderError||detail)+'</div>'+(sources?'<div class="discovery-source-statuses">'+sources+'</div>':"")+'</div>';
}
function renderTitleServerOptions(){
  const finderBox=document.getElementById("serverFinderProgress");
  if(finderBox) finderBox.innerHTML=serverFinderProgressHTML(streamsCtx&&streamsCtx._stats||{});

  const c=streamsCtx; if(!c) return;
  const options=sortTitleServerOptions(c._options||[]);
  c._options=options;
  const direct=options.filter(o=>o.kind==="direct");
  const sites=options.filter(o=>o.kind==="site");
  const configuredSites=allSources(true).filter(source=>source.kind==="site");
  const enabledSiteCount=allSources().filter(source=>source.kind==="site").length;
  const routes=options.filter(o=>o.kind==="route");
  const searching=!c._searchDone;
  const empty=(title,body)=>searching?'<div class="server-skeleton"><span class="spinner"></span> Checking servers for this exact title…</div>':'<div class="empty"><h3>'+esc(title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(body)+'</p></div>';
  const directBox=document.getElementById("serverDirect");
  if(directBox) directBox.innerHTML=direct.length?direct.map(serverOptionHTML).join(""):empty("No direct file yet","ZeroPlay is still looking for this exact title.");
  const siteBox=document.getElementById("serverWebsites");
  if(siteBox) siteBox.innerHTML=sites.length?sites.map(serverOptionHTML).join(""):enabledSiteCount?empty("No website match yet","None of your enabled website lookups returned an identity-verified match for this title. Direct provider and exact-ID server searches run separately."):empty(configuredSites.length?"Website lookup is disabled":"No website lookup sources added",configuredSites.length?"Enable a website lookup source in More to check it. Direct provider and exact-ID server searches are separate.":"This optional section checks websites you add. Direct provider and exact-ID server searches are separate and continue independently.");
  const routeBox=document.getElementById("serverRoutes");
  if(routeBox) routeBox.innerHTML=routes.length?routes.map(serverOptionHTML).join(""):empty("No exact-ID player route","No enabled player template can address this title ID.");
  const race=document.getElementById("btnRace"); if(race) race.disabled=!direct.length;
  const status=document.getElementById("serverSearchStatus");
  if(status){
    const stats=c._stats||{};
    status.innerHTML=searching
      ? '<span class="spinner"></span> Searching only for <strong>'+esc(c.title||"this title")+'</strong>'+(stats.queriedProviders?(' · checked '+stats.queriedProviders+'/'+(stats.totalProviders|| enabledAddons().length)+' direct providers'):"")+(stats.concurrency?' · '+stats.concurrency+' active workers, scanning every enabled provider (100-worker max)':' · scanning every enabled provider (100-worker max)')+(stats.titleCandidatesTotal?' · checking up to '+stats.titleCandidatesTotal+' of '+stats.titleCandidatesAvailable+' title-scoped candidates; only exact-title stream matches are saved':"")+' · matches appear as they arrive'
      : '<strong>'+(direct.length+sites.length)+'</strong> verified server option'+((direct.length+sites.length)===1?"":"s")+' · <strong>'+routes.length+'</strong> exact-ID player route'+(routes.length===1?"":"s")+' · scanned all '+(stats.queriedProviders||stats.totalProviders||0)+' enabled direct providers'+(stats.titleCandidatesQueried?' · checked '+stats.titleCandidatesQueried+' title candidates and saved '+stats.titleCandidatesMatched+' title-matched provider'+(stats.titleCandidatesMatched===1?"":"s"):"")+' · unrelated servers hidden';
  }
  const cnt=document.getElementById("streamCounts");
  if(cnt&&c._stats){
    const s=c._stats;
    cnt.textContent="Checked "+s.checkedRoutes+" exact-ID routes · "+s.checkedWebsites+" website lookup servers ("+s.matchedWebsites+" matched) · "+(s.queriedProviders||0)+"/"+(s.totalProviders||0)+" enabled direct providers · "+(s.titleCandidatesQueried||0)+" checked this pass from "+(s.titleCandidatesAvailable||0)+" title candidates ("+(s.titleCandidatesMatched||0)+" matched and saved) · "+(s.identityVerified||0)+" verified streams · "+(s.identityRejected||0)+" rejected as wrong title/episode · "+(s.torrents||0)+" torrents hidden · "+(s.oversize||0)+" over the "+capGb()+" GB cap hidden.";
  }
  if(playerState&&c.fromPlayer){ playerState.availableServers=options; playerState.availabilityChecked=!!c._searchDone; updatePlayerMeta(); }
}
async function showStreamsModal(ctx){
  stopCardPreview();
  ctx=Object.assign({},ctx||{});
  ctx.identity=(ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx);
  ctx.title=ctx.identity.title||ctx.title;
  ctx.altTitles=ctx.identity.titles||ctx.altTitles||[];
  ctx.year=ctx.identity.year||ctx.year||"";
  ctx.season=ctx.identity.season||ctx.season||1;
  ctx.episode=ctx.identity.episode||ctx.episode||1;
  ctx.imdb=ctx.identity.imdbId||ctx.imdb||"";
  if(!ctx.item) ctx.item=snap(catalogItemFor(ctx.type||ctx.identity.type,ctx.id||ctx.identity.tmdbId),ctx.identity.type);
  const token=Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  streamsCtx=Object.assign(ctx,{_token:token,_options:[],_direct:[],_searchDone:false,_stats:null});
  if(playerState&&ctx.fromPlayer&&Array.isArray(playerState.availableServers)&&playerState.availableServers.length) streamsCtx._options=playerState.availableServers.slice();
  document.body.classList.add("locked");
  $("#streamsRoot").innerHTML='<div class="overlay" id="streamsOverlay"><div class="modal"><button class="icon-btn modal-close" id="btnCloseStreams" aria-label="Close">×</button>'
    +'<div style="padding:1.6rem 1.8rem 1.8rem"><div class="streams-hero"><img src="'+esc(posterURL(ctx.item,"w185"))+'" alt="" data-seed="'+esc(ctx.id||"")+'"><div><span class="logo-badge" style="margin-bottom:.6rem">Servers with this title</span>'
    +'<h2 style="color:var(--text-heading)">'+esc(ctx.title||"Stream")+(ctx.type==='tv'?' <span class="chip violet">S'+(ctx.season||1)+' · E'+(ctx.episode||1)+'</span>':'')+(ctx.year?' <span class="chip">'+esc(ctx.year)+'</span>':'')+'</h2>'
    +'<p class="section-desc" style="margin-bottom:0">ZeroPlay checks the canonical TMDB/IMDb identity, year, title variants and episode. Provider checks, title-scoped discovery, and the continuous provider crawler run separately.</p></div></div>'
    +'<div class="status-box info" id="serverSearchStatus"><span class="spinner"></span> Searching for this exact title…</div><div id="serverFinderProgress"></div>'
    +'<div class="streams-toolbar"><div class="form-group"><label for="streamQuality">Preferred quality</label><select id="streamQuality">'+[["auto","Auto — best stable"],["2160p","4K 2160p"],["1080p","1080p"],["720p","720p"],["480p","480p"]].map(([v,t])=>'<option value="'+v+'"'+(settings.stream.quality===v?' selected':'')+'>'+t+'</option>').join("")+'</select></div><button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnRace" disabled>Race verified streams</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnRefreshServers">Search again</button><span id="raceStatus" class="help-text" style="display:inline"></span></div>'
    +'<h3 class="category-heading">Verified direct servers</h3><div id="serverDirect"></div>'
    +'<h3 class="category-heading">Verified website servers</h3><p class="help-text">Optional: this section checks only website sources you add. It is separate from direct provider and exact-ID server searches.</p><div id="serverWebsites"></div>'
    +'<h3 class="category-heading">Exact-ID players</h3><p class="help-text">These players can address this exact catalogue ID. Cross-origin players cannot prove their library before loading, so ZeroPlay does not falsely label them “verified”. Embedwave remains last.</p><div id="serverRoutes"></div>'
    +'<div id="streamCounts" class="help-text"></div></div></div></div>';
  renderTitleServerOptions();
  $("#btnCloseStreams").onclick=closeStreams;
  $("#streamsOverlay").addEventListener("click",async e=>{
    if(e.target.id==="streamsOverlay"){ closeStreams(); return; }
    const downloadBtn=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-server-download]");
    if(downloadBtn&&streamsCtx&&streamsCtx._token===token){
      const option=(streamsCtx._options||[]).find(o=>o.id===downloadBtn.dataset.serverDownload); if(!option) return;
      const qualitySel=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-server-quality]")].find(el=>el.dataset.serverQuality===option.id);
      const variant=chooseVariantForQuality(option.variants||[],qualitySel?qualitySel.value:settings.stream.quality,"")||(option.variants||[])[0];
      if(!variant){ toast("That server did not return a downloadable direct variant","error"); return; }
      downloadBtn.disabled=true;
      try{ await createDownloadJob(variant,streamsCtx,option.name); toast("Download started in the background — open Downloads to pause or resume it","success"); }
      catch(err){ toast(err.message||String(err),"error"); }
      finally{ if(downloadBtn.isConnected) downloadBtn.disabled=false; }
      return;
    }
    const play=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-server-option]");
    if(!play||!streamsCtx||streamsCtx._token!==token) return;
    const option=(streamsCtx._options||[]).find(o=>o.id===play.dataset.serverOption);
    if(!option) return;
    const qualitySel=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-server-quality]")].find(el=>el.dataset.serverQuality===option.id);
    let variant=null;
    if(option.variants&&option.variants.length) variant=chooseVariantForQuality(option.variants,qualitySel?qualitySel.value:settings.stream.quality,"")||option.variants[0];
    const c=streamsCtx, available=(streamsCtx._options||[]).slice(), fromPlayer=!!c.fromPlayer;
    closeStreams();
    await playTitleServerOption(option,c,{fromPlayer,variant,availableServers:available,keepTime:true});
  });
  $("#streamQuality").addEventListener("change",e=>{
    settings.stream.quality=e.target.value; applyQualityPreset(e.target.value); saveSettings();
    if(streamsCtx){ streamsCtx._options=sortTitleServerOptions(streamsCtx._options||[]); renderTitleServerOptions(); }
  });
  $("#btnRace").onclick=async()=>{
    const btn=$("#btnRace"), status=$("#raceStatus");
    const options=(streamsCtx&&streamsCtx._options||[]).filter(o=>o.kind==="direct"&&(o.variants||[]).length);
    const candidates=[];
    for(const option of options){ const best=chooseVariantForQuality(option.variants,settings.stream.quality,"")||option.variants[0]; if(best) candidates.push({option,variant:best}); if(candidates.length>=6) break; }
    if(!candidates.length){ status.textContent="No verified direct streams to race yet."; return; }
    btn.disabled=true; status.textContent="Measuring "+candidates.length+" verified streams…";
    const speeds=await Promise.all(candidates.map(x=>measureSpeed(x.variant.url)));
    let best=0,bestV=0; speeds.forEach((v,i)=>{ if(v&&v>bestV){ bestV=v; best=i; } });
    const chosen=candidates[best];
    toast("Fastest verified stream: "+chosen.option.name+(bestV?(" at "+bestV.toFixed(1)+" MB/s"):" (speed unmeasurable — best ranked)"),"success");
    const c=streamsCtx, available=(streamsCtx._options||[]).slice(), fromPlayer=!!c.fromPlayer;
    closeStreams();
    await playTitleServerOption(chosen.option,c,{fromPlayer,variant:chosen.variant,availableServers:available,keepTime:true});
  };
  const runSearch=async bypassCache=>{
    if(!streamsCtx||streamsCtx._token!==token) return;
    if(streamsCtx._searchAbort) streamsCtx._searchAbort.abort();
    const searchController=new AbortController(); streamsCtx._searchAbort=searchController;
    streamsCtx._searchDone=false; renderTitleServerOptions();
    const result=await findTitleServers(ctx,{signal:searchController.signal,bypassCache:!!bypassCache,shouldContinue:()=>!!streamsCtx&&streamsCtx._token===token&&streamsCtx._searchAbort===searchController,onUpdate:partial=>{
      if(!streamsCtx||streamsCtx._token!==token||streamsCtx._searchAbort!==searchController) return;
      streamsCtx._options=partial.options||[];
      streamsCtx._stats=partial.stats||{};
      streamsCtx._direct=(partial.options||[]).filter(o=>o.kind==="direct").flatMap(o=>o.variants||[]);
      renderTitleServerOptions();
    }});
    if(!streamsCtx||streamsCtx._token!==token||streamsCtx._searchAbort!==searchController) return;
    streamsCtx._options=result.options||[]; streamsCtx._stats=result.stats||{}; streamsCtx._direct=(result.options||[]).filter(o=>o.kind==="direct").flatMap(o=>o.variants||[]); streamsCtx._searchDone=true;
    renderTitleServerOptions();
  };
  $("#btnRefreshServers").onclick=()=>runSearch(true);
  if(document.body.classList.contains("tv-mode")) setTimeout(()=>{ const first=$("#btnCloseStreams"); if(first) first.focus({preventScroll:true}); },30);
  await runSearch(false);
}

function providerSearchText(p){
  const idn=p.identification||{}; const supports=idn.supports||{};
  return [p.name,p.kind,p.status,p.endpoint,p.base,p.manifestUrl,p.repoUrl,p.homepage,p.description,p.source,p.from,
    (p.categories||[]).join(" "),(p.tags||[]).join(" "),(p.resources||[]).join(" "),(p.types||[]).join(" "),
    idn.kind,(idn.identifierModes||[]).join(" "),Object.keys(supports).filter(k=>supports[k]).join(" ")].filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
}
function providerFilteredList(){
  const q=String(providerUi.query||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  const list=(settings.providers||[]).filter(p=>{
    if(providerUi.category!=="all"&&!(p.categories||[]).includes(providerUi.category)) return false;
    if(providerUi.status==="installed"&&p.status!=="installed") return false;
    if(providerUi.status==="candidate"&&p.status==="installed") return false;
    if(providerUi.status==="disabled"&&p.enabled!==false) return false;
    if(q&&!providerSearchText(p).includes(q)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  list.sort((a,b)=>{
    const ai=a.status==="installed"?0:1, bi=b.status==="installed"?0:1;
    if(ai!==bi) return ai-bi;
    const ac=(a.identification&&a.identification.confidence)||0, bc=(b.identification&&b.identification.confidence)||0;
    if(bc!==ac) return bc-ac;
    return ((b.stars||0)-(a.stars||0))||((b.lastSeenAt||0)-(a.lastSeenAt||0))||String(a.name||"").localeCompare(String(b.name||""));
  });
  return list;
}
function providerSupportText(p){
  const s=(p.identification&&p.identification.supports)||{};
  const labels={movie:"Movies",series:"Series",streams:"Streams",catalog:"Catalogue search",meta:"Metadata",subtitles:"Subtitles",addonCatalog:"Finds more addons",search:"Search",episodeLookup:"Episode lookup"};
  const out=Object.keys(labels).filter(k=>s[k]).map(k=>labels[k]);
  return out.length?out.join(" · "):"Capabilities not identified yet";
}
function providerRowsHTML(){
  const filtered=providerFilteredList();
  const visible=filtered.slice(0,providerUi.limit);
  if(!visible.length) return '<div class="empty"><h3>No providers match</h3><p>Start continuous search, change the filter, or add a server/addon/GitHub seed above.</p></div>';
  const rows=visible.map(p=>{
    const idn=p.identification||{};
    const installed=p.status==="installed";
    const status=p.enabled===false?"Off":installed?"Ready":"Being checked";
    const categoryText=(p.categories||[]).map(c=>{ const f=PROVIDER_CATEGORIES.find(x=>x[0]===c); return f?f[1]:c; }).join(", ")||"Uncategorised";
    const healthId=p.base&&(p.categories||[]).includes("streams")?("addon:"+p.base):p.id;
    const endpoint=p.repoUrl||p.manifestUrl||p.endpoint||p.base||p.home||"";
    const modes=(idn.identifierModes||[]).join(", ")||"not identified";
    const confidence=idn.confidence!=null?(" · confidence "+idn.confidence+"%"):"";
    const checks=(idn.checks||[]).join(" · ");
    return '<div class="src-row provider-row"><div class="grow"><span class="nm">'+esc(p.name||"Provider")+'</span> '
      +'<span class="provider-status '+(installed?"installed":"candidate")+'">'+esc(status)+'</span> '
      +(p.stars?'<span class="meta-inline">★ '+esc(p.stars)+'</span> ':"")+healthBadge(healthId)
      +'<div class="provider-meta">'+esc(categoryText)+' · '+esc(providerSupportText(p))+'</div>'
      +'<div class="provider-meta">Server type: '+esc(idn.kind||p.kind||"unknown")+esc(confidence)+' · Title identification: '+esc(modes)+'</div>'
      +(p.description?'<div class="provider-desc">'+esc(p.description)+'</div>':"")
      +(p.titleScopedDiscovery&&!installed?'<div class="provider-checks">Only added to playback after returning a verified stream for the exact title you search.</div>':"")
      +(checks?'<div class="provider-checks">'+esc(checks)+'</div>':"")
      +(p.lastError?'<div class="provider-error">'+esc(p.lastError)+'</div>':"")
      +'<code>'+esc(endpoint)+(p.source?(" · via "+p.source):"")+'</code></div>'
      +'<div class="src-actions">'
      +(!installed&&!p.titleScopedDiscovery?'<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" data-provider-install="'+esc(p.id)+'">Identify &amp; add</button>':"")
      +'<button class="btn btn-outline btn-xs" type="button" data-provider-toggle="'+esc(p.id)+'">'+(p.enabled!==false?"Disable":"Enable")+'</button>'
      +(endpoint?'<a class="btn btn-outline btn-xs" href="'+esc(endpoint)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a>':"")
      +'<button class="btn btn-danger btn-xs" type="button" data-provider-remove="'+esc(p.id)+'">Remove</button>'
      +'</div></div>';
  }).join("");
  return rows+(filtered.length>visible.length?'<div class="load-more"><button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" data-provider-more="1">Show more providers ('+visible.length+' of '+filtered.length+')</button></div>':"");
}
function refreshProviderList(){
  const list=document.getElementById("providerList");
  const counts=document.getElementById("providerCounts");
  if(list) list.innerHTML=providerRowsHTML();
  if(counts){ const c=providerCounts(); counts.textContent=c.all+" saved · "+c.installed+" ready · "+c.candidate+" being checked."; }
  const status=document.getElementById("discoveryStatus"); if(status) status.textContent=discoveryStatusText();
}

    +'<div class="seed-add"><div class="form-group grow"><label for="providerSeedUrl">Add a server, addon, GitHub project, feed or website</label><input type="text" id="providerSeedUrl" placeholder="Paste a manifest URL, server URL, github.com/owner/repo, JSON feed or website"></div><button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnAddProviderSeed" type="button">Identify &amp; add</button></div><div id="providerSeedStatus" class="status-box hidden"></div>'
    +'<details class="advanced"><summary>Crawlers, GitHub searches and feed</summary><div class="advanced-body">'
    +'<div class="crawler-grid">'+Object.keys(crawlerLabels).map(k=>'<label class="check-line"><input type="checkbox" data-crawler-toggle="'+k+'"'+(cfg.crawlers[k]!==false?" checked":"")+'><span>'+esc(crawlerLabels[k])+'</span></label>').join("")+'</div>'
    +'<div class="form-row"><div class="form-group"><label for="discoveryInterval">Search cycle</label><select id="discoveryInterval">'+[30,60,90,180,300,600].map(s=>'<option value="'+s+'"'+(Number(cfg.intervalSec)===s?" selected":"")+">Every "+(s>=60?(s/60)+" min":s+" sec")+"</option>").join("")+"</select></div>"
    +'<div class="form-group"><label for="feedInterval">Feed check</label><select id="feedInterval">'+[5,15,30,60].map(m=>'<option value="'+m+'"'+(Number(fd.intervalMin)===m?" selected":"")+">Every "+m+" minutes</option>").join("")+"</select></div></div>"
    +'<div class="form-group"><label for="githubQueries">GitHub crawler searches (one per line)</label><textarea id="githubQueries" rows="5">'+esc((cfg.githubQueries||[]).join("\n"))+'</textarea><small class="help-text">The keyless GitHub API is rate-limited, so the crawler rotates one search page per cycle and backs off automatically.</small></div>'
    +'<div class="form-group"><label for="feedUrl">Provider/source feed URL (JSON)</label><input type="text" id="feedUrl" placeholder="https://example.com/providers.json" value="'+esc(fd.url||"")+'"><small class="help-text">Feeds may contain URL templates, manifest URLs, GitHub repositories, websites or nested provider lists. New endpoints are identified before use.</small></div>'
    +'<div class="form-row"><div class="form-group toggle-group"><label tabindex="0" data-switch-label="1" class="switch-label" for="feedAuto" style="position:relative"><span>Include feed in continuous search</span><input type="checkbox" id="feedAuto"'+(fd.auto?" checked":"")+'><span class="slider"></span></label></div><div class="form-group toggle-group"><label tabindex="0" data-switch-label="1" class="switch-label" for="healthAuto" style="position:relative"><span>Continuous health batches</span><input type="checkbox" id="healthAuto"'+(fd.healthAuto?" checked":"")+'><span class="slider"></span></label></div></div>'
    +'<div class="discovery-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnDiscoverySave" type="button">Save crawler settings</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnFeedNow" type="button">Check feed now</button></div>'
    +(seeds?'<h3 class="category-heading">Crawler seeds</h3><div id="seedList">'+seeds+'</div>':"")
    +'<h3 class="category-heading">Discovery activity</h3><ul class="log-list">'+(logs||'<li><span>—</span>No discovery events yet.</li>')+'</ul>'
    +'</div></details>'
    +'<div class="registry-head"><div><h3>Identified servers &amp; providers</h3><p class="section-desc">Installed providers are searchable later. Candidates stay out of playback until the identifier can prove what server they are and what they support.</p></div></div>'
    +'<div class="provider-filters"><div class="form-group grow"><label for="providerSearch">Search providers</label><input type="search" id="providerSearch" placeholder="Name, host, GitHub repo, capability, category…" value="'+esc(providerUi.query)+'"></div><div class="form-group"><label for="providerStatus">Status</label><select id="providerStatus"><option value="all"'+(providerUi.status==="all"?" selected":"")+'>All</option><option value="installed"'+(providerUi.status==="installed"?" selected":"")+'>Ready</option><option value="candidate"'+(providerUi.status==="candidate"?" selected":"")+'>Being checked</option><option value="disabled"'+(providerUi.status==="disabled"?" selected":"")+'>Disabled</option></select></div></div>'
    +'<div class="chip-row" id="providerCategories">'+categoryButtons+'</div>'
    +'<p class="help-text" id="providerCounts">'+counts.all+' saved · '+counts.installed+' ready · '+counts.candidate+' being checked.</p>'
    +'<div id="providerList">'+providerRowsHTML()+'</div>'
    +'<p class="help-text">Diagnostics only: results can come from public catalogues, websites and GitHub projects. Browser storage, CORS and rate limits still apply.</p></div></details>'
    +'</section>';
}
function wireAddonPanel(){
  const panel=document.getElementById("discoveryPanel");
  if(!panel) return;
  const saveDiscoverySettings=()=>{
    const cfg=discoveryCfg();
    const interval=document.getElementById("discoveryInterval"); if(interval) cfg.intervalSec=Number(interval.value)||90;
    const queries=document.getElementById("githubQueries"); if(queries) cfg.githubQueries=queries.value.split(/\n+/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const feedUrl=document.getElementById("feedUrl"); if(feedUrl) settings.feed.url=feedUrl.value.trim();
    const feedInterval=document.getElementById("feedInterval"); if(feedInterval) settings.feed.intervalMin=Number(feedInterval.value)||15;
    const feedAuto=document.getElementById("feedAuto"); if(feedAuto) settings.feed.auto=feedAuto.checked;
    const healthAuto=document.getElementById("healthAuto"); if(healthAuto){ settings.feed.healthAuto=healthAuto.checked; cfg.crawlers.health=healthAuto.checked; }
    saveSettings(); scheduleDiscovery();
  };
  const toggle=document.getElementById("btnDiscoveryToggle");
  if(toggle) toggle.onclick=()=>{ if(discoveryRuntime.running) stopDiscoveryEngine(true); else { startDiscoveryEngine(true,true); toast("Automatic source search is on","success"); } };
  const now=document.getElementById("btnDiscoveryNow");
  if(now) now.onclick=async e=>{ e.target.disabled=true; e.target.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Searching…'; await runDiscoveryCycle("manual"); };
  const health=document.getElementById("btnHealthNow");
  if(health) health.onclick=async e=>{ e.target.disabled=true; e.target.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Checking…'; await runHealthChecks(true,50); };
  const save=document.getElementById("btnDiscoverySave");
  if(save) save.onclick=()=>{ saveDiscoverySettings(); toast("Crawler settings saved","success"); renderSources(true); };
  const feedNow=document.getElementById("btnFeedNow");
  if(feedNow) feedNow.onclick=async e=>{ saveDiscoverySettings(); e.target.disabled=true; e.target.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Checking…'; await checkFeed(true); refreshProviderList(); };
  panel.querySelectorAll("[data-crawler-toggle]").forEach(cb=>cb.addEventListener("change",()=>{ discoveryCfg().crawlers[cb.dataset.crawlerToggle]=cb.checked; saveSettings(); }));
  const seedBtn=document.getElementById("btnAddProviderSeed");
  if(seedBtn) seedBtn.onclick=async()=>{
    const input=document.getElementById("providerSeedUrl"), box=document.getElementById("providerSeedStatus");
    const value=(input&&input.value||"").trim();
    if(box){ box.className="status-box info"; box.textContent="Identifying server…"; }
    seedBtn.disabled=true;
    try{
      const provider=await addDiscoverySeed(value,{from:"manual seed"});
      if(box){ box.className="status-box "+(provider&&provider.status==="installed"?"success":"info"); box.textContent=provider?(provider.status==="installed"?("Identified and installed: "+provider.name):("Added as a candidate for continued identification: "+provider.name)):"Seed saved for the continuous crawler."; }
      if(input) input.value="";
      refreshProviderList();
    }catch(e){ if(box){ box.className="status-box error"; box.textContent=e.message||String(e); } }
    seedBtn.disabled=false;
  };
  const search=document.getElementById("providerSearch");
  if(search) search.addEventListener("input",()=>{ providerUi.query=search.value; providerUi.limit=80; refreshProviderList(); const next=document.getElementById("providerSearch"); if(next&&document.activeElement!==next){ /* list-only refresh keeps focus */ } });
  const status=document.getElementById("providerStatus");
  if(status) status.addEventListener("change",()=>{ providerUi.status=status.value; providerUi.limit=80; refreshProviderList(); });
  panel.addEventListener("click",async e=>{
    const cat=e.target.closest("[data-provider-category]");
    if(cat){ providerUi.category=cat.dataset.providerCategory; providerUi.limit=80; panel.querySelectorAll("[data-provider-category]").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b===cat)); refreshProviderList(); return; }
    const more=e.target.closest("[data-provider-more]");
    if(more){ providerUi.limit+=100; refreshProviderList(); return; }
    const install=e.target.closest("[data-provider-install]");
    if(install){ install.disabled=true; install.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Identifying…'; try{ const r=await installProviderById(install.dataset.providerInstall); toast(r.installed?("Identified and installed: "+r.provider.name):("Not installed yet: "+(r.provider.lastError||"server could not be identified")),r.installed?"success":"error"); }catch(err){ toast(err.message||String(err),"error"); } refreshProviderList(); return; }
    const tog=e.target.closest("[data-provider-toggle]");
    if(tog){ const p=getProvider(tog.dataset.providerToggle); if(p){ setProviderEnabled(p.id,p.enabled===false); refreshProviderList(); } return; }
    const rem=e.target.closest("[data-provider-remove]");
    if(rem){ removeProviderById(rem.dataset.providerRemove); toast("Provider removed"); refreshProviderList(); return; }
    const seedRem=e.target.closest("[data-seed-remove]");
    if(seedRem){ const cfg=discoveryCfg(); cfg.seeds.splice(Number(seedRem.dataset.seedRemove),1); saveSettings(); renderSources(true); }
  });
}

/* ---------------- router, menu drawer and TV navigation ---------------- */
function setNav(name){
  $$(".nav button,.menu-link[data-menu-route],.zp-rail-link[data-menu-route],.mobile-bottom-nav [data-menu-route]").forEach(b=>{
    const active=(b.dataset.nav||b.dataset.menuRoute)===name;
    b.classList.toggle("active",active);
    if(active) b.setAttribute("aria-current","page"); else b.removeAttribute("aria-current");
  });
}
let menuReturnFocus=null;
function renderMenuQuickSwitches(){
  const box=document.getElementById("menuQuickSwitches");
  if(!box) return;
  const switches=[
    featureSwitchHTML("discovery","Find sources automatically","Look for more places to watch while ZeroPlay is open.","menu"),
    featureSwitchHTML("trailers","Trailer previews","Short previews inside focused titles.","menu"),
    featureSwitchHTML("autoFailover","Switch if a source fails","Move only after playback really fails or gets stuck.","menu"),
    featureSwitchHTML("downloads","Downloads","Download movies and episodes when a direct file is available.","menu"),
    featureSwitchHTML("autoplayNext","Autoplay next episode","Continue when an episode ends.","menu"),
    featureSwitchHTML("artworkFallback","Find missing posters","Fill missing artwork automatically — no keys needed.","menu")
  ];
  if(ANDROID_TV_APP) switches.push(featureSwitchHTML("tvPerformance","Make this TV run lighter","Recommended for 2 GB TV boxes.","menu"));
  box.innerHTML=switches.join("");
  syncFeatureToggles(box);
  if(typeof updateDownloadMenuCount==="function") updateDownloadMenuCount();
}

function openMenuDrawer(){
  const drawer=document.getElementById("menuDrawer"), scrim=document.getElementById("menuScrim"), btn=document.getElementById("btnMenu");
  if(!drawer||!scrim) return;
  renderMenuQuickSwitches();
  menuReturnFocus=document.activeElement;
  scrim.hidden=false; drawer.classList.add("open"); drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
  if(btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");
  document.body.classList.add("locked");
  setTimeout(()=>{ const first=document.getElementById("btnCloseMenu"); if(first) first.focus({preventScroll:true}); },30);
}
function closeMenuDrawer(){
  const drawer=document.getElementById("menuDrawer"), scrim=document.getElementById("menuScrim"), btn=document.getElementById("btnMenu");
  if(!drawer||!scrim||!drawer.classList.contains("open")) return;
  drawer.classList.remove("open"); drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true"); scrim.hidden=true;
  if(btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
  if(!playerState&&!detailState&&!streamsCtx) document.body.classList.remove("locked");
  if(menuReturnFocus&&menuReturnFocus.focus) menuReturnFocus.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function goRoute(route){
  closeMenuDrawer();
  const target="#/"+(route||"home");
  if(location.hash===target) render(); else location.hash=target;
}
function render(){
  if(typeof downloadModalState!=="undefined"&&downloadModalState) closeDownloadModal();
  if(streamsCtx) closeStreams();
  closeMenuDrawer();
  closeDetail();
  stopCardPreview();
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview);
  const hash=location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/,"");
  const [route,qs]=hash.split("?");
  const params=new URLSearchParams(qs||"");
  document.body.classList.add("route-enter");
  setTimeout(()=>document.body.classList.remove("route-enter"),480);
  window.scrollTo({top:0});
  const browseParams={genre:params.get("genre")||"",year:params.get("year")||"",rating:params.get("rating")||"",sort:params.get("sort")||""};
  if(route==="movies"){ setNav("movies"); renderBrowse("movie",browseParams); }
  else if(route==="series"){ setNav("series"); renderBrowse("tv",browseParams); }
  else if(route==="categories"){ setNav("categories"); renderCategories(); }
  else if(route==="search"){ setNav("search"); renderSearch(params.get("q")||""); }
  else if(route==="library"){ setNav("library"); renderLibrary(); }
  else if(route==="sources"||route==="discover"){ setNav("sources"); renderSources(false,{settingsPage:false,section:""}); }
  else if(route==="settings"){ setNav("sources"); renderSources(false,{settingsPage:true,section:params.get("section")||""}); }
  else if(route==="downloads"){ setNav(""); renderDownloadsPage(); }
  else if(route==="debrid"||route==="configure"){ setNav("sources"); renderSources(false,{settingsPage:true,section:""}); }
  else if(route.startsWith("title/")){ const [,t,id]=route.split("/"); setNav("home"); renderHome().then(()=>openDetail(t,Number(id))); }
  else { setNav("home"); renderHome(); }
  scheduleTvInitialFocus();
}
$$(".nav button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>goRoute(b.dataset.nav));
$("#btnMenu").onclick=openMenuDrawer;
$("#zpSidebarMore").onclick=openMenuDrawer;

$("#btnCloseMenu").onclick=closeMenuDrawer;
$("#menuScrim").onclick=closeMenuDrawer;
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
  const cat=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-category-type][data-category-id]");
  if(cat){ e.preventDefault(); navigateCategory(cat.dataset.categoryType,cat.dataset.categoryId); return; }
  const settingsBtn=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-settings-section]");
  if(settingsBtn){ e.preventDefault(); closeMenuDrawer(); const target="#/settings?section="+encodeURIComponent(settingsBtn.dataset.settingsSection||""); if(location.hash===target) render(); else location.hash=target; return; }
  const routeBtn=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-menu-route]");
  if(routeBtn){ e.preventDefault(); goRoute(routeBtn.dataset.menuRoute); }
});
$("#topSearch").addEventListener("submit",e=>{ e.preventDefault(); const q=$("#topQuery").value.trim(); const target="#/search?q="+encodeURIComponent(q); if(location.hash===target) render(); else location.hash=target; });
$("#demoBannerBtn").onclick=()=>{ location.hash="#/sources"; };
let lastTvFocusSelector="";
let lastTvFocusPoint=null;
let lastTvFocusElement=null;
let tvInitialFocusTimer=null;
function tvFocusSelectorFor(el){
  if(!el||(!el.dataset&&!el.id)) return "";
  if(el.id) return '[id="'+String(el.id).replace(/"/g,'\\"')+'"]';
  if(el.classList&&el.classList.contains("continue-card")) return '.continue-card[data-type="'+el.dataset.type+'"][data-id="'+el.dataset.id+'"]';
  if(el.classList&&el.classList.contains("poster-card")) return '.poster-card[data-type="'+el.dataset.type+'"][data-id="'+el.dataset.id+'"]';
  if(el.dataset&&el.dataset.categoryType&&el.dataset.categoryId) return '[data-category-type="'+el.dataset.categoryType+'"][data-category-id="'+el.dataset.categoryId+'"]';
  if(el.dataset&&el.dataset.nav) return '[data-nav="'+el.dataset.nav+'"]';
  if(el.dataset&&el.dataset.menuRoute) return '[data-menu-route="'+el.dataset.menuRoute+'"]';
  return "";
}
function rememberTvFocus(el){
  el=el||document.activeElement;
  if(!el||el===document.body) return;
  try{ const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.width>2&&r.height>2) lastTvFocusPoint={x:r.left+r.width/2+window.scrollX,y:r.top+r.height/2+window.scrollY}; }catch{}
  if(el.closest&&el.closest("#playerRoot,#modalRoot,#streamsRoot,#downloadsRoot,#menuDrawer")) return;
  const selector=tvFocusSelectorFor(el);
  if(selector){ lastTvFocusSelector=selector; lastTvFocusElement=el; }
}
function restoreTvFocus(){
  if(!ANDROID_TV_APP) return false;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    let target=lastTvFocusElement&&lastTvFocusElement.isConnected?lastTvFocusElement:null;
    if((!target||!isTvFocusable(target))&&lastTvFocusSelector){ try{ target=document.querySelector(lastTvFocusSelector); }catch{ target=null; } }
    if(target&&isTvFocusable(target)){ target.focus({preventScroll:true}); target.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",inline:"center",behavior:tvPerformanceEnabled()?"auto":"smooth"}); }
  },40);
  return true;
}
function focusInitialTvTarget(){
  if(!ANDROID_TV_APP||!settings.ui||settings.ui.androidTvLaunchFocus===false) return false;
  if(playerState||detailState||streamsCtx||(typeof downloadModalState!=="undefined"&&downloadModalState)) return false;
  const drawer=document.getElementById("menuDrawer"); if(drawer&&drawer.classList.contains("open")) return false;
  const active=document.activeElement;
  if(active&&active!==document.body&&active.id!=="btnMenu"&&isTvFocusable(active)) return false;
  let target=null;
  if(lastTvFocusSelector){ try{ const remembered=document.querySelector(lastTvFocusSelector); if(remembered&&isTvFocusable(remembered)) target=remembered; }catch{} }
  target=target||document.querySelector("#view .continue-card")||document.querySelector("#view .poster-card")||document.getElementById("heroPlay")||document.querySelector("#view .category-tile")||document.querySelector("#view button:not([disabled])");
  if(!target||!isTvFocusable(target)) return false;
  target.focus({preventScroll:true});
  target.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",inline:"center",behavior:tvPerformanceEnabled()?"auto":"smooth"});
  return true;
}
function scheduleTvInitialFocus(){
  if(!ANDROID_TV_APP) return;
  if(tvInitialFocusTimer) clearTimeout(tvInitialFocusTimer);
  tvInitialFocusTimer=setTimeout(()=>{ if(!focusInitialTvTarget()) setTimeout(focusInitialTvTarget,1400); },650);
}
function tvFocusableRoot(){
  if(typeof downloadModalState!=="undefined"&&downloadModalState) return document.getElementById("downloadsRoot");
  if(streamsCtx) return document.getElementById("streamsRoot");
  if(playerState) return document.getElementById("playerRoot");
  const drawer=document.getElementById("menuDrawer");
  if(drawer&&drawer.classList.contains("open")) return drawer;
  if(detailState) return document.getElementById("modalRoot");
  return document;
}
function isTvFocusable(el){
  if(!el||el.disabled||el.getAttribute&&el.getAttribute("tabindex")==="-1") return false;
  const style=window.getComputedStyle?getComputedStyle(el):null;
  if(style&&(style.display==="none"||style.visibility==="hidden")) return false;
  const rect=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  return rect.width>2&&rect.height>2&&rect.bottom>-20&&rect.right>-20;
}
function tvFocusables(){
  const root=tvFocusableRoot()||document;
  return $$("button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([type='hidden']), select, textarea, .poster-card, .continue-card, [tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1'])",root).filter(isTvFocusable);
}
function tvFocusAndReveal(el){
  if(!el) return;
  el.focus({preventScroll:true});
  const behavior=tvPerformanceEnabled()?"auto":"smooth";
  try{ el.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",inline:"nearest",behavior}); }catch{}
  // WebView scrollIntoView can miss nested scrollers (menu drawer, rails,
  // settings panels); reveal inside every scrollable ancestor manually.
  let node=el.parentElement;
  while(node&&node!==document.body){
    const style=window.getComputedStyle?getComputedStyle(node):null;
    if(style&&(/(auto|scroll)/.test(style.overflowY)||/(auto|scroll)/.test(style.overflowX))){
      const nr=node.getBoundingClientRect(), r=el.getBoundingClientRect(), pad=18;
      if(r.bottom>nr.bottom-pad) node.scrollTop+=r.bottom-nr.bottom+pad;
      else if(r.top<nr.top+pad) node.scrollTop-=nr.top+pad-r.top;
      if(r.right>nr.right-pad) node.scrollLeft+=r.right-nr.right+pad;
      else if(r.left<nr.left+pad) node.scrollLeft-=nr.left+pad-r.left;
    }
    node=node.parentElement;
  }
}
function moveTvFocus(direction){
  const list=tvFocusables(); if(!list.length) return false;
  const current=document.activeElement;
  if(!current||!list.includes(current)){
    // Focus was lost (view re-render detached the focused node). Recover
    // where the viewer actually was instead of jumping back to the top.
    let target=null;
    if(lastTvFocusSelector){ try{ const candidate=document.querySelector(lastTvFocusSelector); if(candidate&&list.includes(candidate)) target=candidate; }catch{} }
    if(!target&&lastTvFocusPoint){
      let nearest=null,nearestDist=Infinity;
      for(const el of list){ const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); const d=Math.hypot(r.left+r.width/2+window.scrollX-lastTvFocusPoint.x,r.top+r.height/2+window.scrollY-lastTvFocusPoint.y); if(d<nearestDist){ nearestDist=d; nearest=el; } }
      if(nearest&&nearestDist<900) target=nearest;
    }
    target=target||list.find(el=>el.classList&&el.classList.contains("continue-card"))||list.find(el=>el.classList&&el.classList.contains("poster-card"))||list.find(el=>el.id==="heroPlay")||list[0];
    tvFocusAndReveal(target);
    return true;
  }
  const cr=current.getBoundingClientRect(), cx=cr.left+cr.width/2, cy=cr.top+cr.height/2;
  const currentRail=current.closest?current.closest(".rail-track,.cast-track,.category-strip"):null;
  let best=null,bestScore=Infinity;
  for(const el of list){
    if(el===current) continue;
    if(current.classList&&(current.classList.contains("poster-card")||current.classList.contains("continue-card"))&&current.contains(el)) continue;
    // Left/right inside a poster rail stays in that rail; at the rail edge
    // focus stops instead of teleporting to a menu or another row.
    if((direction==="left"||direction==="right")&&currentRail&&!currentRail.contains(el)) continue;
    const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(), x=r.left+r.width/2, y=r.top+r.height/2;
    const dx=x-cx, dy=y-cy;
    let primary=0, secondary=0;
    if(direction==="right"){ if(dx<=8) continue; primary=dx; secondary=Math.abs(dy); }
    else if(direction==="left"){ if(dx>=-8) continue; primary=-dx; secondary=Math.abs(dy); }
    else if(direction==="down"){ if(dy<=8) continue; primary=dy; secondary=Math.abs(dx); }
    else if(direction==="up"){ if(dy>=-8) continue; primary=-dy; secondary=Math.abs(dx); }
    else continue;
    const score=primary+secondary*2.35+(secondary<8?-18:0);
    if(score<bestScore){ bestScore=score; best=el; }
  }
  if(!best) return false;
  tvFocusAndReveal(best);
  return true;
}
function handlePlayerKeyboard(e){
  const st=playerState; if(!st||st.trailer||streamsCtx||(typeof downloadModalState!=="undefined"&&downloadModalState)) return false;
  const tag=(document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.tagName)||"";
  if(/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(tag)&&document.activeElement.id!=="seekRange"&&document.activeElement.id!=="volumeRange") return false;
  const full=st.engine==="native"||st.engine==="faststream-api";
  const key=e.key;
  const overlayEl=document.getElementById("playerOverlay");
  if(overlayEl&&overlayEl.classList.contains("chrome-hidden")&&(!st.embedFocused||st.chromeUserHidden)&&/^(Arrow|Enter|Channel|Escape| )/.test(key)){
    e.preventDefault(); showPlayerChrome(false,true);
    const wake=document.getElementById(full?"btnPlayPause":"btnFocusEmbed")||document.getElementById("btnPlayerServers");
    if(wake&&wake.style.display!=="none"&&!wake.disabled) wake.focus({preventScroll:true});
    return true;
  }
  if(key==="MediaStop"){ e.preventDefault(); closePlayer(); return true; }
  if(key==="MediaTrackNext"||key==="ChannelUp"||key==="MediaTrackPrevious"||key==="ChannelDown"){
    const epBtn=document.getElementById(key==="MediaTrackNext"||key==="ChannelUp"?"btnNextEp":"btnPrevEp");
    if(epBtn){ e.preventDefault(); epBtn.click(); return true; }
    if(full){ e.preventDefault(); playerCommand("seekDelta",(key==="MediaTrackNext"||key==="ChannelUp")?60:-60); return true; }
  }
  if((key==="MediaFastForward"||key==="MediaRewind")&&full){ e.preventDefault(); playerCommand("seekDelta",key==="MediaFastForward"?30:-30); return true; }
  if(key==="MediaPlay"&&full){ e.preventDefault(); if(st.playback&&st.playback.paused) playerCommand("toggle"); return true; }

'use strict';

const net = require('node:net');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');

const MAX_JSON_BYTES = 1200000;
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;
const DEFAULT_SOURCE_CONCURRENCY = 6;

function cleanText(value, max = 240) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, max);
}

function publicHttpsUrl(raw) {
  let url;
  try { url = new URL(String(raw || '')); } catch { return ''; }
  if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !url.hostname || url.username || url.password) return '';
  const host = url.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^\[|\]$/g, '');
  if (net.isIP(host)) return '';
  if (host === 'localhost' || host.endsWith('.localhost') || host.endsWith('.local') || host.endsWith('.internal')) return '';
  return url.href.slice(0, 1800);
}

function normalizeIdentity(raw) {
  raw = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
  const title = cleanText(raw.title, 160);
  if (title.length < 2) throw new Error('A title is required');
  const type = raw.type === 'tv' || raw.type === 'series' ? 'tv' : 'movie';
  const titles = [...new Set([title, ...(Array.isArray(raw.titles) ? raw.titles : [])]
    .map(value => cleanText(value, 160)).filter(value => value.length >= 2))].slice(0, 5);
  const year = /^\d{4}$/.test(String(raw.year || '')) ? Number(raw.year) : null;
  const imdbId = /^tt\d{5,12}$/i.test(String(raw.imdbId || '')) ? String(raw.imdbId).toLowerCase() : '';
  const tmdbId = /^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(String(raw.tmdbId || '')) ? Number(raw.tmdbId) : null;
  const season = Number.isInteger(Number(raw.season)) && Number(raw.season) > 0 && Number(raw.season) <= 999 ? Number(raw.season) : 1;
  const episode = Number.isInteger(Number(raw.episode)) && Number(raw.episode) > 0 && Number(raw.episode) <= 9999 ? Number(raw.episode) : 1;
  return { title, titles, type, year, imdbId, tmdbId, season, episode };
}

function parseManifest(raw) {

  const resources = [...new Set(resourceRows.map(item => typeof item === 'string' ? item : item && item.name).filter(Boolean).map(String))];
  if (!resources.includes('stream')) return null;
  const types = [...new Set((Array.isArray(raw.types) ? raw.types : []).map(value => String(value).toLowerCase()))];
  if (!types.some(type => ['movie', 'series', 'tv'].includes(type))) return null;
  const prefixes = [...new Set([
    ...(Array.isArray(raw.idPrefixes) ? raw.idPrefixes : []),
    ...resourceRows.flatMap(item => item && typeof item === 'object' && Array.isArray(item.idPrefixes) ? item.idPrefixes : []),
  ].map(value => String(value).toLowerCase()).filter(value => /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,24}$/.test(value)))];
  const catalogs = Array.isArray(raw.catalogs) ? raw.catalogs.filter(item => item && typeof item === 'object') : [];
  const searchCatalogs = catalogs.filter(catalog => Array.isArray(catalog.extra) && catalog.extra.some(extra => extra && extra.name === 'search'));
  const addonCatalogs = Array.isArray(raw.addonCatalogs) ? raw.addonCatalogs.filter(item => item && typeof item === 'object') : [];
  return {
    id: cleanText(raw.id, 120), name: cleanText(raw.name || raw.id || 'Streaming addon', 80),
    version: cleanText(raw.version, 40), description: cleanText(raw.description, 240),
    resources, types, idPrefixes: prefixes, catalogs: catalogs.slice(0, 30),
    catalogDefs: catalogs.slice(0, 30), searchCatalogs: searchCatalogs.slice(0, 30), addonCatalogs: addonCatalogs.slice(0, 30),

function providerRecord(manifestUrl, manifest, source, meta = {}) {
  const safeManifest = publicHttpsUrl(manifestUrl);
