```javascript
  if (!safeManifest || !info) return null;
  const base = safeManifest.replace(/\/manifest\.json(?:[?#].*)?$/i, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  if (!base) return null;
  const id = 'addon:' + base.toLowerCase();
  const types = info.types.map(type => type === 'tv' ? 'series' : type);
  return {
    id, name: info.name, kind: 'stremio-addon', status: 'candidate', titleScopedDiscovery: true,
    enabled: true, base, endpoint: base, manifestUrl: safeManifest, manifestId: info.id,
    version: info.version, resources: info.resources, types, idPrefixes: info.idPrefixes,
    catalogDefs: info.catalogDefs, addonCatalogs: info.addonCatalogs, searchCatalogs: info.searchCatalogs,
    stars: Number(meta.stars) || 0, source: 'Server Finder · ' + source, from: 'Server Finder · ' + source,
    description: info.description || cleanText(meta.description, 240), homepage: publicHttpsUrl(meta.homepage) || '',
    tags: Array.isArray(meta.tags) ? meta.tags.map(value => cleanText(value, 60)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20) : [],
    identification: {
      version: 1, kind: 'stremio-addon', confidence: 88, identifiedAt: Date.now(), searchable: info.searchCatalogs.length > 0,
      supports: { movie: types.includes('movie'), series: types.includes('series'), streams: true, catalog: info.resources.includes('catalog'), meta: info.resources.includes('meta'), subtitles: info.resources.includes('subtitles'), addonCatalog: info.resources.includes('addon_catalog'), search: info.searchCatalogs.length > 0, episodeLookup: types.includes('series') },
      identifierModes: info.idPrefixes.map(prefix => prefix === 'tt' ? 'imdb-id' : prefix), idPrefixes: info.idPrefixes,
      checks: ['public HTTPS manifest', 'stream resource and movie/series types confirmed', 'candidate requires title-scoped identity-verified playback match'],

function extractManifestUrls(text) {
  const urls = [];

async function fetchTextJson(url, options = {}) {

  let next = publicHttpsUrl(url);
  if (!next) throw new Error('Blocked URL');
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    for (let hop = 0; hop <= 3; hop++) {
      const response = await fetchImpl(next, {
        signal: controller.signal, redirect: 'manual',
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json,text/plain;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8', 'User-Agent': 'ZeroPlay-Server-Finder/1.0' },

        const location = response.headers && response.headers.get && response.headers.get('location');
        const redirected = publicHttpsUrl(new URL(location || '', next).href);
        if (!redirected) throw new Error('Blocked redirect');
        next = redirected;

      return { data: options.allowText ? text : JSON.parse(text), url: next };
    }
    throw new Error('Too many redirects');
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}

function mapLimit(items, limit, fn) {
  const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
  let cursor = 0;
  const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, list.length || 1)) }, async () => {
    while (cursor < list.length) {
      const item = list[cursor++];
      try { await fn(item); } catch {}

  });
  return Promise.all(workers);
}

function entryUrl(entry) {

}

async function crawlStremioAddons(identity, options) {
  const { data } = await fetchTextJson('https://stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons?limit=100&nsfw=exclude&sort_by=stars&order=desc&page=1', options);
  const entries = [];

    for (const instance of Array.isArray(addon.instances) ? addon.instances : []) entries.push(instance);

async function crawlCatalogGraph(identity, options) {
  const endpoints = [
    'https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/addon_catalog/all/community.json',

function stableFingerprint(identity) {

function runWorker(sourceId, identity, options) {

  let sources;
  if (options.useWorkerThreads && !options.fetchImpl) {
    sources = await Promise.all(sourceIds.map(id => runWorker(id, identity, { ...common, workerTimeoutMs: options.workerTimeoutMs })));
  } else {
    sources = await Promise.all(sourceIds.map(id => crawlSource(id, identity, common)));
  }
  const candidates = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const source of sources) {
    for (const record of source.records || []) {
      if (seen.has(record.manifestUrl)) continue;
      seen.add(record.manifestUrl);
      candidates.push(record);
      if (candidates.length >= limit) break;
    }
    if (candidates.length >= limit) break;
  }
  const complete = sources.filter(source => source.status !== 'failed').length;
  return {
    ok: true, identity, fingerprint: stableFingerprint(identity),
    mode: options.useWorkerThreads ? 'local-worker-threads' : 'hosted-bounded-pool',
    sourcesTotal: sources.length, sourcesComplete: complete, sourcesFailed: sources.length - complete,
    candidates, candidateCount: candidates.length, truncated: candidates.length >= limit,
    workers: options.useWorkerThreads ? sources.length : Math.min(sources.length, options.sourceConcurrency || 8),
    sources: sources.map(({ records, ...source }) => source),
  };
}

module.exports = {
  SOURCE_IDS, MAX_CANDIDATES, MAX_PER_SOURCE, publicHttpsUrl, normalizeIdentity,
  parseManifest, providerRecord, extractManifestUrls, fetchTextJson, identifyEntries,
  crawlSource, findCandidates, runWorker,
};
```

```javascript
'use strict';

const { parentPort, workerData } = require('node:worker_threads');
const { crawlSource } = require('./core');

(async () => {
  const { sourceId, identity, options } = workerData || {};
  const result = await crawlSource(sourceId, identity, options || {});
  parentPort.postMessage(result);
})().catch(error => {
  parentPort.postMessage({
    id: workerData && workerData.sourceId || 'unknown', status: 'failed',
    seen: 0, checked: 0, candidates: 0, records: [],
    error: String(error && error.message || 'Worker failed').slice(0, 140), elapsedMs: 0,
  });
```

```toml
# ZeroPlay — Netlify configuration
# Deploy options:

# For the live TMDB catalog add env var TMDB_API_KEY (or TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN)

[build]

  functions = "netlify/functions"

# API proxies (ZeroPlay-compatible paths)
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/netlify/functions/extract.js`

```javascript
/* ZeroPlay — website title lookup + watch resolver (Netlify Function)
 *
 * mode=profile : inspect a user-added website only to discover how its public
 *                search works. It does not import that site's titles/covers.
 * mode=find    : check whether an existing catalogue title exists on that
 *                website, then resolve its public watch/embed/direct URL.
 * mode=watch   : inspect one known watch page for public embed/direct URLs.
 * mode=json    : fetch a JSON URL server-side (CORS fallback for addons).
 * mode=text    : return a validated M3U/M3U8 playlist without truncation.
 * mode=m3u     : extract M3U/M3U8 links/variants from a page or playlist.
 *
 * Safety: http(s) only, private/loopback hosts blocked, 1.5 MB response cap,
 * bounded search requests and timeouts. This parses public pages only; it
 * does not log in, bypass paywalls, solve CAPTCHAs, or bypass DRM.

'use strict';

const MAX_BYTES = 1500000;
const UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36';
const SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER = '__ZP_Q__';
const BLOCKED_PATH = /\/(login|register|signup|filter|search|genre|genres|tag|tags|category|categories|type|types|year|years|status|user|profile|dmca|terms|privacy|contact|about|home)(\/|\?|$)/i;

function guardUrl(raw) {
  let u;

  if (u.protocol !== 'https:' && u.protocol !== 'http:') return null;
  const h = u.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (h === 'localhost' || h.endsWith('.local') || h.endsWith('.internal')) return null;
  if (/^(127\.|10\.|192\.168\.|169\.254\.|0\.)/.test(h)) return null;
  if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\./.test(h)) return null;

function isM3uText(text) {

}

function m3uPlaylistInfo(text, base) {

  let segmentCount = 0;

    if (!line) continue;
    if (line.startsWith('#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:')) { pendingVariant = true; continue; }
    if (line.startsWith('#EXTINF:')) { pendingDuration = Number(line.slice(8).split(',')[0]) || 0; continue; }

    if (pendingVariant) { variants.push(url); pendingVariant = false; continue; }
    segmentCount += 1;
    duration += pendingDuration;

function extractM3u(text, base) {

    const summary = isMaster ? `${info.variants.length} variants` : `${info.segmentCount} segments`;
    const detail = isMaster
      ? 'Master playlist. Choose Download to select a quality variant and assemble its segments.'
      : `${info.duration} sec playlist duration${info.encrypted ? ' · encryption declared' : ' · unencrypted'}${info.live ? ' · live/no end marker' : ''}`;
    return {
      title: 'M3U playlist',
      playlists: [{ url: base, label: isMaster ? 'M3U master playlist' : 'M3U media playlist', summary, detail }]

  const found = new Set((watch.direct || []).filter(url => /\.m3u8(?:\?|#|$)/i.test(url)));

    title: watch.title || '',

  const wantedImdb = String(opts.imdb || opts.imdbId || '').toLowerCase();
  const wantedTmdb = Number(opts.tmdb || opts.tmdbId || 0) || null;
  const epInfo = explicitEpisodeInfo([candidate && candidate.title, candidate && candidate.slugTitle, candidate && candidate.url].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
  const episodeConflict = (opts.type === 'tv' || opts.type === 'series') && ((epInfo.season != null && epInfo.season !== Number(opts.season || 1)) || (epInfo.episode != null && epInfo.episode !== Number(opts.episode || 1)));

  if (((wantedImdb && candidateIds.imdbId === wantedImdb) || (wantedTmdb && candidateIds.tmdbId === wantedTmdb)) && !episodeConflict) return 100;

      else if (stripSeasonSuffix(cand) === target || cand === stripSeasonSuffix(target)) score = 95;
      else if (cand.startsWith(target + ' ')) {

function identifyTitleCandidate(candidate, targets, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const score = titleScore(candidate, targets, opts);
  const candidateIds = extractCandidateIds(candidate);
  const episodeInfo = explicitEpisodeInfo([candidate && candidate.title, candidate && candidate.slugTitle, candidate && candidate.url].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
  const reasons = [];
  const wantedImdb = String(opts.imdb || '').toLowerCase();
  const wantedTmdb = Number(opts.tmdb || 0) || null;
  let hardReject = false;
  if (wantedImdb && candidateIds.imdbId && wantedImdb !== candidateIds.imdbId) { hardReject = true; reasons.push('different IMDb id'); }
  else if (wantedImdb && candidateIds.imdbId === wantedImdb) reasons.push('exact IMDb id');
  if (wantedTmdb && candidateIds.tmdbId && wantedTmdb !== candidateIds.tmdbId) { hardReject = true; reasons.push('different TMDB id'); }
  else if (wantedTmdb && candidateIds.tmdbId === wantedTmdb) reasons.push('exact TMDB id');
  if ((opts.type === 'tv' || opts.type === 'series') && ((episodeInfo.season != null && episodeInfo.season !== Number(opts.season || 1)) || (episodeInfo.episode != null && episodeInfo.episode !== Number(opts.episode || 1)))) {
    hardReject = true; reasons.push('different season/episode');
  }
  if (score >= 95) reasons.push('exact title');
  else if (score >= 80) reasons.push('verified title');
  else if (score >= 55) reasons.push('partial title');
  if (opts.year) {
    const years = ([candidate && candidate.title, candidate && candidate.url].filter(Boolean).join(' ').match(/\b(19\d{2}|20\d{2})\b/g) || []);
    if (years.length) reasons.push(years.includes(String(opts.year)) ? 'year match' : 'year differs');
  }
  return {
    score: hardReject ? 0 : score,
    verdict: hardReject ? 'rejected' : score >= 95 ? 'exact' : score >= 80 ? 'verified' : score >= 65 ? 'possible' : 'rejected',
    accepted: !hardReject && score >= 80,
    hardReject,
    reasons,
    candidateIds,
    episodeInfo,
    matchedTitle: (candidate && (candidate.title || candidate.slugTitle)) || '',
  };
}

function candidateSlugTitle(url) {
  try {
    const parts = new URL(url).pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).map(x => { try { return decodeURIComponent(x); } catch { return x; } });
    const useful = parts.filter(p => !/^(anime|movie|movies|tv|series|show|watch|detail|info|play|title|video|episode|ep-\d+|\d+)$/i.test(p));
    return normalizeTitle(useful.join(' ').replace(/[-_]+/g, ' '));
  } catch { return ''; }
}

function parseResultLinks(html, base) {
  const byUrl = new Map();
  const anchorRe = /<a\s[^>]*href\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]{0,1200}?)<\/a>/gi;
  for (const m of html.matchAll(anchorRe)) {
    const hrefRaw = decodeEntities(m[1] || '');
    if (!hrefRaw || hrefRaw.startsWith('#') || /^javascript:/i.test(hrefRaw)) continue;
    let url = abs(hrefRaw, base);
    if (!url || !guardUrl(url) || !sameSite(url, base)) continue;
    try {
      const u = new URL(url);
      u.hash = '';
      if (u.pathname === '/' || BLOCKED_PATH.test(u.pathname + u.search)) continue;
      url = u.href;
    } catch { continue; }
    const inner = m[2] || '';
    const imgTag = (inner.match(/<img\s[^>]*>/i) || [])[0] || '';
    const openTag = m[0].slice(0, m[0].indexOf('>') + 1);
    const title = decodeEntities(stripTags(attr(openTag, 'title') || attr(imgTag, 'alt') || inner)).slice(0, 140);
    const slug = candidateSlugTitle(url);
    if ((!title || title.length < 2) && (!slug || slug.length < 2)) continue;
    const prior = byUrl.get(url);
    if (!prior || (!prior.title && title) || (title && title.length < prior.title.length && normalizeTitle(title).length >= 2)) {
      byUrl.set(url, { title: title || (prior && prior.title) || '', slugTitle: slug, url });
    }
    if (byUrl.size >= 220) break;
  }
  return [...byUrl.values()];
}

function addTemplate(out, template, base) {
  if (!template) return;
  let t = String(template).replace(/%7B/gi, '{').replace(/%7D/gi, '}');
  t = t.replaceAll(SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER, '{q}');
  if (!t.includes('{q}') && !t.includes('{slug}')) return;
  const probe = t.replace('{q}', 'test').replace('{slug}', 'test');
  const u = guardUrl(abs(probe, base));
  if (!u || !sameSite(u.href, base)) return;
  if (!out.includes(t)) out.push(t);
}

function searchTemplatesFromHtml(html, base) {
  const out = [];
  const searchNames = new Set(['q', 'query', 'search', 'keyword', 'keywords', 's', 'title', 'text', 'term', 'name']);
  for (const fm of html.matchAll(/<form\b[^>]*>[\s\S]{0,4000}?<\/form>/gi)) {
    const form = fm[0];
    const open = form.slice(0, form.indexOf('>') + 1);
    if (/method\s*=\s*["']?post/i.test(open)) continue;
    const inputs = [...form.matchAll(/<input\b[^>]*>/gi)].map(x => x[0]);
    const searchInput = inputs.find(tag => {
      const name = attr(tag, 'name').toLowerCase();
      return searchNames.has(name) || /^search$/i.test(attr(tag, 'type')) || /search/i.test(attr(tag, 'placeholder'));
    });
    if (!searchInput) continue;
    const name = attr(searchInput, 'name') || 'q';
    const action = abs(attr(open, 'action') || base, base);
    const u = guardUrl(action);
    if (!u) continue;
    for (const tag of inputs) {
      const n = attr(tag, 'name');
      if (!n || n === name) continue;
      if (/hidden/i.test(attr(tag, 'type'))) u.searchParams.set(n, attr(tag, 'value') || '');
    }
    u.searchParams.set(name, SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER);
    addTemplate(out, u.href, base);
  }
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/(?:href|action)\s*=\s*"([^"]*(?:search|filter)[^"]*)"/gi)) {
    const raw = abs(decodeEntities(m[1]), base);
    const u = guardUrl(raw);
    if (!u) continue;
    for (const key of ['keyword', 'q', 'query', 'search', 's', 'title']) {
      if (u.searchParams.has(key)) { u.searchParams.set(key, SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER); addTemplate(out, u.href, base); break; }
    }
  }
  return out.slice(0, 8);
}

function commonSearchTemplates(siteUrl) {
  const u = guardUrl(siteUrl);
  if (!u) return [];
  const roots = new Set();
  roots.add(u.origin);
  try { roots.add(new URL('./', u.href).href.replace(/\/$/, '')); } catch {}
  const suffixes = ['/search?keyword={q}', '/search?q={q}', '/search?query={q}', '/filter?keyword={q}', '/?s={q}', '/search/{slug}', '/search/{q}'];
  const out = [];
  for (const root of roots) for (const suffix of suffixes) {
    const t = root + suffix;
    if (!out.includes(t)) out.push(t);
  }
  return out;
}

function buildSearchUrl(template, query) {
  return String(template || '')
    .replaceAll('{slug}', slugTitle(query))
    .replaceAll('{q}', encodeURIComponent(query));
}

async function profileSite(rawUrl) {
  const u = guardUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!u) throw new Error('Invalid or blocked URL');
  const docs = [];
  const first = await fetchDocument(u.href, false, 8000);
  docs.push(first);
  let templates = searchTemplatesFromHtml(first.text, first.finalUrl);
  if (!templates.length && !sameSite(first.finalUrl, u.origin + '/')) {
    try {
      const root = await fetchDocument(u.origin + '/', false, 8000);
      docs.push(root);
      templates = searchTemplatesFromHtml(root.text, root.finalUrl);
    } catch {}
  } else if (!templates.length && u.pathname !== '/') {
    try {
      const root = await fetchDocument(u.origin + '/', false, 8000);
      docs.push(root);
      templates = [...new Set([...templates, ...searchTemplatesFromHtml(root.text, root.finalUrl)])];
    } catch {}
  }
  if (!templates.length) templates = commonSearchTemplates(u.href).slice(0, 4);
  const embedHosts = [...new Set(docs.flatMap(d => iframeHosts(d.text)))];
  return {
    ok: true,
    mode: 'profile',
    url: first.finalUrl,
    origin: u.origin,
    lookup: 'dynamic-title-search',
    searchTemplate: templates[0] || '',
    searchTemplates: templates.slice(0, 5),
    embedHosts,
  };
}

function adjustEpisodeInUrl(url, season, episode) {
  let out = String(url || '');
  const ep = episode == null ? null : String(episode);
  const se = season == null ? null : String(season);
  if (ep != null) {
    out = out.replace(/([?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=)\d+/i, '$1' + ep);
    out = out.replace(/(\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/])(\d+)(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/i, '$1' + ep + '$3');
    out = out.replace(/(-ep(?:isode)?-)(\d+)(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/i, '$1' + ep + '$3');
  }
  if (se != null && ep != null) {
    out = out.replace(/(\/season[-_/])(\d+)(\/episode[-_/])(\d+)/i, '$1' + se + '$3' + ep);
    out = out.replace(/(\/)(\d{1,3})\/(\d{1,4})(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/i, (m, slash, oldSeason, oldEpisode, tail) => {
      return /\/(tv|series|show|anime)\//i.test(out) ? slash + se + '/' + ep + tail : m;
    });
  }
  return out;
}

function episodeCandidateUrls(url, episode) {
  if (episode == null) return [];
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (/(?:\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]\d+|-ep(?:isode)?-\d+|[?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=\d+)/i.test(u.href)) return [];
    const path = u.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!path || path === '/') return [];
    return [u.origin + path + '/ep-' + episode, u.origin + path + '/episode-' + episode];
  } catch { return []; }
}

function findEpisodeUrl(html, base, season, episode) {
  if (episode == null) return '';
  const stripEpisode = value => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(value);
      return u.origin + u.pathname
        .replace(/\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]\d+(?:\/|$)/i, '/')
        .replace(/-ep(?:isode)?-\d+(?:\/|$)/i, '/')
        .replace(/\/$/, '');
    } catch { return ''; }
  };
  const baseKey = stripEpisode(base);
  let best = '', bestScore = -1;
  for (const m of String(html || '').matchAll(/<a\s[^>]*href\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]{0,500}?)<\/a>/gi)) {
    const url = abs(decodeEntities(m[1] || ''), base);
    if (!url || !guardUrl(url) || !sameSite(url, base)) continue;
    const openTag = m[0].slice(0, m[0].indexOf('>') + 1);
    const text = normalizeTitle(attr(openTag, 'title') || stripTags(m[2] || ''));
    const epMatches = [
      new RegExp('/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]' + episode + '(?:[/?#]|$)', 'i'),
      new RegExp('-ep(?:isode)?-' + episode + '(?:[/?#]|$)', 'i'),
      new RegExp('[?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=' + episode + '(?:[&#]|$)', 'i'),
    ].some(re => re.test(url));
    const textMatches = text === String(episode) || text === 'episode ' + episode || text === 'ep ' + episode;
    if (!epMatches && !textMatches) continue;
    let score = epMatches ? 60 : 40;
    if (baseKey && stripEpisode(url) === baseKey) score += 25;
    const seasonInUrl = explicitSeason(url);
    if (seasonInUrl != null) score += seasonInUrl === Number(season || 1) ? 20 : -50;
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = url; }
  }
  return bestScore >= 40 ? best : '';
}
function cleanVariants(query) {
  const values = [query.title, ...(Array.isArray(query.alternatives) ? query.alternatives : []), query.alt].flatMap(v => String(v || '').split('|'));
  const seen = new Set(), out = [];
  for (const v of values) {
    const clean = String(v || '').replace(/\s*\(source test\)\s*$/i, '').trim().slice(0, 140);
    const key = normalizeTitle(clean);
    if (clean && key && !seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); out.push(clean); }
  }
  return out.slice(0, 12);
}

async function resolveMatchedWatch(matchUrl, query) {
  const isTv = query.type === 'tv' || query.type === 'series';
  const adjusted = isTv ? adjustEpisodeInUrl(matchUrl, query.season || 1, query.episode || 1) : matchUrl;
  const attempts = [...new Set([adjusted, matchUrl].filter(Boolean))];
  let last = null;

  for (const candidateUrl of attempts) {
    const safe = guardUrl(candidateUrl);
    if (!safe) continue;
    try {
      const doc = await fetchDocument(safe.href, false, 8000);
      let watch = parseWatch(doc.text, doc.finalUrl);
      let watchUrl = doc.finalUrl;
      let resolvedEpisode = false;
      if (isTv && !watch.embed && !watch.direct.length) {
        let episodeUrl = findEpisodeUrl(doc.text, doc.finalUrl, query.season || 1, query.episode || 1);
        if (episodeUrl) resolvedEpisode = true;
        if (episodeUrl && episodeUrl !== doc.finalUrl) {
          const epDoc = await fetchDocument(episodeUrl, false, 8000);
          watch = parseWatch(epDoc.text, epDoc.finalUrl);
          watchUrl = episodeUrl;
        } else if (!episodeUrl) {
          for (const inferredUrl of episodeCandidateUrls(doc.finalUrl, query.episode || 1)) {
            try {
              const epDoc = await fetchDocument(inferredUrl, false, 7000);
              const epPattern = new RegExp('(?:/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]' + (query.episode || 1) + '(?:[/?#]|$)|-ep(?:isode)?-' + (query.episode || 1) + '(?:[/?#]|$))', 'i');
              const looksLikeEpisode = epPattern.test(epDoc.finalUrl) || !!findEpisodeUrl(epDoc.text, epDoc.finalUrl, query.season || 1, query.episode || 1);
              if (!looksLikeEpisode) continue;
              watch = parseWatch(epDoc.text, epDoc.finalUrl);
              watchUrl = epPattern.test(epDoc.finalUrl) ? epDoc.finalUrl : inferredUrl;
              episodeUrl = watchUrl;
              resolvedEpisode = true;
              break;
            } catch {}
          }
        }
      }
      last = { watch, watchUrl };
      if (watch.direct.length || watch.embed) return last;
      if (resolvedEpisode) return last;
      if (isTv && candidateUrl === adjusted && adjusted !== matchUrl) return last;
    } catch {}
  }
  return last || { watch: { embed: '', embeds: [], direct: [], servers: [], embedHosts: [] }, watchUrl: adjusted || matchUrl };
}

async function findTitleOnSite(rawSiteUrl, rawQuery) {
  const site = guardUrl(rawSiteUrl);
  if (!site) throw new Error('Invalid or blocked site URL');
  const query = {
    title: String(rawQuery.title || rawQuery.q || '').trim(),
    alternatives: rawQuery.alternatives || [],
    alt: rawQuery.alt || '',
    type: rawQuery.type || 'movie',
    year: rawQuery.year || '',
    season: Number(rawQuery.season || 1) || 1,
    episode: Number(rawQuery.episode || 1) || 1,
    imdb: String(rawQuery.imdb || '').toLowerCase(),
    tmdb: Number(rawQuery.tmdb || rawQuery.tmdbId || 0) || null,
  };
  const variants = cleanVariants(query);
  if (!variants.length) throw new Error('A catalogue title is required');

  let homeDoc = null;
  try { homeDoc = await fetchDocument(site.href, false, 7000); } catch {}
  const templates = [];
  if (rawQuery.searchTemplate) addTemplate(templates, rawQuery.searchTemplate, site.href);
  if (homeDoc) for (const t of searchTemplatesFromHtml(homeDoc.text, homeDoc.finalUrl)) addTemplate(templates, t, site.href);
  for (const t of commonSearchTemplates(site.href)) addTemplate(templates, t, site.href);

  let best = null;
  let checked = 0;
  const consider = (candidates, strategy) => {
    for (const candidate of candidates || []) {
      if (!guardUrl(candidate.url) || !sameSite(candidate.url, site.href)) continue;
      const identity = identifyTitleCandidate(candidate, variants, query);
      const score = identity.score;
      checked++;
      const epPattern = /(?:\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]\d+|-ep(?:isode)?-\d+|[?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=\d+)/i;
      const episodeTie = best && score === best.score && (query.type === 'tv' || query.type === 'series') && epPattern.test(candidate.url) && !epPattern.test(best.url);
      if (!best || score > best.score || episodeTie) best = { score, url: candidate.url, strategy, title: candidate.title || candidate.slugTitle || '', identity };
    }
  };

  if (homeDoc) {
    consider(parseResultLinks(homeDoc.text, homeDoc.finalUrl), 'site-home');
    const homeTitle = pageTitle(homeDoc.text).replace(/\s+[-|–—].*$/, '');
    consider([{ title: homeTitle, slugTitle: candidateSlugTitle(homeDoc.finalUrl), url: homeDoc.finalUrl }], 'pasted-page');
  }

  let searchFetches = 0;
  outer:
  for (let vi = 0; vi < variants.length; vi++) {
    if (best && best.score >= 95) break;
    if (vi > 0 && best && best.score >= 80) break;
    for (const template of templates.slice(0, 8)) {
      if (searchFetches >= 10) break outer;
      const searchUrl = guardUrl(buildSearchUrl(template, variants[vi]));
      if (!searchUrl || !sameSite(searchUrl.href, site.href)) continue;
      searchFetches++;
      try {
        const doc = await fetchDocument(searchUrl.href, false, 6000);
        consider(parseResultLinks(doc.text, doc.finalUrl), 'site-search');
        const finalTitle = pageTitle(doc.text).replace(/\s+[-|–—].*$/, '');
        if (!BLOCKED_PATH.test(new URL(doc.finalUrl).pathname)) {
          consider([{ title: finalTitle, slugTitle: candidateSlugTitle(doc.finalUrl), url: doc.finalUrl }], 'search-redirect');
        }
        if (best && best.score >= 98) break outer;
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  if (!best || best.score < 80) {
    return { ok: true, mode: 'find', matched: false, checked, searchFetches, bestScore: best ? best.score : 0, identity: best ? best.identity : null, bestTitle: best ? best.title : '' };
  }

  const resolved = await resolveMatchedWatch(best.url, query);
  const watch = resolved.watch;
  const playUrl = (watch.direct && watch.direct[0]) || watch.embed || resolved.watchUrl;
  return {
    ok: true,
    mode: 'find',
    matched: true,
    checked,
    searchFetches,
    match: { score: best.score, strategy: best.strategy, title: best.title || '' },
    identity: best.identity || null,
    matchedUrl: best.url,
    watchUrl: resolved.watchUrl,
    watchTitle: watch.title || '',
    playUrl,
    embed: watch.embed || '',
    embeds: watch.embeds || [],
    direct: watch.direct || [],
    servers: watch.servers || [],
    embedHosts: watch.embedHosts || [],
    pageFallback: !watch.embed && !(watch.direct && watch.direct.length),
  };
}

async function handle(mode, rawUrl, query) {
  query = query || {};
  const u = guardUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!u) return { status: 400, body: { ok: false, error: 'Invalid or blocked URL' } };
  try {
    if (mode === 'json') {
      const text = await fetchText(u.href, true, 10000);
      let data; try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { return { status: 502, body: { ok: false, error: 'Remote did not return JSON' } }; }
      return { status: 200, body: data, raw: true };
    }
    if (mode === 'profile') return { status: 200, body: await profileSite(u.href) };
    if (mode === 'find') {
      const body = await findTitleOnSite(u.href, {
        title: query.q || query.title || '',
        alt: query.alt || '',
        type: query.type || 'movie',
        year: query.year || '',
        season: query.season || 1,
        episode: query.episode || 1,
        imdb: query.imdb || '',
        tmdb: query.tmdb || '',
        searchTemplate: query.searchTemplate || '',
      });
      return { status: 200, body };
    }
    const doc = await fetchDocument(u.href, false, 10000);
    if (mode === 'text') {
      if (!isM3uText(doc.text)) return { status: 415, body: { ok: false, error: 'Remote did not return an M3U/M3U8 playlist' } };
      if (doc.truncated) return { status: 413, body: { ok: false, error: 'Remote playlist is larger than the resolver safety limit' } };
      return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, mode: 'text', url: doc.finalUrl, text: doc.text } };
    }
    if (mode === 'm3u') {
      return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, mode: 'm3u', url: doc.finalUrl, truncated: !!doc.truncated, ...extractM3u(doc.text, doc.finalUrl) } };
    }
    return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, mode: 'watch', url: doc.finalUrl, truncated: !!doc.truncated, ...parseWatch(doc.text, doc.finalUrl) } };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 502, body: { ok: false, error: 'Site lookup failed: ' + (e && e.message || e) } };
  }
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') return { statusCode: 405, headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'Method not allowed' }) };
  const q = event.queryStringParameters || {};
  const mode = String(q.mode || 'profile');
  if (!['profile', 'find', 'watch', 'json', 'text', 'm3u'].includes(mode)) return { statusCode: 400, headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'Unknown mode' }) };
  const out = await handle(mode, String(q.url || ''), q);
  return { statusCode: out.status, headers: H, body: JSON.stringify(out.body) };
};
exports._parse = { parseWatch, extractM3u, isM3uText, parseResultLinks, guardUrl, serverNames, normalizeTitle, titleScore, identifyTitleCandidate, explicitEpisodeInfo, extractCandidateIds, searchTemplatesFromHtml, commonSearchTemplates, buildSearchUrl, adjustEpisodeInUrl, findEpisodeUrl, episodeCandidateUrls };
exports._find = { profileSite, findTitleOnSite, handle };
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/netlify/functions/find.js`

```javascript
'use strict';

const api = require('../../api/find');

exports.handler = async event => {
  let body = null;
  if (event.body) {
    try { body = JSON.parse(event.body); } catch { body = event.body; }
  }
  const req = {
    method: event.httpMethod,
    query: event.queryStringParameters || {},
    body,
    headers: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(event.headers || {}).map(([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])),
    socket: { remoteAddress: event.headers && (event.headers['x-nf-client-connection-ip'] || event.headers['x-forwarded-for']) || 'unknown' },
  };
  let statusCode = 200;
  const headers = {};
  let responseBody = '';
  const res = {
    setHeader(name, value) { headers[name] = value; },
    status(code) { statusCode = code; return this; },
    json(value) { responseBody = JSON.stringify(value); return value; },
  };
  await api(req, res);
  return { statusCode, headers, body: responseBody };
};
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/netlify/functions/tmdb.js`

```javascript
/* ZeroPlay RD — TMDB catalog proxy (Netlify Function)
 * Ported from ZeroPlay web/functions/tmdb.js + web/lib/catalog.cjs,
 * inlined so this folder is fully self-contained.
 * Set ONE env var in Netlify:  TMDB_API_KEY (v3 key)  or  TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN (v4 bearer).
 * Only allowlisted TMDB routes/params are forwarded — this is not an open proxy.
 */
'use strict';

function endpoint(path) {
  return typeof path === 'string' && (
    /^\/(trending\/all\/(day|week)|movie\/(popular|top_rated|now_playing|upcoming)|tv\/(popular|airing_today|on_the_air)|search\/(multi|person)|watch\/providers\/(movie|tv)|discover\/(movie|tv))$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/(movie|tv)\/[1-9]\d{0,9}(\/season\/\d{1,4})?$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/person\/[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/collection\/[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(path)
  );
}

const SORTS = new Set([
  'popularity.desc', 'vote_average.desc', 'vote_count.desc',
  'primary_release_date.desc', 'primary_release_date.asc',
  'first_air_date.desc', 'first_air_date.asc',
  'revenue.desc', 'title.asc', 'name.asc',
]);

function query(params) {
  if (!params || !endpoint(params.path)) throw Error('Unsupported catalog route');
  const allowed = new Set(['query', 'page', 'append_to_response', 'include_image_language', 'watch_region',
    'with_watch_providers', 'with_watch_monetization_types', 'sort_by', 'with_genres', 'with_original_language',
    'primary_release_date.gte', 'primary_release_date.lte', 'first_air_date.gte', 'first_air_date.lte',
    'vote_average.gte', 'vote_count.gte', 'with_runtime.lte', 'with_origin_country']);
  const out = new URLSearchParams({ include_adult: 'false' });
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (name === 'path') continue;
    if (!allowed.has(name) || typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 200) throw Error('Unsupported parameter');
    if (name === 'page' && (!/^[1-9]\d{0,2}$/.test(value) || Number(value) > 500)) throw Error('Invalid page');
    if (name === 'append_to_response' && !['credits,videos,recommendations', 'credits,videos,recommendations,external_ids', 'external_ids', 'credits,videos,recommendations,images', 'videos', 'videos,images', 'images', 'combined_credits'].includes(value)) throw Error('Invalid details request');
    if (name === 'include_image_language' && !/^(?:[a-z]{2}|null)(?:,(?:[a-z]{2}|null)){0,4}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid image language');
    if (name === 'watch_region' && !['PH', 'US', 'GB', 'CA', 'AU', 'IN', 'JP', 'ZA'].includes(value)) throw Error('Invalid region');
    if (name === 'with_watch_providers' && !/^[1-9]\d{0,7}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid provider');
    if (name === 'with_watch_monetization_types' && value !== 'flatrate') throw Error('Invalid availability');
    if (name === 'sort_by' && !SORTS.has(value)) throw Error('Invalid sorting');
    if (name === 'with_genres' && !/^\d{1,8}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid genre');
    if (name === 'with_original_language' && !/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid language');
    if (['primary_release_date.gte', 'primary_release_date.lte', 'first_air_date.gte', 'first_air_date.lte'].includes(name) && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid date filter');
    if (name === 'vote_average.gte' && (!/^\d(?:\.\d)?$/.test(value) || Number(value) > 10)) throw Error('Invalid rating');
    if (name === 'vote_count.gte' && !/^\d{1,7}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid vote filter');
    if (name === 'with_runtime.lte' && (!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(value) || Number(value) > 600)) throw Error('Invalid runtime');
    if (name === 'with_origin_country' && !/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid country');
    out.set(name, value);
  }
  return out;
}

const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff' };
const respond = (statusCode, body, extra = {}) => ({ statusCode, headers: { ...headers, ...extra }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') return respond(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' }, { Allow: 'GET' });

  let params;
  try { params = query(event.queryStringParameters || {}); }
  catch { return respond(400, { error: 'Invalid catalog request' }); }

  const v3 = process.env.TMDB_API_KEY;
  const v4 = process.env.TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN;
  if (!v3 && !v4) return respond(503, { error: 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.', code: 'TMDB_NOT_CONFIGURED' });

  const path = event.queryStringParameters.path;
  const url = new URL('https://api.themoviedb.org/3' + path);
  if (v3) params.set('api_key', v3);
  url.search = params.toString();

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json', ...(v4 && !v3 ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + v4 } : {}) },
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      return respond(response.status === 429 ? 429 : 502,
        { error: 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.' },
        response.status === 429 ? { 'Retry-After': '30' } : {});
    }
    const data = await response.json();
    return respond(200, data, {
      'Cache-Control': path === '/search/multi' ? 'private, max-age=60' : 'public, max-age=300, s-maxage=300',
    });
  } catch {
    return respond(502, { error: 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.' });
  }
};
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/server.js`

```javascript
'use strict';

const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { URL } = require('node:url');
const { findCandidates, normalizeIdentity } = require('./lib/server-finder/core');
const findApi = require('./api/find');

const APP_ROOT = __dirname;
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16 * 1024;
const RATE_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 1000;
const RATE_LIMIT = 8;
const requestBuckets = new Map();
const API_HANDLERS = {
  '/api/extract': require('./api/extract'),
  '/api/tmdb': require('./api/tmdb'),
};

function jsonResponse(res, status, value, headers = {}) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', ...headers });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function readBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let size = 0;
    const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', chunk => {
      size += chunk.length;
      if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { reject(new Error('Request body too large')); req.destroy(); return; }
      chunks.push(chunk);
    });
    req.on('end', () => {
      if (!chunks.length) return resolve(null);
      try { resolve(JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'))); }
      catch { reject(new Error('Invalid JSON body')); }
    });
    req.on('error', reject);
  });
}

function sameOrigin(req) {
  const origin = req.headers.origin;
  if (!origin) return true;
  try { return new URL(origin).host.toLowerCase() === String(req.headers.host || '').toLowerCase(); }
  catch { return false; }
}

function allowRequest(req, now = Date.now()) {
  const key = String(req.socket && req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown');
  const bucket = requestBuckets.get(key);
  if (!bucket || now - bucket.start >= RATE_WINDOW_MS) {
    requestBuckets.set(key, { start: now, count: 1 });
    return true;
  }
  if (bucket.count >= RATE_LIMIT) return false;
  bucket.count++;
  return true;
}

function localApiResponse(res) {
  let statusCode = 200;
  const headers = {};
  return {
    setHeader(name, value) { headers[name] = value; },
    status(code) { statusCode = code; return this; },
    json(value) {
      if (!res.headersSent) res.writeHead(statusCode, headers);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(value));
      return value;
    },
  };
}

async function handleFind(req, res, url) {
  if (!['GET', 'POST'].includes(req.method)) {
    res.setHeader('Allow', 'GET, POST');
    return jsonResponse(res, 405, { ok: false, error: 'Method not allowed' });
  }
  if (!sameOrigin(req)) return jsonResponse(res, 403, { ok: false, error: 'Same-origin requests only' });
  if (!allowRequest(req)) return jsonResponse(res, 429, { ok: false, error: 'Server Finder is rate limited; please retry shortly.' }, { 'Retry-After': '60' });
  let body = null;
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try { body = await readBody(req); }
    catch (error) { return jsonResponse(res, error.message === 'Request body too large' ? 413 : 400, { ok: false, error: error.message }); }
  }
  const identityInput = req.method === 'GET' ? {
    title: url.searchParams.get('q') || url.searchParams.get('title'),
    titles: (url.searchParams.get('titles') || '').split('|'), type: url.searchParams.get('type'),
    year: url.searchParams.get('year'), season: url.searchParams.get('season'), episode: url.searchParams.get('episode'),
    imdbId: url.searchParams.get('imdbId'), tmdbId: url.searchParams.get('tmdbId'),
  } : body && (body.identity || body);
  let identity;
  try { identity = normalizeIdentity(identityInput); }
  catch (error) { return jsonResponse(res, 400, { ok: false, error: error.message || 'Invalid title identity' }); }
  const result = await findCandidates(identity, {
    limit: 24, maxPerSource: 8, timeoutMs: 4500, workerTimeoutMs: 30000,
    sourceConcurrency: 8, useWorkerThreads: true,
  });
  return jsonResponse(res, 200, result, { 'Cache-Control': 'private, max-age=20, stale-while-revalidate=30' });
}

async function handleApi(req, res, url, pathname) {
  if (pathname === '/api/health') return jsonResponse(res, 200, { ok: true, service: 'ZeroPlay Server Finder', mode: 'local-worker-threads', sources: 3, maxCandidatePool: 1000, workerThreads: true });
  if (pathname === '/api/find') return handleFind(req, res, url);
  const handler = API_HANDLERS[pathname];
  if (!handler) return jsonResponse(res, 404, { ok: false, error: 'Not found' });
  let body = null;
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try { body = await readBody(req); }
    catch (error) { return jsonResponse(res, 400, { ok: false, error: error.message }); }
  }
  const query = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());
  const adaptedReq = Object.assign(req, { query, body });
  return handler(adaptedReq, localApiResponse(res));
}

function appHtml() {
  for (const file of [path.join(APP_ROOT, 'index.html'), path.join(APP_ROOT, 'dist/index.html')]) {
    try { return fs.readFileSync(file); } catch {}
  }
  return Buffer.from('ZeroPlay build is missing. Run npm run build first.');
}

function createLocalServer() {
  const html = appHtml();
  return http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    let url;
    try { url = new URL(req.url || '/', 'http://' + (req.headers.host || 'localhost')); }
    catch { return jsonResponse(res, 400, { ok: false, error: 'Invalid request URL' }); }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
      try { await handleApi(req, res, url, url.pathname); }
      catch { if (!res.headersSent) jsonResponse(res, 502, { ok: false, error: 'Server Finder request failed' }); else res.end(); }
      return;
    }
    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
      res.writeHead(405, { Allow: 'GET, HEAD' });
      return res.end();
    }
    res.writeHead(200, {
      'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Content-Length': html.length,
      'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'Referrer-Policy': 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
      'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https:; frame-src https:; media-src https: blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'",
    });
    if (req.method === 'HEAD') return res.end();
    return res.end(html);
  });
}

if (require.main === module) {
  const port = Math.max(1, Math.min(65535, Number(process.env.PORT) || 8787));
  const host = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';
  const server = createLocalServer();
  server.listen(port, host, () => console.log('ZeroPlay Server Finder listening on ' + host + ':' + port));
}

module.exports = { createLocalServer, handleFind, readBody, sameOrigin, allowRequest, MAX_BODY_BYTES, RATE_LIMIT };
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/accessibility-prefs.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "..", "index.html"), "utf8");
const checks = [
  ["dark is the default theme", html.includes('theme:"dark"')],
  ["theme choices include OLED and warm", ["oled", "warm", "light"].every(value => html.includes(`value="${value}"`))],
  ["text scaling offers standard, large, and extra large", ["normal", "large", "xl"].every(value => html.includes(`value="${value}"`))],
  ["high contrast preference is exposed accessibly", html.includes('id="uiHighContrast" data-ui-preference="highContrast"')],
  ["theme and text scale classes are applied", ["theme-oled", "theme-warm", "font-large", "font-xl"].every(name => html.includes(`classList.toggle(\"${name}\"`))],
  ["preference changes persist and reapply the interface", html.includes('closest("[data-ui-preference]")') && html.includes("saveSettings(); applyInterfaceSettings();")],
  ["unrecognized themes and text scales fall back safely", html.includes('["dark","oled","warm","light"].includes(ui.theme)') && html.includes('["normal","large","xl"].includes(ui.textScale)')],
  ["display preference theme styles are present", ["body.theme-oled", "body.theme-warm", "body.high-contrast"].every(name => html.includes(name))],
];

for (const [name, passed] of checks) {
  assert.ok(passed, `FAIL ${name}`);
  console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
}
console.log(`\n${checks.length} accessibility/display preference checks passed`);
```

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const vm = require('vm');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');

const webRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const repoRoot = path.resolve(webRoot, '..', '..');
const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(webRoot, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const script = html.slice(html.indexOf('<script>') + 8, html.lastIndexOf('</script>'));

function between(start, end) {
  const a = script.indexOf(start);
  assert(a >= 0, 'missing start ' + start);
  const b = script.indexOf(end, a + start.length);
  assert(b > a, 'missing end ' + end);
  return script.slice(a, b);
}
function response(data, status = 200) {
  return {
    ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,
    status,
    async json() { return data; },
    async text() { return typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data); },

}
class FakeImage {

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (String(value).includes('broken')) {
        if (this.onerror) this.onerror(new Error('broken test image'));
      } else if (this.onload) {
        this.onload();
      }
    }, 0);
  }
  get src() { return this._src || ''; }
}

let cinemetaResult = null;

  esc: s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c])),
  tvPerformanceEnabled: () => true,

  async cinemetaFetch(url) {

  },
  async fetch(url, _opts) {
    const u = String(url);
    fetchCalls.push(u);
    if (u.includes('api.tvmaze.com/search/shows')) {

      ]);
    }
    if (u.includes('api.tvmaze.com/lookup/shows')) return response({}, 404);
    if (u.includes('graphql.anilist.co')) {
      return response({ data: { Page: { media: [{
        seasonYear: 1999,
        title: { english: 'One Piece', romaji: 'One Piece', native: 'ワンピース' },
        synonyms: [],
        coverImage: { extraLarge: 'https://img.test/one-piece-xl.jpg', large: 'https://img.test/one-piece-large.jpg', medium: 'https://img.test/one-piece-medium.jpg' },
        bannerImage: 'https://img.test/one-piece-banner.jpg',

ctx.globalThis = ctx;

vm.runInContext([

let passed = 0;
const ok = (condition, label) => { assert(condition, label); passed++; console.log('PASS', label); };
const eq = (actual, expected, label) => { assert.strictEqual(actual, expected, label); passed++; console.log('PASS', label); };

(async () => {
  eq(
    ctx.cleanArtworkUrl('https://images.metahub.space/poster/large/tt0903747/img.jpg', 'poster'),

  eq(

  eq(ctx.cleanArtworkUrl('https://example.test/no-poster-placeholder.jpg', 'poster'), '', 'provider placeholder images are rejected');

  ok(ctx.artworkCandidateMatches(['Breaking Bad'], ['2008-01-20'], breakingBad), 'artwork accepts an exact title/year match');
  ok(!ctx.artworkCandidateMatches(['Breaking Bad'], ['1999-01-01'], breakingBad), 'artwork rejects the same title from the wrong year');

  cinemetaResult = { meta: {
    poster: 'https://images.metahub.space/poster/small/tt0903747/img.jpg',
    background: 'https://images.metahub.space/background/large/tt0903747/img.jpg',
    logo: 'https://images.metahub.space/logo/medium/tt0903747/img.png',
    imdb_id: 'tt0903747',
  } };
  const cinemetaItem = { ...breakingBad, id: 9001, imdb_id: 'tt0903747' };
  const cinemetaArt = await ctx.resolveArtwork(cinemetaItem, { backdrop: true });
  eq(cinemetaArt.provider, 'Cinemeta / MetaHub', 'Cinemeta/MetaHub is the first keyless artwork provider');
  ok(cinemetaArt.poster.includes('/poster/medium/'), 'Cinemeta poster is browser-ready at medium size');
  eq(cinemetaItem.poster_url, cinemetaArt.poster, 'resolved Cinemeta poster is applied to the catalogue item');

  cinemetaResult = { meta: null };
  const tvmazeItem = { ...breakingBad, id: 9002 };
  const beforeTvmazeFetch = fetchCalls.length;
  const tvmazeArt = await ctx.resolveArtwork(tvmazeItem, {});
  eq(tvmazeArt.provider, 'TVmaze', 'TVmaze supplies series artwork when Cinemeta has none');
  eq(tvmazeArt.poster, 'https://img.test/breaking-bad-medium.jpg', 'TV performance mode chooses TVmaze medium artwork');
  ok(fetchCalls.slice(beforeTvmazeFetch).some(u => u.includes('api.tvmaze.com/search/shows')), 'TVmaze public search requires no user key');

  ctx.settings.artwork.cinemeta = false;
  ctx.settings.artwork.tvmaze = false;
  const animeItem = {
    id: 9003,
    media_type: 'tv',
    name: 'One Piece',
    first_air_date: '1999-10-20',
    genre_ids: [16],
    original_language: 'ja',
    origin_country: ['JP'],
  };
  const anilistArt = await ctx.resolveArtwork(animeItem, { backdrop: true });
  eq(anilistArt.provider, 'AniList', 'AniList supplies anime artwork without user authentication');
  eq(anilistArt.poster, 'https://img.test/one-piece-large.jpg', 'AniList large cover is the constrained-TV rendition');
  eq(anilistArt.backdrop, 'https://img.test/one-piece-banner.jpg', 'AniList banner fills the wide TV surface');

  ctx.settings.artwork.anilist = false;
  const inception = { id: 9004, media_type: 'movie', title: 'Inception', release_date: '2010-07-16' };
  const itunesArt = await ctx.resolveArtwork(inception, {});
  eq(itunesArt.provider, 'Apple iTunes', 'iTunes is a keyless final artwork fallback');

  ctx.settings.artwork.enabled = true;
  ctx.settings.artwork.cinemeta = true;
  ctx.settings.artwork.tvmaze = true;
  ctx.settings.artwork.anilist = true;

  cinemetaResult = { meta: { poster: 'https://img.test/broken-poster.jpg', background: '', imdb_id: 'tt0903747' } };
  const brokenItem = { ...breakingBad, id: 9006, imdb_id: 'tt0903747' };
  const recoveredArt = await ctx.resolveArtwork(brokenItem, {});
  eq(recoveredArt.provider, 'TVmaze', 'a broken provider image is probed out and the next provider is tried');

  ctx.__setDiscoveryRuntime({ cycleRunning: false, running: true, lastFoundAt: 0, lastFoundCount: 0, lastError: '' });
  eq(ctx.sourceReadiness().label, 'Ready', 'source status simplifies to Ready');
  ctx.__setDiscoveryRuntime({ cycleRunning: true });
  eq(ctx.sourceReadiness().label, 'Searching', 'active lookup simplifies to Searching');
  ctx.__setDiscoveryRuntime({ cycleRunning: false, lastFoundAt: Date.now(), lastFoundCount: 2 });
  eq(ctx.sourceReadiness().label, 'Found sources', 'a recent successful lookup says Found sources');
  ctx.__readySources = [];
  eq(ctx.sourceReadiness().label, 'Problem', 'no enabled sources says Problem instead of zero counters');
  const normalStatus = ctx.discoveryStatusText();
  ok(!/cycle|identified\/installed|awaiting identification|total providers|last never|registry cap/i.test(normalStatus), 'normal source status contains no engineering counters');
  ok(/Diagnostics:/.test(ctx.discoveryDiagnosticsText()), 'detailed source counters remain available only as diagnostics');
  ctx.__readySources = [{ id: 'a' }];
  ctx.__setDiscoveryRuntime({ lastFoundAt: 0, lastFoundCount: 0 });
  const panel = ctx.sourceStatusPanelHTML();
  ok(panel.includes('btnSourceStateSearch') && panel.includes('Find more') && panel.includes('Advanced'), 'source panel offers one primary action and one Advanced door');
  ok(!/awaiting identification|registry|total providers|cycle/i.test(panel), 'source panel does not expose registry language');

  const androidJavaPath = path.join(repoRoot, 'tv/android-tv/app/src/main/java/com/savage/zeroplay/tv/MainActivity.java');
  const androidManifestPath = path.join(repoRoot, 'tv/android-tv/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml');
  const androidGradlePath = path.join(repoRoot, 'tv/android-tv/app/build.gradle.kts');
  const androidJava = fs.readFileSync(androidJavaPath, 'utf8');
  const androidManifest = fs.readFileSync(androidManifestPath, 'utf8');
  const androidGradle = fs.readFileSync(androidGradlePath, 'utf8');
  const indexDetection = html.indexOf('const ANDROID_TV_APP=');
  const indexSettings = html.indexOf('settings.stream=Object.assign');
  const staticChecks = [
    [indexDetection >= 0 && indexSettings > indexDetection, 'Android TV detection happens before web settings defaults'],
    [html.includes('ZeroPlayTV\\/') && html.includes('window.ZeroPlayAndroidTV'), 'native user-agent and bridge both activate TV mode'],
    [html.includes('settings.artwork=Object.assign({enabled:true,cinemeta:true,tvmaze:true,anilist:true,itunes:true}'), 'four artwork providers are ready with zero user configuration'],
    [!html.includes('settings.tmdbKey') && !html.includes('settings.artworkKey'), 'no user-entered artwork/TMDB API key exists'],
    [html.includes('ANDROID_TV_APP&&resumeItems.length?resumeHTML+heroHTML'), 'Android TV puts instant resume before the featured hero'],
    [html.includes('Couch-first Android TV') && html.includes('flex-basis:clamp(430px,34vw,570px)'), 'TV home uses large artwork-first rows instead of dashboard density'],
    [html.includes('body.android-tv .menu-category-list') && html.includes('body.android-tv .filters'), 'text-heavy category/filter chrome is removed from the TV normal path'],
    [html.includes('function applyTvSourcesLayout') && html.includes('"sourceStatePanel","settingsAddWebsite","settingsPlaybackSources"'), 'TV Sources opens as status plus two useful panels, not every control'],
    [html.includes('Advanced &amp; diagnostics') && html.includes('id="discoveryDiagnostics"'), 'source counters are contained in an Advanced diagnostics disclosure'],
    [html.includes('featureSwitchHTML("discovery","Find sources automatically"') && !html.includes('featureSwitchHTML("dnsWarm","Connect faster","Prepare source connections in advance.","menu")'), 'menu quick settings keep engineering switches out'],
    [html.includes('function handleZeroPlayTvBack') && html.includes('function handleZeroPlayTvMediaKey') && html.includes('function handleZeroPlayTvLowMemory'), 'web app exposes the native remote and low-memory contract'],
    [androidManifest.includes('LEANBACK_LAUNCHER') && androidManifest.includes('android.software.leanback') && androidManifest.includes('@drawable/tv_banner'), 'native app is discoverable as an Android TV Leanback app'],
    [androidGradle.includes('include("armeabi-v7a")') && androidGradle.includes('isUniversalApk = false') && androidGradle.includes('applicationId = "com.savage.zeroplay.tv"'), 'native release is explicitly scoped to the Xiaomi box ARMv7 userspace'],
    [androidJava.includes('KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE') && androidJava.includes('handleZeroPlayTvBack') && androidJava.includes('ZeroPlayTV/'), 'native shell forwards D-pad/media keys and identifies itself to the web app'],
    [androidJava.includes('onTrimMemory') && androidJava.includes('handleZeroPlayTvLowMemory') && androidJava.includes('totalMemoryMb'), 'native shell reports memory and asks the web app to shed previews under pressure'],
    [fs.existsSync(path.join(repoRoot, 'tv/android-tv/app/src/main/res/drawable-xhdpi/tv_banner.png')) && fs.existsSync(path.join(repoRoot, 'tv/android-tv/app/src/main/res/mipmap-xxxhdpi/ic_launcher.png')), 'TV launcher banner and icons are present'],
    [html.includes('tabindex="0" data-switch-label="1"') && html.includes('closest("[data-switch-label]")'), 'menu/settings switches are D-pad focusable and toggle with OK so menus can scroll'],
    [html.includes('lastTvFocusPoint') && html.includes('nearestDist<900') && html.includes('function tvFocusAndReveal'), 'lost TV focus recovers near the last position instead of jumping to the top'],
    [html.includes('currentRail&&!currentRail.contains(el)') && html.includes('if(movedTv||ANDROID_TV_APP) e.preventDefault()'), 'rail left/right stays in-row and TV arrows never fall through to native WebView focus jumps'],
    [html.includes('if(sticky&&!(ANDROID_TV_APP&&playingNow)) return;') && html.includes('chrome-hidden') && html.includes('overlayEl.classList.contains("chrome-hidden")'), 'player menu auto-hides during TV playback and wakes on the next key press'],
    [html.includes('playerState.embedFocused=true') && html.includes('if(playerState.embedFocused){ playerState.embedFocused=false;'), 'embedded players get a real D-pad focus mode and Back returns to the ZeroPlay bar first'],
    [html.includes('if(e.key===\"Escape\")') && html.includes('if(handleZeroPlayTvBack()){ e.preventDefault(); return; }'), 'browser Escape mirrors native Android TV Back routing'],
    [html.includes('autoHighLevelId') && html.includes('autoHighBufferingSince'), 'FastStream auto quality starts at the highest level and steps down only on sustained buffering'],
    [html.includes('body.android-tv .settings-hub-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}') && html.includes('body.android-tv .modal{width:min(980px,94vw)') && html.includes('#btnPlayerDownload'), 'TV layout keeps settings on-screen and hides tool clutter from the player bar'],
    [html.includes('body.android-tv *{backdrop-filter:none!important;') && html.includes('animation-duration:.12s!important'), 'TV mode strips backdrop blur and caps animation cost for 2 GB boxes'],
    [html.includes('id=\"btnPlayerFastStream\"') && html.includes('id=\"btnPlayerM3u\"') && html.includes('id=\"btnHidePlayerChrome\"'), 'FastStream, M3U, and hide actions stay in the single player bar'],
    [!html.includes('player-action-shelf') && html.includes('player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-bar') && html.includes('player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-controls'), 'no paused duplicate overlay remains; one chrome layer hides cleanly'],
    [html.includes('function openM3uExtractorForContext') && html.includes('location.hash=\"#/downloads\"'), 'M3U button opens the real extractor workflow with current stream context'],
    [html.includes('input,select,textarea{border-radius:14px}') && html.includes('setting-control,.setting-control input,.setting-control .slider{border-radius:999px}'), 'TV inputs and solid toggles use rounded controls'],
    [((html.match(/in:name,description,readme/g)||[]).length >= 50), 'GitHub discovery registry contains at least 50 focused tool searches'],
  ];
  for (const [condition, label] of staticChecks) ok(condition, label);

  console.log(`\n${passed} Android TV/UI/artwork checks passed`);
})().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),assert=require('assert'),path=require('path');

function between(a,b){const i=script.indexOf(a);assert(i>=0,a);const j=script.indexOf(b,i+a.length);assert(j>i,b);return script.slice(i,j);}
const manifest=(id,name)=>({id,name,version:'1',resources:['stream','catalog','meta'],types:['movie','series'],idPrefixes:['tt'],catalogs:[{type:'movie',id:'top',extra:[{name:'search'}]}]});
const cinemetaManifest={id:'com.linvo.cinemeta',name:'Cinemeta',version:'3',resources:['catalog','meta','addon_catalog'],types:['movie','series'],idPrefixes:['tt'],addonCatalogs:[{type:'all',id:'community'},{type:'all',id:'official'}],catalogs:[]};
function response(data,status=200){return {ok:status>=200&&status<300,status,headers:{get(){return null;}},async json(){return data;},async text(){return typeof data==='string'?data:JSON.stringify(data);}};}
const fetchCalls=[];
async function fakeFetch(url){
  const u=String(url); fetchCalls.push(u);
  if(u.startsWith('/api/extract')) return response({ok:false},404);
  if(u==='https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/manifest.json') return response(cinemetaManifest);
  if(u.includes('v3-cinemeta.strem.io/addon_catalog/')) return response({addons:[{transportUrl:'https://graph.example/manifest.json',manifest:manifest('graph','Graph Addon')}]});
  if(u.includes('stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons')) return response({addons:[{manifestUrl:'https://listed.example/manifest.json',manifest:manifest('listed','Listed Addon'),stars:42,categories:[{slug:'movies'}],instances:[]}],pagination:{hasNextPage:false}});
  if(u.includes('api.github.com/search/repositories')) return response({total_count:1,items:[{full_name:'Example/GHAddon',name:'GHAddon',html_url:'https://github.com/Example/GHAddon',description:'A Stremio addon server',homepage:'https://gh-addon.example',topics:['stremio-addon'],stargazers_count:99,default_branch:'main',has_pages:false}]});
  if(u==='https://gh-addon.example/manifest.json') return response(manifest('gh','GitHub Hosted Addon'));
  if(u.includes('raw.githubusercontent.com/Example/GHAddon/main/README.md')) return response('Install https://gh-addon.example/manifest.json');
  if(u.includes('site.example/manifest.json')) return response({error:'not found'},404);
  return response({},404);
}
const context={
  console,URL,Set,Map,Date,Math,Number,String,Array,Object,RegExp,Promise,AbortController,setTimeout,clearTimeout,setInterval,clearInterval,
  fetch:fakeFetch,
  document:{getElementById(){return null;},activeElement:null},
  settings:{providers:[],providerTombstones:{},addons:[],sites:[],customSources:[],disabledSources:[],health:{},feed:{url:'',auto:true,intervalMin:15,lastCheck:0,healthAuto:true},discovery:{autoStart:true,intervalSec:90,crawlers:{catalogGraph:true,stremioAddons:true,github:true,githubProbe:true,candidateIdentification:true,feeds:true,websites:true,health:true},githubQueries:['topic:stremio-addon'],cursors:{},seeds:[],stats:{cycles:0}},stream:{quality:'auto'}},
  saveSettings(){},dlog(){},toast(){},routeNow(){return 'home';},renderSources(){},prettyHostName(h){return String(h).split('.')[0];},parseFeedData(){return [];},sourceSignature(s){return JSON.stringify(s);},isDirectMedia(u){return /\.(mp4|m3u8)$/i.test(String(u));},runHealthChecks:async()=>7,
  async registerWebsiteSource(raw){const u=new URL(raw);context.settings.sites.push({id:'site:'+u.hostname,name:'Example Site',base:u.origin,home:u.href,enabled:true,searchTemplate:u.origin+'/search?q={q}'});return {origin:u.origin,url:u.href,searchTemplate:u.origin+'/search?q={q}'};}
};
context.globalThis=context;vm.createContext(context);
vm.runInContext(between('const PROVIDER_CATEGORIES=','function streamIdsForAddon'),context,{filename:'discovery-extract.js'});
let n=0;const ok=(c,l)=>{assert(c,l);n++;console.log('PASS',l);};
(async()=>{
  const totals=await context.runDiscoveryCycle('test');
  const providers=context.settings.providers;
  ok(context.discoveryCfg().stats.cycles===1,'one continuous cycle completed');
  ok(providers.some(p=>p.name==='Cinemeta'&&p.status==='installed'&&p.categories.includes('discovery')),'Cinemeta server identified from manifest');
  ok(providers.some(p=>p.name==='Graph Addon'&&p.status==='candidate'&&p.titleScopedDiscovery),'recursive catalogue streaming addon waits for a title match');
  ok(providers.some(p=>p.name==='Listed Addon'&&p.status==='candidate'&&p.titleScopedDiscovery),'stremio-addons.net streaming addon waits for a title match');
  const gh=providers.find(p=>p.repoUrl==='https://github.com/Example/GHAddon');
  ok(gh&&gh.status==='candidate'&&gh.titleScopedDiscovery&&gh.name==='GitHub Hosted Addon','GitHub crawler identifies a hosted stream candidate without installing it');
  ok(gh.identification.supports.streams&&gh.identification.identifierModes.includes('imdb-id'),'GitHub candidate capabilities and title identifiers recorded');
  ok(context.settings.addons.length===0,'unmatched catalogue candidates are not imported as playback providers');
  ok(fetchCalls.some(u=>u.includes('api.github.com/search/repositories')),'GitHub crawler ran');
  ok(fetchCalls.some(u=>u.includes('/addon_catalog/all/community.json')),'catalogue graph crawler ran');
  ok(totals.errors.length===0,'mocked crawler cycle had no errors');
  const siteProvider=await context.addDiscoverySeed('https://site.example/watch');
  ok(siteProvider&&siteProvider.kind==='website-lookup'&&siteProvider.status==='installed','website seed identified as searchable lookup server');
  ok(siteProvider.identification.searchable&&siteProvider.identification.supports.episodeLookup,'website identification records title/episode search capability');
  console.log(`\n${n} crawler checks passed`);
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/discovery-identity.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const vm = require('vm');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const script = html.slice(html.indexOf('<script>') + 8, html.lastIndexOf('</script>'));

function between(start, end) {
  const a = script.indexOf(start);
  assert(a >= 0, 'missing start ' + start);
  const b = script.indexOf(end, a + start.length);
  assert(b > a, 'missing end ' + end);
  return script.slice(a, b);
}

const context = {
  console,
  URL,
  Set,
  Map,
  Date,
  Math,
  Number,
  String,
  Array,
  Object,
  RegExp,
  Promise,
  watchlist: [],
  document: { addEventListener() {}, querySelectorAll() { return []; }, body: { classList: { toggle() {} } } },
  settings: {
    providers: [], providerTombstones: {}, addons: [], sites: [],
    discovery: { crawlers: {}, cursors: {}, seeds: [], stats: {}, githubQueries: [] },
    stream: { quality: 'auto', maxFileSizeGb: 5 },
  },
  saveSettings() {},
  dlog() {},
  prettyHostName(host) { return String(host || 'Source').split('.')[0]; },
  capBytes() { return 5_000_000_000; },
  healthScore() { return 50; },
  async fetchImdbId() { return ''; },
};
context.globalThis = context;
vm.createContext(context);

const code = [
  between('function titleOf(it)', '/* ---------------- built-in title identifier'),
  between('/* ---------------- built-in title identifier', '/* ---------------- demo catalog'),
  between('const DEFAULT_GITHUB_QUERIES=', 'function upsertProvider(rec, opts)'),
  between('function upsertProvider(rec, opts)', 'function identifyWebsiteProvider'),
  between('function getProvider(id)', 'function providerCounts'),
  between('function streamIdsForAddon(addon, identity, imdb)', 'function enabledAddons'),
  between('function parseStreamMeta(s)', 'async function collectAllStreams'),
].join('\n');
vm.runInContext(code, context, { filename: 'extracted-client.js' });

let passed = 0;
function ok(cond, label) { assert(cond, label); passed++; console.log('PASS', label); }
function eq(a, b, label) { assert.deepStrictEqual(a, b, label + `: ${JSON.stringify(a)} !== ${JSON.stringify(b)}`); passed++; console.log('PASS', label); }

(async () => {
  const identity = context.buildTitleIdentity({
    type: 'tv', id: 1399, title: 'Game of Thrones', year: '2011', season: 1, episode: 2,
    imdb: 'tt0944947', altTitles: ['GoT', 'Juego de tronos'],
  });
  eq(identity.imdbId, 'tt0944947', 'identity keeps IMDb id');
  eq(identity.tmdbId, 1399, 'identity keeps TMDB id');
  ok(identity.titles.includes('Juego de tronos'), 'identity keeps alternative titles');

  const lolaIdentity = context.buildTitleIdentity({
    type: 'tv', id: 35281, title: 'My Heart Beats for Lola Volcán',
    original_name: 'Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán',
    external_ids: { imdb_id: 'tt1929755' }, year: '2011', season: 1, episode: 1,
  });
  eq(lolaIdentity.tmdbId, 35281, 'reference series keeps its TMDB ID');
  eq(lolaIdentity.imdbId, 'tt1929755', 'reference series keeps its IMDb ID');
  ok(lolaIdentity.titles.includes('Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán'), 'reference series searches its original Spanish title');
  ok(Array.from(context.streamIdsForAddon({ idPrefixes: ['tt'] }, lolaIdentity, lolaIdentity.imdbId)).join(',') === 'tt1929755:1:1', 'reference series builds exact IMDb episode ID');
  const lolaVerdict = context.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: 'Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán S01E01', type: 'series', year: '2011' }, lolaIdentity);
  ok(lolaVerdict.accepted, 'reference series verifies the Spanish title and requested episode');

  let verdict = context.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: 'Game of Thrones 2011 S01E02', type: 'series' }, identity);
  ok(verdict.accepted && verdict.score >= 95, 'exact series episode accepted');
  verdict = context.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: 'Game of Thrones S01E03' }, identity);
  ok(!verdict.accepted && verdict.hardReject, 'wrong episode hard-rejected');
  verdict = context.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: 'Game of Thrones', url: 'https://example.test/watch/tt9999999' }, identity);
  ok(!verdict.accepted && verdict.hardReject, 'wrong IMDb id hard-rejected');
  verdict = context.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: '1080p WEB-DL', url: 'https://cdn.example/file.mp4' }, identity, { idVerified: true });
  ok(verdict.accepted && verdict.score === 100, 'generic label accepted only through exact-ID route');
  verdict = context.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: 'Completely Different Movie 2024 1080p' }, identity, { idVerified: true });
  ok(!verdict.accepted && verdict.hardReject, 'conflicting stream label rejected despite ID route');

  const manifest = {
    id: 'example.addon', name: 'Example Server', version: '2.0',
    resources: [{ name: 'stream', idPrefixes: ['tmdb'] }, 'catalog', 'meta', 'subtitles', 'addon_catalog'],
    types: ['movie', 'series'],
    catalogs: [{ type: 'series', id: 'searchable', extra: [{ name: 'search' }] }],
    addonCatalogs: [{ type: 'all', id: 'community' }],
  };
  const info = context.manifestInfo(manifest);
  ok(info.valid && info.identification.kind === 'stremio-addon', 'manifest identified as addon server');
  ok(info.identification.supports.movie && info.identification.supports.series, 'server identifier records movie/series support');
  ok(info.identification.searchable && info.identification.identifierModes.includes('catalog-search'), 'server identifier records searchable catalogue');
  const provider = context.providerFromManifest('https://addon.example/manifest.json', manifest, { from: 'test' });
  eq(provider.status, 'installed', 'identified usable server auto-installs');
  ok(provider.categories.includes('streams') && provider.categories.includes('discovery'), 'provider installed by capabilities');
  const addon = context.providerToAddon(provider);
  ok(addon && addon.base === 'https://addon.example', 'installed provider syncs to playable addon registry');

  context.upsertProvider(provider);
  eq(context.settings.providers.length, 1, 'provider registry stores identified provider');
  const before = context.settings.providers.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < 1500; i++) {
    context.upsertProvider({
      id: 'github:example/repo-' + i, name: 'Repo ' + i, kind: 'github-project',
      categories: ['projects'], status: 'candidate', repoUrl: 'https://github.com/example/repo-' + i,
    });
  }
  eq(context.settings.providers.length, before + 1500, 'registry has no 30/60 style cap');
  context.removeProviderById(provider.id);
  ok(!context.getProvider(provider.id), 'provider can be removed while registry remains live');
  eq(context.upsertProvider(provider), null, 'removed provider is tombstoned against crawler resurrection');
  context.upsertProvider(provider, { force: true });
  ok(context.getProvider(provider.id), 'manual force re-add clears tombstone');

  context.fetchJsonLoose = async (url) => {
    if (url.includes('/catalog/series/searchable/search=')) {
      return { metas: [
        { id: 'custom-wrong', name: 'Game of Thrones S01E03', type: 'series' },
        { id: 'custom-got', name: 'Game of Thrones', type: 'series', releaseInfo: '2011' },
      ] };
    }
    if (url.includes('/meta/series/custom-got.json')) {
      return { meta: { id: 'custom-got', name: 'Game of Thrones', type: 'series', releaseInfo: '2011', videos: [{ id: 'custom-got-episode-2', season: 1, episode: 2 }] } };
    }
    if (url.includes('/stream/series/custom-got-episode-2.json')) {
      return { streams: [

      ] };

  ok(found && found.streamId === 'custom-got-episode-2', 'catalogue search identifies exact series and uses server episode id');
  const streams = await context.queryAddonStreams(addon, { identity });
  eq(streams.direct.length, 1, 'only identity-verified direct stream survives');
  eq(streams.direct[0].url, 'https://cdn.example/got.mp4', 'verified stream is the requested episode');
  ok(streams.identityRejected >= 1, 'wrong stream counted as identity rejection');
  eq(streams.torrents, 1, 'torrent remains hidden/counted');

  const lolaCatalogUrls = [];
  context.fetchJsonLoose = async (url) => {
    lolaCatalogUrls.push(url);
    if (url.includes('search=Mi%20coraz%C3%B3n%20insiste%20en%20Lola%20Volc%C3%A1n')) {
      return { metas: [{
        id: 'lola-volcan', name: 'Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán', type: 'series', releaseInfo: '2011',
        imdb_id: 'tt1929755', moviedb_id: 35281,
        videos: [{ id: 'lola-volcan:1:1', season: 1, episode: 1 }],
      }] };
    }
    return { metas: [] };
  };
  const lolaFound = await context.searchAddonCatalog({
    base: 'https://lola-addon.example', supportsMeta: false,

  }, lolaIdentity);
  ok(lolaFound && lolaFound.streamId === 'lola-volcan:1:1', 'server catalogue fallback finds Lola Volcán by its original title and episode');
  ok(lolaCatalogUrls.some(url => url.includes('search=My%20Heart%20Beats%20for%20Lola%20Volc%C3%A1n')) && lolaCatalogUrls.some(url => url.includes('search=Mi%20coraz%C3%B3n%20insiste%20en%20Lola%20Volc%C3%A1n')), 'server searches both English and Spanish exact-title variants');

  const server = require(path.join(root, 'api/extract.js'));
  const p = server._parse;

  ok(p.titleScore({ title: 'One Piece', url: 'https://x.test/anime/one-piece/ep-1' }, ['One Piece'], { type: 'tv', season: 1, episode: 1 }) >= 95, 'server accepts explicit correct episode URL');
  eq(p.titleScore({ title: 'Inception tt9999999' }, ['Inception'], { type: 'movie', imdb: 'tt1375666' }), 0, 'server rejects wrong IMDb identity');
  const sid = p.identifyTitleCandidate({ title: 'Inception', url: 'https://x.test/movie/tt1375666' }, ['Inception'], { type: 'movie', year: '2010', imdb: 'tt1375666' });
  ok(sid.accepted && sid.score === 100 && sid.reasons.includes('exact IMDb id'), 'server returns identity evidence');

  const staticChecks = [
    [!html.includes('function renderDebrid'), 'Real-Debrid UI removed'],
    [!html.includes('settings.tmdbKey'), 'personal TMDB key removed'],
    [!html.includes('settings.debrid'), 'Real-Debrid settings removed'],
    [html.includes('id="btnDiscoveryToggle"'), 'one continuous-search toggle exists'],
    [html.includes('runDiscoveryCycle'), 'continuous crawler engine exists'],
    [html.includes('identifyAndRegisterEndpoint'), 'server identification pipeline exists'],
    [!html.includes('enabledAddons().slice(0,12)'), '12-provider playback cap removed'],
    [!html.includes('sort((a,b)=>(b.stars||0)-(a.stars||0)).slice(0,60)'), '60-provider discovery cap removed'],
    [!fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'api/debrid.js')), 'Vercel Real-Debrid API removed'],
    [!fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'netlify/functions/debrid.js')), 'Netlify Real-Debrid API removed'],
    [!fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'netlify.toml'), 'utf8').includes('/api/debrid'), 'Netlify Real-Debrid route removed'],
  ];
  for (const [cond, label] of staticChecks) ok(cond, label);

  console.log(`\n${passed} checks passed`);
})().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
const { createCipheriv } = require('crypto');

const script = html.slice(html.indexOf('<script>') + 8, html.lastIndexOf('</script>'));
function between(start, end) {
  const a = script.indexOf(start);
  assert(a >= 0, 'missing start ' + start);
  const b = script.indexOf(end, a + start.length);
  assert(b > a, 'missing end ' + end);

}

let passed = 0;
function ok(cond, label) { assert(cond, label); passed++; console.log('PASS', label); }
function eq(a, b, label) {

  passed++; console.log('PASS', label);
}
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function waitFor(fn, label, timeout = 3000) {
  const start = Date.now();

    await sleep(20);
  }
  assert.fail('timed out waiting for ' + label);
}

function bufferOf(value) {
  const b = bytesOf(value);
  return b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.byteLength);
}

    this.map = new Map(Object.entries(init).map(([k, v]) => [String(k).toLowerCase(), String(v)]));
  }
  get(name) { return this.map.get(String(name).toLowerCase()) || null; }
}
function fakeResponse({ status = 200, headers = {}, body = '', chunks = null, url = '' } = {}) {
  const all = bytesOf(body);
  const parts = (chunks || [all]).map(bytesOf);

  return {
    status,
    ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,
    url,
    headers: new FakeHeaders(headers),
    body: {
      async cancel() { cancelled = true; },
      getReader() {
        let i = 0;

          async read() { return i < parts.length ? { done: false, value: parts[i++] } : { done: true, value: undefined }; },
          async cancel() { cancelled = true; },
        };

    get cancelled() { return cancelled; },
    async arrayBuffer() { return bufferOf(all); },
    async text() { return dec.decode(all); },
  };
}
function rangeSliceResponse(allBytes, rangeHeader, contentType = 'video/mp4') {
  const m = String(rangeHeader || '').match(/bytes=(\d+)-(\d*)/);
```
