```javascript
    const textOut = await server._find.handle('text', 'https://cdn.test/master.m3u8', {});
    ok(textOut.status === 200 && textOut.body.text.includes('#EXT-X-STREAM-INF'), 'server mode=text returns a validated M3U playlist');
    const m3uOut = await server._find.handle('m3u', 'https://site.test/watch', {});
    ok(m3uOut.status === 200 && m3uOut.body.playlists.some(p => p.url === 'https://cdn.test/from-page.m3u8'),
      'server mode=m3u extracts playlist links from a watch page');
    eq((await server._find.handle('text', 'https://site.test/not-playlist', {})).status, 415,
      'server mode=text rejects a non-M3U response');
    eq((await server._find.handle('text', 'https://cdn.test/huge.m3u8', {})).status, 413,
      'server mode=text refuses a playlist beyond the streamed safety cap');
    eq((await server._find.handle('m3u', 'http://127.0.0.1/admin', {})).status, 400,
      'server M3U modes keep private/loopback URLs blocked');
  } finally {
    global.fetch = originalFetch;
  }

  /* ---------- entry-point and route wiring ---------- */
  const statics = [
    [html.includes('data-ep-play="') && html.includes('data-ep-download="') && html.includes('e.stopPropagation()'),
      'each episode has separate Play and Download buttons'],
    [html.includes('id="btnDownloadTitle"') && html.includes('downloadTitleBtn.onclick'),
      'title/detail download button is wired to the exact selected episode'],
    [html.includes('id="btnPlayerDownload"') && html.includes('openDownloadForContext(playerContext(st)'),
      'player download button is wired'],
    [html.includes('data-server-download="') && html.includes('closest("[data-server-download]")'),
      'Servers modal download button is wired for verified direct options'],
    [html.includes('id="settingsAddWebsite"') && html.includes('id="discoveryPanel"') && html.includes('id="settingsFastStream"'),
      'Settings contains Add Website, continuous adding and FastStream configuration'],
    [html.includes('id="menuQuickSwitches"') && html.includes('function renderMenuQuickSwitches()'),
      'menu box contains quick feature switches'],
    [html.includes('.setting-control input{width:46px;height:24px') && html.includes('.setting-control input:focus-visible+.slider'),
      'feature switches keep a TV-focusable hit area and visible focus ring'],
    [html.includes('route==="settings"') && html.includes('route==="downloads"'),
      'Settings and Downloads routes are wired'],
    [html.includes('String(job.id).replace(/["\\\\]/g,"\\\\$&")'),
      'download-row selector does not depend on CSS.escape on older TV browsers'],
    [html.includes('activeVariant:{url:activeDownloadObjectUrl,quality:job.quality,bytes:blob.size}'),
      'downloaded-file playback uses the local object URL as its active variant'],
  ];
  for (const [cond, label] of statics) ok(cond, label);

  const vercel = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'vercel.json'), 'utf8'));
  const rewriteSources = (vercel.rewrites || []).map(r => r.source);
  ok(rewriteSources.includes('/settings') && rewriteSources.includes('/downloads'), 'Vercel clean Settings/Downloads rewrites exist');
  const netlify = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'netlify.toml'), 'utf8');
  ok(netlify.includes('from = "/settings"') && netlify.includes('from = "/downloads"'), 'Netlify clean Settings/Downloads rewrites exist');

  console.log(`\n${passed} download/M3U/settings checks passed`);
})().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/server-finder.test.cjs`

```javascript
'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { once } = require('node:events');
const { publicHttpsUrl, normalizeIdentity, parseManifest, providerRecord, extractManifestUrls, fetchTextJson, crawlSource, findCandidates, runWorker } = require('../lib/server-finder/core');
const findApi = require('../api/find');
const { createLocalServer } = require('../server');

const manifest = {
  id: 'org.example.lola', name: 'Lola Stream Candidate', version: '1.0.0',
  description: 'Public test addon', resources: ['stream', 'catalog', 'meta'],
  types: ['movie', 'series'], idPrefixes: ['tt'],
  catalogs: [{ type: 'movie', id: 'search', extra: [{ name: 'search' }] }],
};
function response(data, status = 200, headers = {}) {
  return {
    ok: status >= 200 && status < 300, status,
    headers: { get(name) { return headers[String(name).toLowerCase()] || null; } },
    async text() { return typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data); },
  };
}
function responseStub() {
  return { statusCode: 200, headers: {}, body: null, setHeader(name, value) { this.headers[name] = value; }, status(code) { this.statusCode = code; return this; }, json(value) { this.body = value; return value; } };
}

(async () => {
  assert.equal(publicHttpsUrl('https://addon.example/manifest.json'), 'https://addon.example/manifest.json', 'public HTTPS addon manifests are accepted');
  for (const url of ['http://addon.example/manifest.json', 'https://localhost/manifest.json', 'https://127.0.0.1/manifest.json', 'https://192.168.1.2/manifest.json', 'https://addon.local/manifest.json']) {
    assert.equal(publicHttpsUrl(url), '', 'private, local, and non-HTTPS targets are rejected');
  }
  const identity = normalizeIdentity({ title: 'My Heart Beats for Lola Volcán', titles: ['Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán'], type: 'tv', year: '2011', imdbId: 'tt1929755', tmdbId: '35281', season: 1, episode: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(identity.titles, ['My Heart Beats for Lola Volcán', 'Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán'], 'identity retains English and original title variants');
  assert.equal(identity.imdbId, 'tt1929755');
  assert.throws(() => normalizeIdentity({ title: ' ' }), /title is required/i, 'empty title searches are rejected');
  assert.equal(parseManifest(manifest).resources.includes('stream'), true, 'stream-capable manifest is identified');
  assert.equal(parseManifest({ ...manifest, resources: ['catalog'] }), null, 'catalog-only manifests are not server candidates');
  assert.equal(parseManifest({ ...manifest, types: ['person'] }), null, 'non-video manifests are not server candidates');
  const record = providerRecord('https://addon.example/manifest.json', manifest, 'fixture');
  assert.equal(record.status, 'candidate', 'discovered providers remain candidates');
  assert.equal(record.titleScopedDiscovery, true, 'candidate is marked for title-scoped verification');
  assert.equal(record.identification.installable, false, 'manifest discovery alone cannot install a provider');
  assert.equal(record.identification.supports.streams, true, 'candidate stream capability is surfaced to the existing title scanner');
  assert.deepEqual(extractManifestUrls('Install at https://addons.example/manifest.json and not https://example.org/home'), ['https://addons.example/manifest.json'], 'GitHub README scraper only extracts manifest endpoints');

  let calls = 0;
  await assert.rejects(fetchTextJson('http://127.0.0.1/private', { fetchImpl: async () => { calls++; return response({}); } }), /Blocked URL/, 'unsafe requests are rejected before fetching');
  assert.equal(calls, 0, 'private URL rejection avoids network access');
  await assert.rejects(fetchTextJson('https://public.example/start', { fetchImpl: async () => response('', 302, { location: 'http://127.0.0.1/private' }) }), /Blocked redirect/, 'redirects to private targets are blocked');

  const fixtureFetch = async url => {
    const value = String(url);
    if (value.includes('stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons')) return response({ addons: [
      { manifestUrl: 'https://addon.example/manifest.json', manifest, stars: 7 },
      { manifestUrl: 'http://unsafe.example/manifest.json', manifest },
      { manifestUrl: 'https://catalog-only.example/manifest.json', manifest: { ...manifest, resources: ['catalog'] } },
    ] });
    if (value.includes('addon_catalog/all/')) return response({ addons: [] });
    if (value.includes('api.github.com/search/repositories')) return response({ items: [] });
    throw new Error('Unexpected fixture request ' + value);
  };
  const catalog = await crawlSource('stremio-addons', identity, { fetchImpl: fixtureFetch, maxPerSource: 12, timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(catalog.status, 'complete', 'catalog crawler completes with fixture data');
  assert.equal(catalog.candidates, 1, 'only a public HTTPS stream manifest becomes a candidate');
  assert.equal(catalog.records[0].source, 'Server Finder · stremio-addons', 'candidate provenance is retained');
  const partialGraph = await crawlSource('catalog-graph', identity, { fetchImpl: async url => String(url).includes('community.json') ? response({}, 503) : response({ addons: [] }), timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(partialGraph.status, 'partial', 'one unavailable catalogue is reported as partial rather than silently complete');
  const failedGraph = await crawlSource('catalog-graph', identity, { fetchImpl: async () => { throw new Error('offline'); }, timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(failedGraph.status, 'failed', 'all unavailable catalogues are reported as failed');
  const bounded = await findCandidates(identity, { sourceIds: ['stremio-addons'], fetchImpl: fixtureFetch, maxPerSource: 12, limit: 1, timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(bounded.candidateCount, 1, 'candidate results obey caller limits');
  assert.equal(bounded.mode, 'hosted-bounded-pool', 'hosted mode uses bounded async workers');

  const threadResult = await runWorker('unknown-source', identity, { timeoutMs: 1000, workerTimeoutMs: 5000 });
  assert.equal(threadResult.status, 'failed', 'local worker_threads execute and report isolated source failures');
  assert.match(threadResult.error, /unknown crawler/i, 'worker failures are contained as source status rather than crashing the server');

  const originalFetch = global.fetch;
  global.fetch = async url => {
    const value = String(url);
    if (value.includes('stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons')) return response({ addons: [] });
    if (value.includes('addon_catalog/all/')) return response({ addons: [] });
    if (value.includes('api.github.com/search/repositories')) return response({ items: [] });
    throw new Error('Unexpected API fixture request ' + value);
  };
  try {
    const badMethod = responseStub();
    await findApi({ method: 'DELETE', headers: {}, query: {} }, badMethod);
    assert.equal(badMethod.statusCode, 405, 'hosted endpoint is read-only apart from title search');
    const badOrigin = responseStub();
    await findApi({ method: 'GET', headers: { origin: 'https://evil.example', host: 'zeroplay.example' }, query: { q: 'Lola' } }, badOrigin);
    assert.equal(badOrigin.statusCode, 403, 'hosted endpoint rejects cross-origin requests');
    const hosted = responseStub();
    await findApi({ method: 'POST', headers: { host: 'zeroplay.example', origin: 'https://zeroplay.example', 'x-forwarded-for': '203.0.113.4' }, query: {}, body: { identity } }, hosted);
    assert.equal(hosted.statusCode, 200, 'hosted API returns candidate-discovery status');
    assert.equal(hosted.body.ok, true, 'hosted API returns a successful bounded search');
    assert.equal(hosted.body.candidateCount, 0, 'no manifests means no candidates are promoted');
  } finally { global.fetch = originalFetch; }

  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'index.html'), 'utf8');
  assert(html.includes('fetch("/api/find"'), 'browser uses a same-origin finder URL instead of hard-coded localhost');
  assert(html.includes('serverFinderProgressHTML') && html.includes('serverFinderSourceStatus'), 'finder source progress appears separately in the title-search UI');
  assert(html.includes('result.identityVerified>0') && html.includes('status:"installed"'), 'browser retains exact-match-only candidate promotion');

  const local = createLocalServer();
  local.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
  await once(local, 'listening');
  try {
    const address = local.address();
    const health = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + address.port + '/api/health');
    const status = await health.json();
    assert.equal(status.ok, true, 'local sidecar health endpoint responds');
    assert.equal(status.mode, 'local-worker-threads', 'local mode advertises its actual worker strategy');
    const home = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + address.port + '/');
    assert.equal(home.status, 200, 'local server serves the existing browser app from the same origin');
    assert((await home.text()).includes('ZeroPlay'), 'local app shell is served without a localhost URL in browser code');
  } finally { await new Promise(resolve => local.close(resolve)); }

  console.log('PASS bounded local/hosted Server Finder, safe candidate discovery, same-origin fallback, and exact-title promotion guard');
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

### `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/server-search-concurrency.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const vm = require('vm');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const script = html.slice(html.indexOf('<script>') + 8, html.lastIndexOf('</script>'));
const start = script.indexOf('async function collectAllStreams(ctx,opts)');
const end = script.indexOf('\nasync function measureSpeed', start);
assert(start >= 0 && end > start, 'collectAllStreams must exist');
const titleSearchStart = script.indexOf('async function findTitleServers(ctx,opts)');
const titleSearchEnd = script.indexOf('\nasync function playTitleServerOption', titleSearchStart);
assert(titleSearchStart >= 0 && titleSearchEnd > titleSearchStart, 'title server search must exist');
const titleSearchCode = script.slice(titleSearchStart, titleSearchEnd);
assert(!titleSearchCode.includes('runDiscoveryCycle(') && !titleSearchCode.includes('crawlStremioAddonsNet(') && !titleSearchCode.includes('crawlCatalogGraph('), '100-worker title lookup does not start the independent continuous discovery crawler');
assert(titleSearchCode.includes('collectAllStreams(richCtx') && titleSearchCode.includes('collectTitleCandidateStreams(richCtx'), 'title lookup scans installed providers and the current candidate snapshot');
assert(script.includes('setInterval(()=>{ runDiscoveryCycle("interval"); }'), 'continuous provider discovery keeps its independent timer');

const addons = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `provider-${i}`, name: `Provider ${i}` }));
let active = 0;
let maxActive = 0;
const completed = [];
const updates = [];
const ctx = {
  settings: { stream: { quality: 'auto' }, addons },
  enabledAddons() { return ctx.settings.addons; },
  healthScore() { return 50; },
  normalizeQualityLabel(value) { return value; },
  qualityHeight(value) { return Number.parseInt(value, 10) || 0; },
  buildTitleIdentity(input) { return { version: 1, title: input.title || 'Series', type: 'tv' }; },
  async queryAddonStreams(addon) {
    active++;
    maxActive = Math.max(maxActive, active);
    const delays = { 'provider-0': 35, 'provider-1': 5, 'provider-2': 15, 'provider-3': 3, 'provider-4': 8, 'provider-5': 1, 'provider-6': 2 };
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delays[addon.id]));
    active--;
    completed.push(addon.id);
    return {
      direct: [{ url: `https://cdn.test/${addon.id}.mp4`, addonName: addon.name, addonBase: `https://${addon.id}.test`, quality: '1080p', identityScore: 99 }],
      identityVerified: 1,
    };
  },
};
ctx.globalThis = ctx;
vm.createContext(ctx);
vm.runInContext(script.slice(start, end), ctx, { filename: 'collect-all-streams.js' });

(async () => {
  const result = await ctx.collectAllStreams({ title: 'Series', type: 'tv' }, {
    concurrency: 3,
    onProgress(snapshot) { updates.push(snapshot.queried); },
  });
  assert.strictEqual(maxActive, 3, 'uses configured provider concurrency');
  assert.strictEqual(result.concurrency, 3, 'reports actual concurrency');
  assert.strictEqual(result.queried, addons.length, 'queries every enabled provider');
  assert.strictEqual(result.direct.length, addons.length, 'preserves every verified matching stream');
  assert.strictEqual(updates.length, addons.length, 'reports progress per provider, not per completed batch');
  assert.strictEqual(updates[0], 1, 'first provider completion is emitted immediately');
  assert.notStrictEqual(completed[0], 'provider-0', 'fast providers are not held behind a slow provider');
  assert.strictEqual(result.identityVerified, addons.length, 'aggregates verified stream counts');

  const allProviders = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `vod-${i}`, name: `VOD ${i}` }));
  ctx.settings.addons = allProviders;
  let started = 0;
  ctx.queryAddonStreams = async addon => {
    started++;
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1));
    return { direct: [{ url: `https://cdn.test/${addon.id}.mp4`, addonName: addon.name, addonBase: `https://${addon.id}.test` }] };
  };
  const fullScan = await ctx.collectAllStreams({ title: 'Series', type: 'tv' }, {});
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.concurrency, 100, 'uses the requested 100-worker default for a large VOD provider list');
  assert.strictEqual(started, 120, 'does not stop provider scheduling after finding matching servers');
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.queried, 120, 'scans the complete enabled VOD provider list');
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.totalAddons, 120, 'reports the full provider inventory');
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.direct.length, 120, 'does not cap verified direct results');
  console.log('PASS bounded concurrent workers and immediate per-provider progress');
  console.log('PASS uncapped VOD provider scan returns all matching servers');
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');

function between(start, end) {
  const a = script.indexOf(start); assert(a >= 0, 'missing ' + start);
  const b = script.indexOf(end, a + start.length); assert(b > a, 'missing ' + end);
  return script.slice(a, b);
}
const installed = [];
const queried = [];
let saves = 0, syncs = 0;
const providers = [
  { id: 'candidate:match', status: 'candidate', enabled: true, name: 'Match addon', base: 'https://match.example', manifestUrl: 'https://match.example/manifest.json', categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], types: ['movie'], idPrefixes: ['tt'], identification: { supports: { streams: true }, confidence: 90 } },
  { id: 'candidate:miss', status: 'candidate', enabled: true, name: 'No match addon', base: 'https://miss.example', manifestUrl: 'https://miss.example/manifest.json', categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], types: ['movie'], idPrefixes: ['tt'], identification: { supports: { streams: true }, confidence: 80 } },
  { id: 'candidate:wrong', status: 'candidate', enabled: true, name: 'Unverified addon', base: 'https://wrong.example', manifestUrl: 'https://wrong.example/manifest.json', categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], types: ['movie'], idPrefixes: ['tt'], identification: { supports: { streams: true }, confidence: 75 } },
  { id: 'candidate:disabled', status: 'candidate', enabled: false, name: 'Disabled addon', base: 'https://disabled.example', manifestUrl: 'https://disabled.example/manifest.json', categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], types: ['movie'], idPrefixes: ['tt'], identification: { supports: { streams: true } } },
  { id: 'installed:known', status: 'installed', enabled: true, name: 'Already installed', base: 'https://known.example', manifestUrl: 'https://known.example/manifest.json', categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], identification: { supports: { streams: true } } },
  { id: 'candidate:local', status: 'candidate', enabled: true, name: 'Local endpoint', base: 'https://127.0.0.1', manifestUrl: 'https://127.0.0.1/manifest.json', categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], identification: { supports: { streams: true } } },
  { id: 'candidate:nostream', status: 'candidate', enabled: true, name: 'Non-stream addon', base: 'https://catalog.example', manifestUrl: 'https://catalog.example/manifest.json', identification: { supports: { streams: false } } },
];
const ctx = {
  Date, Math, Number, String, Array, Object, Set, Map, URL, Promise,
  settings: { providers, providerTombstones: {}, addons: [], discovery: { cursors: {} } },
  discoveryCfg() { return ctx.settings.discovery; },
  queryAddonStreams: async addon => {
    queried.push(addon.base);
    if (addon.base === 'https://match.example') return { direct: [{ url: 'https://cdn.example/exact-title.mp4', addonName: addon.name, addonBase: addon.base }], identityVerified: 1 };
    if (addon.base === 'https://wrong.example') return { direct: [{ url: 'https://cdn.example/unverified.mp4', addonName: addon.name, addonBase: addon.base }], identityVerified: 0 };
    return { direct: [], identityVerified: 0 };
  },
  upsertProvider: rec => { installed.push(rec); return { provider: rec }; },
  syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders() { syncs++; },
  saveSettings() { saves++; },
  uniqueStringList(values) { return [...new Set((values || []).map(String))]; },
  cleanHttpUrl(raw) { try { const u = new URL(raw); return /^https?:$/.test(u.protocol) ? u.href : ''; } catch { return ''; } },
  manifestBaseFromUrl(url) { return String(url).replace(/\/manifest\.json(?:\?.*)?$/i, '').replace(/\/$/, ''); },
  manifestInfo() { return { valid: true, categories: ['streams'], resources: ['stream'], types: ['movie'], idPrefixes: ['tt'], catalogDefs: [], addonCatalogs: [], searchCatalogs: [], playableStream: true, identification: { installable: true, playableStream: true, supports: { streams: true } } }; },
};
ctx.globalThis = ctx;
vm.createContext(ctx);
vm.runInContext(between('function providerFromManifest(', 'function providerToAddon(') + between('function isPublicHttpsProviderBase(', 'async function measureSpeed('), ctx);

(async () => {
  const deferred = ctx.providerFromManifest('https://deferred.example/manifest.json', { id: 'test', name: 'Deferred' }, { deferInstall: true });
  assert.strictEqual(deferred.status, 'candidate', 'public catalogue stream addons stay candidates until a title match');
  assert.strictEqual(deferred.titleScopedDiscovery, true, 'title-scoped marker is retained after manifest identification');
  const normal = ctx.providerFromManifest('https://manual.example/manifest.json', { id: 'manual', name: 'Manual' }, {});
  assert.strictEqual(normal.status, 'installed', 'manual or explicitly seeded providers keep existing install behavior');

  const candidates = ctx.titleSearchCandidates(100);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(candidates.map(p => p.id), ['candidate:match', 'candidate:miss', 'candidate:wrong']);
  const result = await ctx.collectTitleCandidateStreams({ identity: { type: 'movie', tmdbId: 1, imdbId: 'tt0000001', title: 'Exact Title' } }, { limit: 100, concurrency: 12 });
  assert.strictEqual(result.queried, 3, 'only eligible, enabled, public HTTPS stream candidates are queried');
  assert.strictEqual(result.matchedProviders, 1, 'only a provider returning an identity-verified direct title stream matches');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result.direct.map(s => s.url))), ['https://cdn.example/exact-title.mp4']);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(installed.map(p => p.id), ['candidate:match'], 'unmatched and unverified providers are never installed');
  assert.strictEqual(installed[0].titleScopedDiscovery, false, 'a verified title match graduates its provider from candidate status');
  assert.strictEqual(syncs, 1, 'matched addons are synchronized once after the candidate batch');
  assert.strictEqual(saves, 1, 'matched providers persist once after the candidate batch');
  assert.strictEqual(queried.includes('https://127.0.0.1'), false, 'local/private destinations are not queried');
  for (let i = 0; i < 108; i++) providers.push({ id: 'candidate:extra-' + i, status: 'candidate', enabled: true, base: 'https://extra-' + i + '.example', manifestUrl: 'https://extra-' + i + '.example/manifest.json', resources: ['stream'], identification: { supports: { streams: true }, confidence: 10 } });
  const firstBatch = ctx.titleSearchCandidates(100, 0).map(p => p.id);
  const nextBatch = ctx.titleSearchCandidates(100, 100).map(p => p.id);
  assert.strictEqual(firstBatch.length, 100, 'each title-search pass is capped at 100 candidates');
  assert(new Set(firstBatch.concat(nextBatch)).size > 100, 'candidate cursor rotates so providers beyond the first 100 are reached');
  console.log('PASS title-scoped provider discovery and exact-match-only installation');
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');

const tvIdentity = { type: 'tv', tmdbId: 1399, imdbId: 'tt0944947', season: 2, episode: 3 };
ok(ctx.sourceSupportsTitle({ id: 'vidstuck', kind: 'builtin' }, tvIdentity).supported, 'built-in exact-ID episode route is title-addressable');
ok(!ctx.sourceSupportsTitle({ id: 'x', kind: 'custom', tvTpl: 'https://x.test/movie/{tmdb}' }, tvIdentity).supported, 'movie-only template excluded for an episode');
ok(!ctx.sourceSupportsTitle({ id: 'a', kind: 'addon', identification: { supports: { movie: false } } }, movieIdentity).supported, 'addon explicitly lacking movie support excluded');

(async () => {
  const sent = [];

  ctx.resetFastStreamBridge(frame);

  const handler = listeners.message.at(-1);
  handler({ origin: 'https://faststream.online', source: frame.contentWindow, data: { type: 'faststream:event', event: 'ready', state: { paused: true } } });

    [html.includes('result.direct.length&&result.identityVerified>0') && html.includes('titleScopedDiscovery:false') && html.includes('matched a title-scoped playback search'), 'only identity-verified direct title matches are promoted into installed providers'],
    [html.includes('titleCandidatesQueried') && html.includes('only exact-title stream matches are saved'), 'title-specific candidate progress is shown separately from installed-provider scan progress'],
    [html.includes('function titleCandidateInventoryFingerprint()') && html.includes('candidateInventory:candidates.map') && html.includes('titleCandidateCursor'), 'candidate inventory is cache-aware and rotates past the first 100 candidates'],
    [html.includes('titleScopedDiscovery&&!installed') && html.includes('!installed&&!p.titleScopedDiscovery'), 'title-scoped candidates cannot be manually installed from the candidate list without a title match'],


    [html.includes('id="btnFastStreamToggle"') && html.includes('Disable FastStream') && html.includes('stNow.player="builtin"') && html.includes('stNow.fastStreamApiProbe=false'), 'settings include an immediate FastStream disable toggle'],

    [html.includes('https://faststream.online/player/#'), 'legacy FastStream HLS/DASH fallback retained'],
    [html.includes('r.status!==206') && html.includes('Math.min(4,Number(cfg.primeThreads)||2)') && html.includes('primeBudgetMb'), 'direct priming capped to genuine range responses and configured worker/budget limits'],
    [html.includes('async function tryNextDirectVariant(reason){\n  const st=playerState; if(!st) return false;\n  if(streamCfg().autoFailover===false) return false;') && html.includes('Confirmed direct playback stalled on ') && html.includes('hasAdvanced&&lastObservedAdvanceAt'), 'automatic switching master switch and confirmed native stall detection are wired'],
    [html.includes('scanning every enabled provider') && html.includes('groupStreamsByServer') && !html.includes('stopAfterServers') && !html.includes('maxDirect:opts.maxDirect'), 'server search scans every enabled provider and groups title-specific matches'],
    [html.includes('quickSearchDetached=true') && html.includes('quickSearchDetached||!opts.shouldContinue||opts.shouldContinue()'), 'quick failover can return early while the full provider search continues in the background'],
    [html.includes('const providerInventory=enabledAddons()') && html.includes("scanned all '+(stats.queriedProviders||stats.totalProviders||0)+' enabled direct providers"), 'newly discovered VOD providers invalidate the title cache and appear in the completed scan count'],
    [!/id=\\"playerSource\\"(?!Line)/.test(html) && !html.includes('id="detailSource"'), 'all-server player/detail dropdowns removed'],
    [html.includes('function moveTvFocus') && html.includes('handlePlayerKeyboard'), 'TV spatial and player keyboard navigation present'],
    [html.includes('tabindex="-1" src="https://faststream.online/player/#') || html.includes('f.setAttribute("tabindex","-1")'), 'cross-origin frames do not steal initial TV focus'],
  ];
  for (const [cond, label] of statics) ok(cond, label);
  console.log(`\n${n} TV/player checks passed`);
})().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });
```
